526character(len=40) :: mdl = "MOM_open_boundary" !< This module's name.
527
528contains
529
530!> Enables OBC module and reads configuration parameters
531!! This routine is called from MOM_initialize_fixed which
532!! occurs before the initialization of the vertical coordinate
533!! and ALE_init. Therefore segment data are not fully initialized
534!! here. The remainder of the segment data are initialized in a
535!! later call to update_open_boundary_data
5361subroutine open_boundary_config(G, US, param_file, OBC)
537 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
538 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
539 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< Parameter file handle
540 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
541
542 ! Local variables
543 integer :: num_of_segs ! Number of open boundary segments
544 integer :: n, n_seg ! For looping over segments
545 logical :: debug, mask_outside, reentrant_x, reentrant_y
546 character(len=15) :: segment_param_str ! The run-time parameter name for each segment
547 character(len=1024) :: segment_str ! The contents (rhs) for parameter "segment_param_str"
548 character(len=200) :: config ! A string to temporarily store a few runtime parameters
549 real :: Lscale_in, Lscale_out ! parameters controlling tracer values at the boundaries [L ~> m]
550 integer :: default_answer_date ! The default setting for the various ANSWER_DATE flags.
551 logical :: enable_bugs ! If true, the defaults for recently added bug-fix flags are set to
552 ! recreate the bugs, or if false bugs are only used if actively selected.
553 logical :: debugging_tests ! If true, do additional calls resetting values to help debug the performance
554 ! of the open boundary condition code.
555 logical :: obsolete_param_set, param_set
556 logical :: zero_vorticity, freeslip_vorticity, computed_vorticity, specified_vorticity
557 logical :: zero_strain, freeslip_strain, computed_strain, specified_strain
558 ! This include declares and sets the variable "version".
559# include "version_variable.h"
560
561 call log_version(param_file, mdl, version, "Controls where open boundaries are located, "//&
562 "what kind of boundary condition to impose, and what data to apply, if any.", &
5631 all_default=.false.)
564 ! Parameter OBC_NUMBER_OF_SEGMENTS is always logged.
565 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_NUMBER_OF_SEGMENTS", num_of_segs, &
5661 "The number of open boundary segments.", default=0)
5671 if (num_of_segs <= 0) & ! Do nothing if there is no OBC segments
5681 return
569
5700 allocate(OBC)
5710 OBC%number_of_segments = num_of_segs
572 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_USER_CONFIG", config, &
573 "A string that sets how the open boundary conditions are "//&
5740 " configured: \n", default="none", do_not_log=.true.)
575 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "NK", OBC%ke, &
5760 "The number of model layers", default=0, do_not_log=.true.)
577
5780 if (config /= "none" .and. config /= "dyed_obcs") OBC%user_BCs_set_globally = .true.
579
580 ! Configuration for OBC relative vorticity.
581 ! Old setup method
5820 obsolete_param_set = .false.
5830 zero_vorticity = .false.
5840 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_ZERO_VORTICITY", zero_vorticity, set=param_set)
5850 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
5860 freeslip_vorticity = .true.
5870 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_FREESLIP_VORTICITY", freeslip_vorticity, set=param_set)
5880 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
5890 computed_vorticity = .false.
5900 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_COMPUTED_VORTICITY", computed_vorticity, set=param_set)
5910 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
5920 specified_vorticity = .false.
5930 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_SPECIFIED_VORTICITY", specified_vorticity, set=param_set)
5940 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
5950 if (obsolete_param_set) then
596 call MOM_error(WARNING, 'OBC_ZERO_VORTICITY, OBC_FREESLIP_VORTICITY, OBC_COMPUTED_VORTICITY'//&
5970 ' and OBC_SPECIFIED_VORTICITY are obsolete, use OBC_VORTICITY_CONFIG instead.')
598 if ((zero_vorticity .and. freeslip_vorticity) .or. &
599 (zero_vorticity .and. computed_vorticity) .or. &
600 (zero_vorticity .and. specified_vorticity) .or. &
601 (freeslip_vorticity .and. computed_vorticity) .or. &
6020 (freeslip_vorticity .and. specified_vorticity) .or. &
603 (computed_vorticity .and. specified_vorticity)) &
604 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, open_boundary_config:\n"//&
605 "Only one of OBC_ZERO_VORTICITY, OBC_FREESLIP_VORTICITY, OBC_COMPUTED_VORTICITY\n"//&
6060 "and OBC_IMPORTED_VORTICITY can be True at once.")
607 ! "config" is set from OBC_XXX_VORTICITY if they are used.
6080 if (zero_vorticity) then
6090 config = 'zero'
6100 elseif (freeslip_vorticity) then
6110 config = 'freeslip'
6120 elseif (computed_vorticity) then
6130 config = 'computed'
6140 elseif (specified_vorticity) then
6150 config = 'specified'
616 else
6170 config = 'none'
618 endif
619 else
6200 config = 'freeslip' ! Default
621 endif
622 ! New setup method (overrides old method if specified)
6230 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_VORTICITY_CONFIG", config)
624 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_VORTICITY_CONFIG", config, &
625 "Configuration for relative vorticity in momentum advection at open "//&
626 "boundaries. Options are: \n"// &
627 " \t none - No adjustment.\n"//&
628 " \t zero - Sets relative vorticity to zero.\n"//&
629 " \t freeslip - Sets the normal gradient of tangential velocity to zero.\n"//&
630 " \t computed - Computes the normal gradient of tangential velocity using\n"//&
631 " \t external values of tangential velocity.\n"//&
632 " \t specified - Uses the external values of the normal gradient of\n"//&
6330 " \t tangential velocity.", default="freeslip", do_not_read=.true.)
6340 select case (trim(config))
6350 case ("none") ; OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_VORTICITY_NONE
6360 case ("zero") ; OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_VORTICITY_ZERO
6370 case ("freeslip") ; OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_VORTICITY_FREESLIP
6380 case ("computed") ; OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_VORTICITY_COMPUTED
6390 case ("specified") ; OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_VORTICITY_SPECIFIED
640 case default
6410 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary: Unrecognized OBC_VORTICITY_CONFIG: "//trim(config))
642 end select
643
644 ! Configuration for OBC strain.
645 ! Old setup method
6460 obsolete_param_set = .false.
6470 zero_strain = .false.
6480 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_ZERO_STRAIN", zero_strain, set=param_set)
6490 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
6500 freeslip_strain = .true.
6510 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_FREESLIP_STRAIN", freeslip_strain, set=param_set)
6520 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
6530 computed_strain = .false.
6540 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_COMPUTED_STRAIN", computed_strain, set=param_set)
6550 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
6560 specified_strain = .false.
6570 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_SPECIFIED_STRAIN", specified_strain, set=param_set)
6580 obsolete_param_set = obsolete_param_set .or. param_set
6590 if (obsolete_param_set) then
660 call MOM_error(WARNING, 'OBC_ZERO_STRAIN, OBC_FREESLIP_STRAIN, OBC_COMPUTED_STRAIN'//&
6610 ' and OBC_SPECIFIED_STRAIN are obsolete, use OBC_STRAIN_CONFIG instead.')
662 if ((zero_strain .and. freeslip_strain) .or. &
663 (zero_strain .and. computed_strain) .or. &
664 (zero_strain .and. specified_strain) .or. &
665 (freeslip_strain .and. computed_strain) .or. &
6660 (freeslip_strain .and. specified_strain) .or. &
667 (computed_strain .and. specified_strain)) &
668 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, open_boundary_config: \n"//&
669 "Only one of OBC_ZERO_STRAIN, OBC_FREESLIP_STRAIN, OBC_COMPUTED_STRAIN \n"//&
6700 "and OBC_IMPORTED_STRAIN can be True at once.")
671 ! "config" is set from OBC_XXX_STRAIN if they are used.
6720 if (zero_strain) then
6730 config = 'zero'
6740 elseif (freeslip_strain) then
6750 config = 'freeslip'
6760 elseif (computed_strain) then
6770 config = 'computed'
6780 elseif (specified_strain) then
6790 config = 'specified'
680 else
6810 config = 'none'
682 endif
683 else
6840 config = 'freeslip' ! Default
685 endif
686 ! New setup method (overrides old method if specified)
6870 call read_param(param_file, "OBC_STRAIN_CONFIG", config)
688 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_STRAIN_CONFIG", config, &
689 "Configuration for strain in horizontal viscosity at open boundaries. "//&
690 "Options are: \n"// &
691 " \t none - No adjustment.\n"//&
692 " \t zero - Sets strain to zero.\n"//&
693 " \t freeslip - Sets the normal gradient of tangential velocity to zero.\n"//&
694 " \t computed - Computes the normal gradient of tangential velocity using\n"//&
695 " \t external values of tangential velocity.\n"//&
696 " \t specified - Uses the external values of the normal gradient of\n"//&
6970 " \t tangential velocity.", default="freeslip", do_not_read=.true.)
6980 select case (trim(config))
6990 case ("none") ; OBC%strain_config = OBC_STRAIN_NONE
7000 case ("zero") ; OBC%strain_config = OBC_STRAIN_ZERO
7010 case ("freeslip") ; OBC%strain_config = OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP
7020 case ("computed") ; OBC%strain_config = OBC_STRAIN_COMPUTED
7030 case ("specified") ; OBC%strain_config = OBC_STRAIN_SPECIFIED
704 case default
7050 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary: Unrecognized OBC_STRAIN_CONFIG: "//trim(config))
706 end select
707
708 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_ZERO_BIHARMONIC", OBC%zero_biharmonic, &
709 "If true, zeros the Laplacian of flow on open boundaries in the biharmonic "//&
7100 "viscosity term.", default=.false.)
711 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "MASK_OUTSIDE_OBCS", mask_outside, &
712 "If true, set the areas outside open boundaries to be land.", &
7130 default=.false.)
714 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "RAMP_OBCS", OBC%ramp, &
715 "If true, ramps from zero to the external values over time, with "//&
716 "a ramping timescale given by RAMP_TIMESCALE. Ramping SSH only so far.", &
7170 default=.false.)
718 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_RAMP_TIMESCALE", OBC%ramp_timescale, &
719 "If RAMP_OBCS is true, this sets the ramping timescale.", &
7200 units="days", default=1.0, scale=86400.0*US%s_to_T)
721 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TIDE_N_CONSTITUENTS", OBC%n_tide_constituents, &
722 "Number of tidal constituents being added to the open boundary.", &
7230 default=0)
7240 OBC%add_tide_constituents = (OBC%n_tide_constituents > 0)
725
7260 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "DEBUG", debug, default=.false.)
727 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "DEBUG_OBCS", OBC%debug, &
728 "If true, do additional calls to help debug the performance "//&
729 "of the open boundary condition code.", &
7300 default=.false., debuggingParam=.true.)
7310 if (OBC%debug .and. (num_PEs() > 1)) &
7320 call MOM_error(FATAL, "DEBUG_OBCS = True is currently only supported for single PE runs.")
733 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_DEBUGGING_TESTS", debugging_tests, &
734 "If true, do additional calls resetting certain values to help verify the correctness "//&
735 "of the open boundary condition code.", &
7360 default=.false., old_name="DEBUG_OBC", debuggingParam=.true.)
737 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "NK_OBC_DEBUG", OBC%nk_OBC_debug, &
738 "The number of layers of OBC segment data to write out in full "//&
739 "when DEBUG_OBCS is true.", &
7400 default=0, debuggingParam=.true., do_not_log=.not.OBC%debug)
741 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_REVERSE_SEGMENT_ORDER", OBC%reverse_segment_order, &
742 "If true, store the OBC segments internally and handle them in the reverse "//&
743 "order from that with which they are specified via external parameters to test "//&
744 "for dependencies on the order with which the OBC segments are applied.", &
7450 default=.false., debuggingParam=.true., do_not_log=(OBC%number_of_segments<2))
746
747 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_SILLY_THICK", OBC%silly_h, &
748 "A silly value of thicknesses used outside of open boundary "//&
749 "conditions for debugging.", units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_Z, &
7500 do_not_log=.not.debugging_tests, debuggingParam=.true.)
751 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_SILLY_VEL", OBC%silly_u, &
752 "A silly value of velocities used outside of open boundary "//&
753 "conditions for debugging.", units="m/s", default=0.0, scale=US%m_s_to_L_T, &
7540 do_not_log=.not.debugging_tests, debuggingParam=.true.)
755 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "ENABLE_BUGS_BY_DEFAULT", enable_bugs, &
7560 default=.true., do_not_log=.true.) ! This is logged from MOM.F90.
757 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "EXTERIOR_OBC_BUG", OBC%exterior_OBC_bug, &
758 "If true, recover a bug in barotropic solver and other routines when "//&
759 "boundary contitions interior to the domain are used.", &
7600 default=enable_bugs)
761 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_HOR_INDEXING_BUG", OBC%hor_index_bug, &
762 "If true, recover set of a horizontal indexing bugs in the OBC code.", &
7630 default=enable_bugs)
764 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_RESERVOIR_INIT_BUG", OBC%reservoir_init_bug, &
765 "If true, set the OBC tracer reservoirs at the startup of a new run from the "//&
766 "interior tracer concentrations regardless of properties that may be explicitly "//&
7670 "specified for the reservoir concentrations.", default=enable_bugs, do_not_log=.true.)
768 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TEMP_SALT_NEEDED_BUG", OBC%ts_needed_bug, &
769 "If true, recover a bug that OBC temperature and salinity can be ignored "//&
7700 "even if they are registered tracers in the rest of the model.", default=enable_bugs)
771 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "IGNORE_DT_OBC_SEG_UPDATE_OBGC", OBC%ignore_dt_obc_bgc, &
772 "If true, DT_OBC_SEG_UPDATE_OBGC is ignored and all OBC segment tracer data "//&
773 "(T/S and BGC) is updated every tracer advection step. If false, T/S is "//&
774 "updated every dynamic step, which is unnecessary, while BGC follows its own "//&
775 "update schedule, which may not reproduce across restarts. Once "//&
776 "DT_OBC_SEG_UPDATE_OBGC is deprecated, only the 'true' path will be needed.", &
7770 default=.false.)
778 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TRACER_DZ_BUG", OBC%tracer_dz_bug, &
779 "If true, recover a bug that OBC tracer segment data is read without "//&
780 "recomputing segment layer thicknesses from the current layer thicknesses "//&
7810 "and thermodynamic state.", default=enable_bugs)
7820 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REENTRANT_X", reentrant_x, default=.true.)
7830 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REENTRANT_Y", reentrant_y, default=.false.)
784
785 ! Allocate everything
7860 allocate(OBC%segment(1:OBC%number_of_segments))
7870 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
7880 OBC%segment(n)%Flather = .false.
7890 OBC%segment(n)%radiation = .false.
7900 OBC%segment(n)%radiation_tan = .false.
7910 OBC%segment(n)%radiation_grad = .false.
7920 OBC%segment(n)%oblique = .false.
7930 OBC%segment(n)%oblique_tan = .false.
7940 OBC%segment(n)%oblique_grad = .false.
7950 OBC%segment(n)%nudged = .false.
7960 OBC%segment(n)%nudged_tan = .false.
7970 OBC%segment(n)%nudged_grad = .false.
7980 OBC%segment(n)%specified = .false.
7990 OBC%segment(n)%specified_tan = .false.
8000 OBC%segment(n)%specified_grad = .false.
8010 OBC%segment(n)%open = .false.
8020 OBC%segment(n)%gradient = .false.
8030 OBC%segment(n)%direction = OBC_NONE
8040 OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S = .false.
8050 OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W = .false.
8060 OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W_2 = .false.
8070 OBC%segment(n)%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in = 0.0
8080 OBC%segment(n)%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out = 0.0
8090 OBC%segment(n)%num_fields = 0
810 enddo
8110 allocate(OBC%segnum_u(G%IsdB:G%IedB,G%jsd:G%jed), source=0)
8120 allocate(OBC%segnum_v(G%isd:G%ied,G%JsdB:G%JedB), source=0)
8130 OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = .false.
8140 OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = .false.
815
8160 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
8170 n_seg = n ; if (OBC%reverse_segment_order) n_seg = OBC%number_of_segments + 1 - n
8180 write(segment_param_str(1:15),"('OBC_SEGMENT_',i3.3)") n
819 call get_param(param_file, mdl, segment_param_str, segment_str, &
820 "Documentation needs to be dynamic?????", &
8210 fail_if_missing=.true.)
8220 segment_str = remove_spaces(segment_str)
8230 if (segment_str(1:2) == 'I=') then
8240 call setup_u_point_obc(OBC, G, US, segment_str, n_seg, n, param_file, reentrant_y)
8250 elseif (segment_str(1:2) == 'J=') then
8260 call setup_v_point_obc(OBC, G, US, segment_str, n_seg, n, param_file, reentrant_x)
827 else
828 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, open_boundary_config: "//&
8290 "Unable to interpret "//segment_param_str//" = "//trim(segment_str))
830 endif
831 enddo
832 ! Set arrays indicating the segment number and segment direction, and also store the
833 ! range of indices within which various orientations of OBCs can be found on this PE.
8340 call set_segnum_signs(OBC, G)
835
836 ! Moved this earlier because time_interp_external_init needs to be called
837 ! before anything that uses time_interp_external (such as initialize_segment_data)
838 if (OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
8390 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally) then
840 ! Need this for ocean_only mode boundary interpolation.
8410 call time_interp_external_init()
842 endif
843 ! if (open_boundary_query(OBC, needs_ext_seg_data=.true.)) &
844 ! call initialize_segment_data(G, OBC, param_file)
845
8460 if (open_boundary_query(OBC, apply_open_OBC=.true.)) then
847 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_RADIATION_MAX", OBC%rx_max, &
848 "The maximum magnitude of the baroclinic radiation velocity (or speed of "//&
849 "characteristics), in gridpoints per timestep. This is only "//&
850 "used if one of the open boundary segments is using Orlanski.", &
8510 units="nondim", default=1.0)
852 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_RAD_VEL_WT", OBC%gamma_uv, &
853 "The relative weighting for the baroclinic radiation "//&
854 "velocities (or speed of characteristics) at the new "//&
855 "time level (1) or the running mean (0) for velocities. "//&
856 "Valid values range from 0 to 1. This is only used if "//&
857 "one of the open boundary segments is using Orlanski.", &
8580 units="nondim", default=0.3)
859 endif
860
8610 if (mask_outside) call mask_outside_OBCs(G, US, param_file, OBC)
862
8630 Lscale_in = 0.
8640 Lscale_out = 0.
8650 if (open_boundary_query(OBC, apply_open_OBC=.true.)) then
866 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TRACER_RESERVOIR_LENGTH_SCALE_OUT", Lscale_out, &
867 "An effective length scale for the tracer reservoir update when the flow "//&
868 "is exiting the domain. If positive, the reservoir relaxes toward the "//&
869 "interior concentration with this length scale. If zero (default), the "//&
870 "length scale is truly zero: the reservoir is set instantly to the "//&
871 "interior concentration on outflow. If negative, the length scale is "//&
872 "effectively infinite: the reservoir is never updated on outflow.", &
8730 units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_L)
874 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TRACER_RESERVOIR_LENGTH_SCALE_IN", Lscale_in, &
875 "An effective length scale for the tracer reservoir update when the flow "//&
876 "is entering the domain. If positive, the reservoir relaxes toward the "//&
877 "external OBC concentration with this length scale. If zero (default), "//&
878 "the length scale is truly zero: the reservoir is set instantly to the "//&
879 "external OBC concentration on inflow. If negative, the length scale is "//&
880 "effectively infinite: the reservoir is never updated on inflow.", &
8810 units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_L)
882 endif
883
884 ! All tracers are using the same restoring length scale for now, but we may want to make this
885 ! tracer-specific in the future for example, in cases where certain tracers are poorly constrained
886 ! by data while others are well constrained - MJH.
887 ! All segments also have the same restoring length scale. Internally, each tracer has
888 ! resrv_lfac_in/out attributes to rescale the length scales. resrv_lfac_in/out is only
889 ! used by BGC tracers at the moment.
8900 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
8910 if (Lscale_in > 0.0) then
8920 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_in = 1.0 / Lscale_in
8930 elseif (Lscale_in < 0.0) then
8940 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_in = 0.0
895 else ! (Lscale_in == 0.0) then
8960 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_in = -1.0 ! A nondim sentinel value
897 endif
8980 if (Lscale_out > 0.0) then
8990 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_out = 1.0 / Lscale_out
9000 elseif (Lscale_out < 0.0) then
9010 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_out = 0.0
902 else ! (Lscale_out == 0.0) then
9030 OBC%segment(n)%Tr_InvLscale_out = -1.0 ! A nondim sentinel value
904 endif
905 enddo
906
9070 Lscale_in = 0.
9080 Lscale_out = 0.
9090 if (open_boundary_query(OBC, apply_open_OBC=.true.)) then
910 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_THICKNESS_RESERVOIR_LENGTH_SCALE_OUT ", Lscale_out, &
911 "An effective length scale for restoring the layer thickness "//&
912 "at the boundaries to externally imposed values when the flow "//&
9130 "is exiting the domain.", units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_L)
914
915 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_THICKNESS_RESERVOIR_LENGTH_SCALE_IN ", Lscale_in, &
916 "An effective length scale for restoring the layer thickness "//&
917 "at the boundaries to values from the interior when the flow "//&
9180 "is entering the domain.", units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_L)
919 endif
920
9210 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
9220 OBC%segment(n)%Th_InvLscale_in = 0.0
9230 if (Lscale_in>0.) OBC%segment(n)%Th_InvLscale_in = 1.0/Lscale_in
9240 OBC%segment(n)%Th_InvLscale_out = 0.0
9250 if (Lscale_out>0.) OBC%segment(n)%Th_InvLscale_out = 1.0/Lscale_out
9260 if (Lscale_in>0. .or. Lscale_out>0.) then
9270 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W_2) then
9280 OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used = .true.
9290 OBC%use_h_res = .true.
930 else
9310 OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used = .true.
9320 OBC%use_h_res = .true.
933 endif
934 endif
935 enddo
936
937 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REMAPPING_SCHEME", OBC%remappingScheme, &
9380 default=remappingDefaultScheme, do_not_log=.true.)
939 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_REMAPPING_SCHEME", OBC%remappingScheme, &
940 "This sets the reconstruction scheme used "//&
941 "for OBC vertical remapping for all variables. "//&
942 "It can be one of the following schemes: \n"//&
9430 trim(remappingSchemesDoc), default=OBC%remappingScheme)
944 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "FATAL_CHECK_RECONSTRUCTIONS", OBC%check_reconstruction, &
945 "If true, cell-by-cell reconstructions are checked for "//&
946 "consistency and if non-monotonicity or an inconsistency is "//&
9470 "detected then a FATAL error is issued.", default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
948 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "FATAL_CHECK_REMAPPING", OBC%check_remapping, &
949 "If true, the results of remapping are checked for "//&
950 "conservation and new extrema and if an inconsistency is "//&
9510 "detected then a FATAL error is issued.", default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
952 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "BRUSHCUTTER_MODE", OBC%brushcutter_mode, &
953 "If true, read external OBC data on the supergrid.", &
9540 default=.false.)
955 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REMAP_BOUND_INTERMEDIATE_VALUES", OBC%force_bounds_in_subcell, &
956 "If true, the values on the intermediate grid used for remapping "//&
957 "are forced to be bounded, which might not be the case due to "//&
9580 "round off.", default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
959 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "DEFAULT_ANSWER_DATE", default_answer_date, &
960 "This sets the default value for the various _ANSWER_DATE parameters.", &
9610 default=99991231)
962 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REMAPPING_ANSWER_DATE", OBC%remap_answer_date, &
963 "The vintage of the expressions and order of arithmetic to use for remapping. "//&
964 "Values below 20190101 result in the use of older, less accurate expressions "//&
965 "that were in use at the end of 2018. Higher values result in the use of more "//&
966 "robust and accurate forms of mathematically equivalent expressions.", &
9670 default=default_answer_date)
968 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "REMAPPING_USE_OM4_SUBCELLS", OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells, &
9690 do_not_log=.true., default=.true.)
970
971 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_REMAPPING_USE_OM4_SUBCELLS", OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells, &
972 "If true, use the OM4 remapping-via-subcells algorithm for neutral diffusion. "//&
973 "See REMAPPING_USE_OM4_SUBCELLS for more details. "//&
9740 "We recommend setting this option to false.", default=OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells)
975
976 ! Safety check
9770 if ((OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally) .and. &
978 .not.G%symmetric ) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
979 "MOM_open_boundary, open_boundary_config: "//&
9800 "Symmetric memory must be used when using Flather OBCs.")
981 ! Need to do this last, because it depends on time_interp_external_init having already been called
9820 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents) then
9830 call initialize_obc_tides(OBC, US, param_file)
984 ! Tide update is done within update_OBC_segment_data, so this should be true if tides are included.
9850 OBC%update_OBC = .true.
986 endif
987
9880 if (.not.(OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
989 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally)) then
990 ! No open boundaries have been requested
9910 call open_boundary_dealloc(OBC)
992 endif
993
9940end subroutine open_boundary_config
995
996!> Setup vertical remapping for open boundaries
9970subroutine open_boundary_setup_vert(GV, US, OBC)
998 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Container for vertical grid information
999 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1000 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1001
1002 ! Local variables
1003 real :: dz_neglect, dz_neglect_edge ! Small thicknesses in vertical height units [Z ~> m]
1004
10050 if (associated(OBC)) then
10060 if (OBC%number_of_segments > 0) then
1007 ! Set up vertical remapping for open boundaries. Remapping happens independently on each PE,
1008 ! so this block could be skipped for PEs without open boundary conditions that use remapping.
10090 if (GV%Boussinesq .and. (OBC%remap_answer_date < 20190101)) then
10100 dz_neglect = US%m_to_Z * 1.0e-30 ; dz_neglect_edge = US%m_to_Z * 1.0e-10
10110 elseif (GV%semi_Boussinesq .and. (OBC%remap_answer_date < 20190101)) then
10120 dz_neglect = GV%kg_m2_to_H*GV%H_to_Z * 1.0e-30 ; dz_neglect_edge = GV%kg_m2_to_H*GV%H_to_Z * 1.0e-10
1013 else
10140 dz_neglect = GV%dZ_subroundoff ; dz_neglect_edge = GV%dZ_subroundoff
1015 endif
10160 allocate(OBC%remap_z_CS)
1017 call initialize_remapping(OBC%remap_z_CS, OBC%remappingScheme, boundary_extrapolation=.false., &
1018 check_reconstruction=OBC%check_reconstruction, check_remapping=OBC%check_remapping, &
1019 om4_remap_via_sub_cells=OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells, &
1020 force_bounds_in_subcell=OBC%force_bounds_in_subcell, answer_date=OBC%remap_answer_date, &
10210 h_neglect=dz_neglect, h_neglect_edge=dz_neglect_edge)
10220 allocate(OBC%remap_h_CS)
1023 call initialize_remapping(OBC%remap_h_CS, OBC%remappingScheme, boundary_extrapolation=.false., &
1024 check_reconstruction=OBC%check_reconstruction, check_remapping=OBC%check_remapping, &
1025 om4_remap_via_sub_cells=OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells, &
1026 force_bounds_in_subcell=OBC%force_bounds_in_subcell, answer_date=OBC%remap_answer_date, &
10270 h_neglect=GV%H_subroundoff, h_neglect_edge=GV%H_subroundoff)
1028 endif
1029 endif
1030
10310end subroutine open_boundary_setup_vert
1032
1033!> Determine which physical fields are required for this segment based on boundary-condition type
1034!! and segment orientation. Also enable groups of physical fields required by tides or thermodynamics.
1035!! Note the tidal group could be further narrowed based on modes.
10360subroutine segment_determine_required_fields(segment, tides, temp_salt)
1037 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< OBC segment
1038 logical, optional, intent(in) :: tides !< Switch for tidal variables
1039 logical, optional, intent(in) :: temp_salt !< Switch for thermodynamic variables
1040
1041 ! Local variables
1042 logical :: use_tide ! Local switch for tidal variables
1043 logical :: use_temp ! Local switch for thermodynamic variables
1044 integer :: m
1045 integer :: F_Vn, F_Vt, F_G
1046 integer, parameter :: &
1047 tide_idx(6) = (/ F_UAMP, F_UPHASE, F_VAMP, F_VPHASE, F_ZAMP, F_ZPHASE /), & ! Indices for tides
1048 temp_idx(2) = (/ F_T, F_S /) ! Indices for thermodynamics
1049
10500 if (.not. associated(segment%field)) &
10510 call MOM_error(FATAL, 'segment_determine_required_fields: segment%field is not allocated.')
1052
10530 use_tide = .false. ; if (present(tides)) use_tide = tides
10540 use_temp = .false. ; if (present(temp_salt)) use_temp = temp_salt
1055
1056 ! Normal, tangential and gradient depend on segment orientation.
10570 if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) then
10580 F_Vn = F_U ; F_Vt = F_V ; F_G = F_VX
1059 else
10600 F_Vn = F_V ; F_Vt = F_U ; F_G = F_UY
1061 endif
10620 if (segment%Flather) &
10630 segment%field(F_Z)%required = .true.
1064
10650 if (segment%Flather .or. segment%nudged .or. segment%specified) &
10660 segment%field(F_Vn)%required = .true.
1067
10680 if (segment%nudged_tan .or. segment%specified_tan) &
10690 segment%field(F_Vt)%required = .true.
1070
10710 if (segment%nudged_grad .or. segment%specified_grad) &
10720 segment%field(F_G)%required = .true.
1073
10740 if (use_tide) then ; do m = 1, size(tide_idx)
10750 segment%field(tide_idx(m))%required = .true.
1076 enddo ; endif
1077
10780 if (use_temp) then ; do m = 1, size(temp_idx)
10790 segment%field(temp_idx(m))%required = .true.
1080 enddo ; endif
1081
10820end subroutine segment_determine_required_fields
1083
1084!> Find physical field index from name
10850integer function find_phys_field_index(name)
1086 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< Field name
1087
1088 ! Local variables
1089 integer :: i
1090
10910 find_phys_field_index = 0
10920 do i = 1, NUM_PHYS_FIELDS ; if (trim(name) == PHYS_FIELD_NAMES(i)) then
10930 find_phys_field_index = i
10940 return
1095 endif ; enddo
10960end function find_phys_field_index
1097
1098!> Set global flag OBC%any_needs_IO_for_data.
10990subroutine OBC_any_IO(OBC)
1100 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1101
1102 ! Local variables
1103 integer :: m, n
1104 logical :: use_IO
1105
11060 use_IO = .false.
11070 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
11080 do m=1,OBC%segment(n)%num_fields
11090 if (OBC%segment(n)%field(m)%use_IO) then
11100 use_IO = .true.
11110 exit
1112 endif
1113 enddo
11140 if (use_IO) exit
1115 enddo
1116
11170 OBC%any_needs_IO_for_data = any_across_PEs(use_IO)
11180end subroutine OBC_any_IO
1119
1120!> Allocate data (buffer_src, buffer_dst and dz_src) for a field at an OBC segment.
11210subroutine allocate_segment_field_data(field, OBC, segment, US, inputdir, filename, varname, &
1122 suffix, value, turns, nz)
1123 type(OBC_segment_data_type), &
1124 intent(inout) :: field !< A field of the segment
1125 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(in) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1126 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< Segment to work on
1127 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1128 character(len=*), intent(in) :: inputdir !< The directory of input files
1129 character(len=*), intent(in) :: filename !< Input file name
1130 character(len=*), intent(in) :: varname !< Variable name in the input file
1131 character(len=*), intent(in) :: suffix !< Variable name suffix, "_segment_xxx"
1132 real, intent(in) :: value !< Unscaled specified value of the field [a]
1133 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns of the grid
1134 integer, intent(in) :: nz !< Default k-axis size in buffer_dst
1135
1136 ! Local variables
1137 character(len=256) :: full_filename, full_varname ! Full filename and varname
1138 character(len=512) :: mesg ! Error message
1139 real :: init_value_dst ! Initial value for allocated buffer_dst array [a]
1140 integer :: qturns ! The number of quarter turns in the range of 0 to 3
1141 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB ! Aliases of segment geometry indices
1142 integer, dimension(4) :: siz, siz_check ! Four-dimensional shape of a variable in input file
1143 integer :: dim ! Loop index for siz/siz_check
1144 integer :: nk_dst ! k-axis size of buffer_dst
1145
11460 if (.not. segment%on_pe) return
1147
11480 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied ; IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
11490 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed ; JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
11500 nk_dst = nz
1151
11520 qturns = modulo(turns, 4)
1153
11540 field%on_face = field_is_on_face(field%name, segment%is_E_or_W)
1155 ! The scale factor for tracers may also be set in register_segment_tracer, and a constant input
1156 ! value is rescaled there.
11570 field%scale = scale_factor_from_name(field%name, US, segment%tr_Reg)
11580 field%use_IO = (trim(filename) /= 'none')
1159
11600 if (field%use_IO) then
11610 full_filename = trim(inputdir) // trim(filename)
11620 full_varname = trim(varname) // trim(suffix)
1163
11640 if (.not.file_exists(full_filename)) &
11650 call MOM_error(FATAL," Unable to open OBC file " // trim(full_filename))
1166
11670 call field_size(full_filename, full_varname, siz, no_domain=.true.)
11680 field%nk_src = siz(3)
1169
11700 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode .and. (modulo(siz(1),2) == 0 .or. modulo(siz(2),2) == 0)) then
11710 write(mesg, '("Brushcutter mode sizes ",I0," ",I0)') siz(1), siz(2)
11720 call MOM_error(WARNING, mesg // " " // trim(full_filename) // " " // trim(full_varname))
11730 call MOM_error(FATAL,'segment data are not on the supergrid')
1174 endif
1175
1176 ! Allocate src array
11770 if (.not.field%on_face) then
11780 allocate(field%buffer_src(IsdB:IedB, JsdB:JedB, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
11790 elseif (segment%is_E_or_W) then
11800 allocate(field%buffer_src(IsdB:IedB, jsd:jed, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
1181 else
11820 allocate(field%buffer_src(isd:ied, JsdB:JedB, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
1183 endif
1184
1185 field%handle = init_external_field(trim(full_filename), trim(full_varname), &
11860 ignore_axis_atts=.true., threading=SINGLE_FILE)
1187
11880 if ((field%nk_src > 1) .and. (.not. field_is_tidal(field%name))) then ! nk_src is depth
11890 full_varname = 'dz_' // trim(full_varname)
11900 call field_size(full_filename, full_varname, siz_check, no_domain=.true.)
11910 do dim = 1, 4 ; if (siz(dim) /= siz_check(dim)) &
1192 call MOM_error(FATAL, "'dz' field size is inconsistent with "//&
11930 "its corresponding variable.")
1194 enddo
1195
11960 if (.not.field%on_face) then
11970 allocate(field%dz_src(IsdB:IedB, JsdB:JedB, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
11980 elseif (segment%is_E_or_W) then
11990 allocate(field%dz_src(IsdB:IedB, jsd:jed, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
1200 else
12010 allocate(field%dz_src(isd:ied, JsdB:JedB, field%nk_src), source=0.0)
1202 endif
1203 field%dz_handle = init_external_field(trim(full_filename), trim(full_varname), &
12040 ignore_axis_atts=.true., threading=SINGLE_FILE)
1205
12060 elseif (field_is_tidal(field%name)) then ! nk_src is constituent for tidal variables
1207 ! expect third dimension to be number of constituents in MOM_input
12080 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents .and. (field%nk_src /= OBC%n_tide_constituents)) &
1209 call MOM_error(FATAL, 'Number of constituents in input data is not '//&
12100 'the same as the number specified')
12110 nk_dst = field%nk_src
1212
1213 else ! nk_src = 1
12140 nk_dst = 1
1215
1216 endif
1217
12180 init_value_dst = 0.0
1219 else ! This data is not being read from a file.
12200 field%value = field%scale * value
1221 ! Change the sign of the specified velocities, depending on the number of quarter turns of the grid.
1222 if ( ( ((field%name == 'U') .or. (field%name == 'Uamp')) .and. &
12230 ((qturns == 1) .or. (qturns == 2)) ) .or. &
1224 ( ((field%name == 'V') .or. (field%name == 'Vamp')) .and. &
1225 ((qturns == 3) .or. (qturns == 2)) ) ) &
12260 field%value = -field%value
1227
1228 ! Check if this is a tidal field. If so, the number of expected constituents must be 1.
12290 if (field_is_tidal(field%name)) then
12300 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents .and. (OBC%n_tide_constituents > 1)) &
1231 call MOM_error(FATAL, 'Only one constituent is supported when specifying '//&
12320 'tidal boundary conditions by value rather than file.')
12330 nk_dst = 1
1234 endif
1235
12360 if (field%name == 'SSH') &
12370 nk_dst = 1
1238
12390 init_value_dst = field%value
1240 endif
1241
1242 ! Allocate buffer_dst array
12430 if (.not.field%on_face) then
12440 allocate(field%buffer_dst(IsdB:IedB, JsdB:JedB, nk_dst), source=init_value_dst)
12450 elseif (segment%is_E_or_W) then
12460 allocate(field%buffer_dst(IsdB:IedB, jsd:jed, nk_dst), source=init_value_dst)
1247 else
12480 allocate(field%buffer_dst(isd:ied, JsdB:JedB, nk_dst), source=init_value_dst)
1249 endif
12500end subroutine allocate_segment_field_data
1251
1252!> Get and store properties about the fields on the OBC segments and allocate space for reading
1253!! OBC data from files. In the process, it does funky stuff with the MPI processes.
12540subroutine initialize_segment_data(GV, US, OBC, PF, turns, use_temperature)
1255 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Container for vertical grid information
1256 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1257 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1258 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: PF !< Parameter file handle
1259 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns of the grid
1260 logical, intent(in) :: use_temperature !< If true, temperature and
1261 !! salinity used as state variables.
1262
1263 ! Local variables
1264 integer :: n, n_seg, m, num_manifest_fields, mm
1265 character(len=1024) :: segstr
1266 character(len=256) :: filename
1267 character(len=20) :: segname, suffix
1268 character(len=32) :: varname
1269 real :: value ! A value that is parsed from the segment data string [various units]
1270 character(len=32), dimension(NUM_PHYS_FIELDS) :: phys_inputs ! input physical field names
1271 integer, dimension(NUM_PHYS_FIELDS) :: phys_idx ! input physical field indices to PHYS_FIELD_NAMES
1272 character(len=32) :: bgc_input ! segment field names
1273 character(len=128) :: inputdir
1274 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
1275 character(len=256) :: mesg ! Message for error messages.
12760 integer, dimension(:), allocatable :: saved_pelist
1277 integer :: current_pe
1278 integer, dimension(1) :: single_pelist
1279 type(external_tracers_segments_props), pointer :: obgc_segments_props_list =>NULL()
1280 logical :: check_ts_needed ! Check if temperature and salinity are explicitly specified.
1281 integer :: idx
1282 character(len=256) :: routine_name ! Name of this subroutine
1283
12840 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) return
1285
12860 routine_name = trim(mdl) // ', initialize_segment_data'
1287
12880 OBC%update_OBC = .true. ! Data is time-dependent if not using user BC.
1289
12900 check_ts_needed = use_temperature .and. (.not. OBC%ts_needed_bug)
1291
12920 call get_param(PF, mdl, "INPUTDIR", inputdir, default=".")
12930 inputdir = slasher(inputdir)
1294
1295 ! Try this here just for the documentation. It is repeated below.
12960 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
12970 write(segname, "('OBC_SEGMENT_',i3.3,'_DATA')") n
12980 call get_param(PF, mdl, segname, segstr, 'OBC segment docs')
1299 enddo
1300
1301 !< temporarily disable communication in order to read segment data independently
1302
13030 allocate(saved_pelist(0:num_PEs()-1))
13040 call Get_PElist(saved_pelist)
13050 current_pe = PE_here()
13060 single_pelist(1) = current_pe
13070 call Set_PElist(single_pelist)
1308
13090 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
13100 n_seg = n ; if (OBC%reverse_segment_order) n_seg = OBC%number_of_segments + 1 - n
13110 segment => OBC%segment(n_seg)
1312
13130 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
1314
13150 write(segname, "('OBC_SEGMENT_',i3.3,'_DATA')") n
13160 write(suffix, "('_segment_',i3.3)") n
1317 ! needs documentation !! Yet, unsafe for now, causes grief for
1318 ! MOM_parameter_docs in circle_obcs on two processes.
1319 ! call get_param(PF, mdl, segname, segstr, 'xyz')
1320 ! Clear out any old values
13210 segstr = ''
13220 call get_param(PF, mdl, segname, segstr)
13230 if (segstr == '') then
13240 write(mesg,'("No OBC_SEGMENT_XXX_DATA string for OBC segment ",I0)') n
13250 call MOM_error(FATAL, mesg)
1326 endif
1327
13280 segment%num_fields = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS + OBC%num_obgc_tracers
13290 allocate(segment%field(segment%num_fields))
1330
1331 ! Initialize physical fields
13320 do m = 1, NUM_PHYS_FIELDS
13330 segment%field(m)%name = PHYS_FIELD_NAMES(m) ! The order of physical fields is fixed.
13340 segment%field(m)%bgc_tracer = .false.
13350 segment%field(m)%required = .false.
13360 segment%field(m)%use_IO = .false.
13370 segment%field(m)%tr_index = -1
1338 enddo
13390 segment%field(F_T)%tr_index = 1 ! Temperature tracer index is hard-coded.
13400 segment%field(F_S)%tr_index = 2 ! Salinity tracer index is hard-coded.
1341
1342 call segment_determine_required_fields(segment, tides=OBC%add_tide_constituents, &
13430 temp_salt=check_ts_needed)
1344
1345 ! Parse and find available physical fields
13460 call parse_segment_manifest_str(trim(segstr), num_manifest_fields, phys_inputs)
1347
13480 phys_idx(:) = -1
13490 do m = 1, num_manifest_fields
13500 idx = find_phys_field_index(rotated_field_name(trim(phys_inputs(m)), turns))
13510 if (idx == 0) then
13520 write(mesg,'("OBC segment ",I0," has an unknown input field: ",a)') n, trim(phys_inputs(m))
13530 call MOM_error(FATAL, trim(routine_name) // ", " // trim(mesg))
1354 endif
13550 if ((.not. segment%field(idx)%required) .and. &
1356 ((.not. (idx == F_T .or. idx == F_S)) .or. check_ts_needed)) then
1357 write(mesg,'("OBC segment ",I0," has an unnecessary field: ",a)') &
13580 n, trim(phys_inputs(m))
13590 call MOM_error(WARNING, trim(mesg))
1360 ! Unnecessary field is allowed and allocated for now.
1361 ! Otherwise, the next line can be uncommented.
1362 ! cycle
1363 endif
13640 phys_idx(idx) = m
1365 enddo
1366
1367 ! Allocate physical fields
13680 do m = 1, NUM_PHYS_FIELDS
13690 if (segment%field(m)%required .and. (phys_idx(m) < 0)) then
13700 write(mesg,'("OBC segment ",I0," requires field: ",a)') n, trim(segment%field(m)%name)
13710 call MOM_error(FATAL, trim(routine_name) // ", " // trim(mesg))
1372 endif
13730 if ((phys_idx(m) > 0)) then ! Field is found in input, even if not required
1374 call parse_segment_data_str(trim(segstr), phys_idx(m), trim(phys_inputs(phys_idx(m))), &
13750 value, filename, varname)
1376 call allocate_segment_field_data(segment%field(m), OBC, segment, US, &
13770 inputdir, filename, varname, suffix, value, turns, GV%ke)
1378 endif
1379 enddo
1380
1381 ! Allocate BGC tracer fields
13820 obgc_segments_props_list => OBC%obgc_segments_props ! pointer to the head node
13830 do m = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS+1, segment%num_fields
13840 segment%field(m)%bgc_tracer = .true.
1385 ! Query the obgc segment properties by traversing the linked list
1386 call get_obgc_segments_props(obgc_segments_props_list, bgc_input, filename, varname, &
13870 segment%field(m)%resrv_lfac_in, segment%field(m)%resrv_lfac_out)
1388 ! Make sure the obgc tracer is not specified in the MOM6 param file too.
13890 do mm=1,num_manifest_fields ; if (trim(bgc_input) == trim(phys_inputs(mm))) then
1390 write(mesg,'("Input parameter for OBC segment ",I0," contains a BGC tracer: ", A)') &
13910 n, trim(bgc_input)
13920 call MOM_error(FATAL, trim(routine_name) // ", " // trim(mesg))
1393 endif ; enddo
13940 segment%field(m)%name = rotated_field_name(bgc_input, turns)
13950 segment%field(m)%tr_index = get_tracer_index(segment, trim(segment%field(m)%name))
1396 call allocate_segment_field_data(segment%field(m), OBC, segment, US, &
13970 inputdir, filename, varname, suffix, 0.0, turns, GV%ke)
1398 enddo
1399
1400 ! write(stderr, '(A)') trim(suffix)//" segment checksum"
14010 if (OBC%debug) call chksum_OBC_segment_data(OBC%segment(n_seg), GV, US, OBC%nk_OBC_debug, n)
1402
1403 enddo ! n-loop for segments
1404
14050 call Set_PElist(saved_pelist)
1406
1407 ! Determine global IO data requirement patterns.
14080 call OBC_any_IO(OBC)
14090end subroutine initialize_segment_data
1410
1411!> Determine whether a particular field is descretized at the normal-velocity faces of an open
1412!! boundary condition segment.
14130logical function field_is_on_face(name, is_E_or_W)
1414 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< The OBC segment data name to interpret
1415 logical, intent(in) :: is_E_or_W !< This is true for an eastern or western open boundary condition
1416
14170 field_is_on_face = .true.
14180 if (is_E_or_W) then
14190 if ((name == 'V') .or. (name == 'Vamp') .or. (name == 'Vphase') .or. (name == 'DVDX')) &
14200 field_is_on_face = .false.
1421 else
14220 if ((name == 'U') .or. (name == 'Uamp') .or. (name == 'Uphase') .or. (name == 'DUDY')) &
14230 field_is_on_face = .false.
1424 endif
14250end function field_is_on_face
1426
1427!> Determine based on its name whether a particular field a barotropic tidal field, for which the
1428!! third dimension is the tidal constituent rather than a vertical axis
14290logical function field_is_tidal(name)
1430 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< The OBC segment data name to interpret
1431
14320 field_is_tidal = ((index(name, 'phase') > 0) .or. (index(name, 'amp') > 0))
14330end function field_is_tidal
1434
1435!> This subroutine sets the sign of the OBC%segnum_u and OBC%segnum_v arrays to indicate the
1436!! direction of the faces - positive for logically eastern or northern OBCs and neagative
1437!! for logically western or southern OBCs, or zero on non-OBC points. Also store information
1438!! about which orientations of OBCs ar on this PE and the range of indices within which the
1439!! various orientations of OBCs can be found on this PE.
14400subroutine set_segnum_signs(OBC, G)
1441 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure, perhaps on a rotated grid.
1442 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure used by OBC
1443
1444 integer :: i, j
1445
14460 OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = .false. ; OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = .false.
14470 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do I=G%IsdB,G%IedB
14480 OBC%segnum_u(I,j) = abs(OBC%segnum_u(I,j))
14490 if (abs(OBC%segnum_u(I,j)) > 0) then
14500 OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
14510 if (OBC%segment(abs(OBC%segnum_u(I,j)))%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) &
14520 OBC%segnum_u(I,j) = -abs(OBC%segnum_u(I,j))
1453 endif
1454 enddo ; enddo
14550 do J=G%JsdB,G%JedB ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
14560 OBC%segnum_v(i,J) = abs(OBC%segnum_v(i,J))
14570 if (abs(OBC%segnum_v(i,J)) > 0) then
14580 OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
14590 if (OBC%segment(abs(OBC%segnum_v(i,J)))%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) &
14600 OBC%segnum_v(i,J) = -abs(OBC%segnum_v(i,J))
1461 endif
1462 enddo ; enddo
1463
1464 ! Determine the maximum and minimum index range for various directions of OBC points on this PE
1465 ! by first setting these one point outside of the wrong side of the domain.
14660 OBC%Is_u_W_obc = G%IedB + 1 ; OBC%Ie_u_W_obc = G%IsdB - 1
14670 OBC%js_u_W_obc = G%jed + 1 ; OBC%je_u_W_obc = G%jsd - 1
14680 OBC%Is_u_E_obc = G%IedB + 1 ; OBC%Ie_u_E_obc = G%IsdB - 1
14690 OBC%js_u_E_obc = G%jed + 1 ; OBC%je_u_E_obc = G%jsd - 1
14700 OBC%is_v_S_obc = G%ied + 1 ; OBC%ie_v_S_obc = G%isd - 1
14710 OBC%Js_v_S_obc = G%JedB + 1 ; OBC%Je_v_S_obc = G%JsdB - 1
14720 OBC%is_v_N_obc = G%ied + 1 ; OBC%ie_v_N_obc = G%isd - 1
14730 OBC%Js_v_N_obc = G%JedB + 1 ; OBC%Je_v_N_obc = G%JsdB - 1
14740 OBC%v_N_OBCs_on_PE = .false. ; OBC%v_S_OBCs_on_PE = .false.
14750 OBC%u_E_OBCs_on_PE = .false. ; OBC%u_W_OBCs_on_PE = .false.
1476 ! Note that the loop ranges are reduced because outward facing OBCs can not be applied at edge points.
14770 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do I=G%IsdB,G%IedB-1
14780 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) < 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_W.
14790 OBC%Is_u_W_obc = min(I, OBC%Is_u_W_obc) ; OBC%Ie_u_W_obc = max(I, OBC%Ie_u_W_obc)
14800 OBC%js_u_W_obc = min(j, OBC%js_u_W_obc) ; OBC%je_u_W_obc = max(j, OBC%je_u_W_obc)
14810 OBC%u_W_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
1482 endif
1483 enddo ; enddo
14840 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do I=G%IsdB+1,G%IedB
14850 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) > 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_E.
14860 OBC%Is_u_E_obc = min(I, OBC%Is_u_E_obc) ; OBC%Ie_u_E_obc = max(I, OBC%Ie_u_E_obc)
14870 OBC%js_u_E_obc = min(j, OBC%js_u_E_obc) ; OBC%je_u_E_obc = max(j, OBC%je_u_E_obc)
14880 OBC%u_E_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
1489 endif
1490 enddo ; enddo
14910 do J=G%JsdB,G%JedB-1 ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
14920 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) < 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_S.
14930 OBC%is_v_S_obc = min(i, OBC%is_v_S_obc) ; OBC%ie_v_S_obc = max(i, OBC%ie_v_S_obc)
14940 OBC%Js_v_S_obc = min(J, OBC%Js_v_S_obc) ; OBC%Je_v_S_obc = max(J, OBC%Je_v_S_obc)
14950 OBC%v_S_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
1496 endif
1497 enddo ; enddo
14980 do J=G%JsdB+1,G%JedB ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
14990 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) > 0) then ! This point has OBC_DIRECTION_N.
15000 OBC%is_v_N_obc = min(i, OBC%is_v_N_obc) ; OBC%ie_v_N_obc = max(i, OBC%ie_v_N_obc)
15010 OBC%Js_v_N_obc = min(J, OBC%Js_v_N_obc) ; OBC%Je_v_N_obc = max(J, OBC%Je_v_N_obc)
15020 OBC%v_N_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
1503 endif
1504 enddo ; enddo
1505
15060end subroutine set_segnum_signs
1507
1508!> Return an appropriate dimensional scaling factor for input data based on an OBC segment data
1509!! name [various ~> 1], or 1 for tracers or other fields that do not match one of the specified names.
1510!! Note that calls to register_segment_tracer can come before or after calls to scale_factor_from_name.
1511
15120real function scale_factor_from_name(name, US, Tr_Reg)
1513 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< The OBC segment data name to interpret
1514 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1515 type(segment_tracer_registry_type), pointer :: Tr_Reg !< pointer to tracer registry for this segment
1516
1517 integer :: m
1518
15190 select case (trim(name))
15200 case ('U') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_s_to_L_T
15210 case ('V') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_s_to_L_T
15220 case ('Uamp') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_s_to_L_T
15230 case ('Vamp') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_s_to_L_T
15240 case ('DVDX') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%T_to_s
15250 case ('DUDY') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%T_to_s
15260 case ('SSH') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_to_Z
15270 case ('SSHamp') ; scale_factor_from_name = US%m_to_Z
15280 case default ; scale_factor_from_name = 1.0
1529 end select
1530
15310 if (associated(Tr_Reg) .and. (scale_factor_from_name == 1.0)) then
1532 ! Check for name matches with previously registered tracers.
15330 do m=1,Tr_Reg%ntseg
15340 if (uppercase(name) == uppercase(Tr_Reg%Tr(m)%name)) then
15350 scale_factor_from_name = Tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
15360 exit
1537 endif
1538 enddo
1539 endif
1540
15410end function scale_factor_from_name
1542
1543!> Initize parameters and fields related to the specification of tides at open boundaries.
15440subroutine initialize_obc_tides(OBC, US, param_file)
1545 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1546 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1547 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< Parameter file handle
1548 integer, dimension(3) :: tide_ref_date !< Reference date (t = 0) for tidal forcing (year, month, day).
1549 integer, dimension(3) :: nodal_ref_date !< Date to calculate nodal modulation for (year, month, day).
1550 character(len=50) :: tide_constituent_str !< List of tidal constituents to include on boundary.
1551 type(astro_longitudes) :: nodal_longitudes !< Solar and lunar longitudes for tidal forcing
1552 type(time_type) :: nodal_time !< Model time to calculate nodal modulation for.
1553 integer :: c !< Index to tidal constituent.
1554 logical :: tides !< True if astronomical tides are also used.
1555
1556 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "OBC_TIDE_CONSTITUENTS", tide_constituent_str, &
1557 "Names of tidal constituents being added to the open boundaries.", &
15580 fail_if_missing=.true.)
1559
1560 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDES", tides, &
15610 "If true, apply tidal momentum forcing.", default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
1562
1563 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDE_USE_EQ_PHASE", OBC%add_eq_phase, &
1564 "If true, add the equilibrium phase argument to the specified tidal phases.", &
15650 old_name="OBC_TIDE_ADD_EQ_PHASE", default=.false., do_not_log=tides)
1566
1567 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDE_ADD_NODAL", OBC%add_nodal_terms, &
1568 "If true, include 18.6 year nodal modulation in the boundary tidal forcing.", &
15690 old_name="OBC_TIDE_ADD_NODAL", default=.false., do_not_log=tides)
1570
1571 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDE_REF_DATE", tide_ref_date, &
1572 "Reference date to use for tidal calculations and equilibrium phase.", &
15730 old_name="OBC_TIDE_REF_DATE", defaults=(/0, 0, 0/), do_not_log=tides)
1574
1575 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDE_NODAL_REF_DATE", nodal_ref_date, &
1576 "Fixed reference date to use for nodal modulation of boundary tides.", &
15770 old_name="OBC_TIDE_NODAL_REF_DATE", defaults=(/0, 0, 0/), do_not_log=tides)
1578
15790 allocate(OBC%tide_names(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
15800 read(tide_constituent_str, *) OBC%tide_names
1581
1582 ! Set reference time (t = 0) for boundary tidal forcing.
15830 if (sum(tide_ref_date) == 0) then ! tide_ref_date defaults to 0.
15840 OBC%time_ref = set_date(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
1585 else
15860 if (.not. OBC%add_eq_phase) then
1587 ! If equilibrium phase argument is not added, the input phases
1588 ! should already be relative to the reference time.
15890 call MOM_mesg('OBC tidal phases will *not* be corrected with equilibrium arguments.')
1590 endif
15910 OBC%time_ref = set_date(tide_ref_date(1), tide_ref_date(2), tide_ref_date(3), 0, 0, 0)
1592 endif
1593
1594 ! Find relevant lunar and solar longitudes at the reference time
15950 if (OBC%add_eq_phase) call astro_longitudes_init(OBC%time_ref, OBC%tidal_longitudes)
1596
1597 ! If the nodal correction is based on a different time, initialize that.
1598 ! Otherwise, it can use N from the time reference.
15990 if (OBC%add_nodal_terms) then
16000 if (sum(nodal_ref_date) /= 0) then
1601 ! A reference date was provided for the nodal correction
16020 nodal_time = set_date(nodal_ref_date(1), nodal_ref_date(2), nodal_ref_date(3), 0, 0, 0)
16030 call astro_longitudes_init(nodal_time, nodal_longitudes)
16040 elseif (OBC%add_eq_phase) then
1605 ! Astronomical longitudes were already calculated for use in equilibrium phases,
1606 ! so use nodal longitude from that.
16070 nodal_longitudes = OBC%tidal_longitudes
1608 else
1609 ! Tidal reference time is a required parameter, so calculate the longitudes from that.
16100 call astro_longitudes_init(OBC%time_ref, nodal_longitudes)
1611 endif
1612 endif
1613
16140 allocate(OBC%tide_frequencies(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
16150 allocate(OBC%tide_eq_phases(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
16160 allocate(OBC%tide_fn(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
16170 allocate(OBC%tide_un(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
1618
16190 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents
1620 ! If tidal frequency is overridden by setting TIDE_*_FREQ, use that, otherwise use the
1621 ! default realistic frequency for this constituent.
1622 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "TIDE_"//trim(OBC%tide_names(c))//"_FREQ", OBC%tide_frequencies(c), &
1623 "Frequency of the "//trim(OBC%tide_names(c))//" tidal constituent. "//&
1624 "This is only used if TIDES and TIDE_"//trim(OBC%tide_names(c))// &
1625 " are true, or if OBC_TIDE_N_CONSTITUENTS > 0 and "//trim(OBC%tide_names(c))//&
1626 " is in OBC_TIDE_CONSTITUENTS.", &
16270 units="rad s-1", default=tidal_frequency(trim(OBC%tide_names(c))), scale=US%T_to_s)
1628
1629 ! Find equilibrium phase if needed
16300 if (OBC%add_eq_phase) then
16310 OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) = eq_phase(trim(OBC%tide_names(c)), OBC%tidal_longitudes)
1632 else
16330 OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) = 0.0
1634 endif
1635
1636 ! Find nodal corrections if needed
16370 if (OBC%add_nodal_terms) then
16380 call nodal_fu(trim(OBC%tide_names(c)), nodal_longitudes%N, OBC%tide_fn(c), OBC%tide_un(c))
1639 else
16400 OBC%tide_fn(c) = 1.0
16410 OBC%tide_un(c) = 0.0
1642 endif
1643 enddo
16440end subroutine initialize_obc_tides
1645
1646!> Define indices for segment and store in hor_index_type
1647!! using global segment bounds corresponding to q-points
16480subroutine setup_segment_indices(G, seg, Is_obc, Ie_obc, Js_obc, Je_obc)
1649 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< grid type
1650 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: seg !< Open boundary segment
1651 integer, intent(in) :: Is_obc !< Q-point global i-index of start of segment
1652 integer, intent(in) :: Ie_obc !< Q-point global i-index of end of segment
1653 integer, intent(in) :: Js_obc !< Q-point global j-index of start of segment
1654 integer, intent(in) :: Je_obc !< Q-point global j-index of end of segment
1655 ! Local variables
1656 integer :: IsgB, IegB, JsgB, JegB ! Global corner point indices at the ends of the OBC segments
1657 integer :: isg, ieg, jsg, jeg
1658
1659 ! Isg, Ieg will be I*_obc in global space
16600 if (Ie_obc < Is_obc) then
16610 IsgB = Ie_obc
16620 IegB = Is_obc
1663 else
16640 IsgB = Is_obc
16650 IegB = Ie_obc
1666 endif
1667
16680 if (Je_obc < Js_obc) then
16690 JsgB = Je_obc
16700 JegB = Js_obc
1671 else
16720 JsgB = Js_obc
16730 JegB = Je_obc
1674 endif
1675
1676 ! NOTE: h-points are defined along the interior of the segment q-points.
1677 ! For a given segment and its start and end index pairs, [IJ][se]gB, the
1678 ! h-cell corresponding to this pair are shown in the figure below.
1679 !
1680 ! x-x----------------x-x
1681 ! | | N | |
1682 ! x-x W E x-x
1683 ! | S |
1684 ! x-x----------------x-x
1685 ! | | | |
1686 ! x-x x-x
1687 !
1688 ! For segment points on the west and south, h-point indices are incremented
1689 ! in order to move to the interior cell.
1690
16910 if (Is_obc > Ie_obc) then
1692 ! Northern boundary
16930 isg = IsgB + 1
16940 jsg = JsgB
16950 ieg = IegB
16960 jeg = JegB
1697 endif
1698
16990 if (Is_obc < Ie_obc) then
1700 ! Southern boundary
17010 isg = IsgB + 1
17020 jsg = JsgB + 1
17030 ieg = IegB
17040 jeg = JegB + 1
1705 endif
1706
17070 if (Js_obc < Je_obc) then
1708 ! Eastern boundary
17090 isg = IsgB
17100 jsg = JsgB + 1
17110 ieg = IegB
17120 jeg = JegB
1713 endif
1714
17150 if (Js_obc > Je_obc) then
1716 ! Western boundary
17170 isg = IsgB + 1
17180 jsg = JsgB + 1
17190 ieg = IegB + 1
17200 jeg = JegB
1721 endif
1722
1723 ! Global space I*_obc but sorted
17240 seg%HI%IsgB = IsgB
17250 seg%HI%JegB = JegB
17260 seg%HI%IegB = IegB
17270 seg%HI%JsgB = JsgB
1728
17290 seg%HI%isg = isg
17300 seg%HI%jsg = jsg
17310 seg%HI%ieg = ieg
17320 seg%HI%jeg = jeg
1733
1734 ! Move into local index space
17350 IsgB = IsgB - G%idg_offset
17360 JsgB = JsgB - G%jdg_offset
17370 IegB = IegB - G%idg_offset
17380 JegB = JegB - G%jdg_offset
1739
17400 isg = isg - G%idg_offset
17410 jsg = jsg - G%jdg_offset
17420 ieg = ieg - G%idg_offset
17430 jeg = jeg - G%jdg_offset
1744
1745 ! This is the i-extent of the segment on this PE.
1746 ! The values are nonsense if the segment is not on this PE.
17470 seg%HI%IsdB = min(max(IsgB, G%HI%IsdB), G%HI%IedB)
17480 seg%HI%IedB = min(max(IegB, G%HI%IsdB), G%HI%IedB)
17490 seg%HI%isd = min(max(isg, G%HI%isd), G%HI%ied)
17500 seg%HI%ied = min(max(ieg, G%HI%isd), G%HI%ied)
17510 seg%HI%IscB = min(max(IsgB, G%HI%IscB), G%HI%IecB)
17520 seg%HI%IecB = min(max(IegB, G%HI%IscB), G%HI%IecB)
17530 seg%HI%isc = min(max(isg, G%HI%isc), G%HI%iec)
17540 seg%HI%iec = min(max(ieg, G%HI%isc), G%HI%iec)
1755
1756 ! This is the j-extent of the segment on this PE.
1757 ! The values are nonsense if the segment is not on this PE.
17580 seg%HI%JsdB = min(max(JsgB, G%HI%JsdB), G%HI%JedB)
17590 seg%HI%JedB = min(max(JegB, G%HI%JsdB), G%HI%JedB)
17600 seg%HI%jsd = min(max(jsg, G%HI%jsd), G%HI%jed)
17610 seg%HI%jed = min(max(jeg, G%HI%jsd), G%HI%jed)
17620 seg%HI%JscB = min(max(JsgB, G%HI%JscB), G%HI%JecB)
17630 seg%HI%JecB = min(max(JegB, G%HI%JscB), G%HI%JecB)
17640 seg%HI%jsc = min(max(jsg, G%HI%jsc), G%HI%jec)
17650 seg%HI%jec = min(max(jeg, G%HI%jsc), G%HI%jec)
1766
17670end subroutine setup_segment_indices
1768
1769!> Parse an OBC_SEGMENT_%%% string starting with "I=" and configure placement and type of OBC accordingly
17700subroutine setup_u_point_obc(OBC, G, US, segment_str, l_seg, l_seg_io, PF, reentrant_y)
1771 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
1772 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
1773 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1774 character(len=*), intent(in) :: segment_str !< A string in form of "I=%,J=%:%,string"
1775 integer, intent(in) :: l_seg !< The internal segment number
1776 integer, intent(in) :: l_seg_io !< The segment number used for reading parameters
1777 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: PF !< Parameter file handle
1778 logical, intent(in) :: reentrant_y !< is the domain reentrant in y?
1779 ! Local variables
1780 integer :: I_obc, Js_obc, Je_obc ! Position of segment in global index space
1781 integer :: j, a_loop
1782 character(len=32) :: action_str(8)
1783 character(len=128) :: segment_param_str
17840 real, allocatable, dimension(:) :: tnudge ! Nudging timescales [T ~> s]
1785 ! This returns the global indices for the segment
17860 call parse_segment_str(G%ieg, G%jeg, segment_str, I_obc, Js_obc, Je_obc, action_str, reentrant_y)
1787
17880 call setup_segment_indices(G, OBC%segment(l_seg),I_obc,I_obc,Js_obc,Je_obc)
1789
17900 I_obc = I_obc - G%idg_offset ! Convert to local tile indices on this tile
17910 Js_obc = Js_obc - G%jdg_offset ! Convert to local tile indices on this tile
17920 Je_obc = Je_obc - G%jdg_offset ! Convert to local tile indices on this tile
1793
17940 if (Je_obc>Js_obc) then
17950 OBC%segment(l_seg)%direction = OBC_DIRECTION_E
17960 elseif (Je_obc<Js_obc) then
17970 OBC%segment(l_seg)%direction = OBC_DIRECTION_W
17980 j = js_obc ; js_obc = je_obc ; je_obc = j
1799 endif
1800
18010 OBC%segment(l_seg)%on_pe = .false.
1802
18030 do a_loop = 1,8 ! up to 8 options available
18040 if (len_trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 0) then
18050 cycle
18060 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'FLATHER') then
18070 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Flather = .true.
18080 OBC%segment(l_seg)%open = .true.
18090 OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18100 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18110 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'ORLANSKI') then
18120 OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation = .true.
18130 OBC%segment(l_seg)%open = .true.
18140 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18150 OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18160 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'ORLANSKI_TAN') then
18170 OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation = .true.
18180 OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation_tan = .true.
18190 OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18200 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'ORLANSKI_GRAD') then
18210 OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation = .true.
18220 OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation_grad = .true.
18230 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'OBLIQUE') then
18240 OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique = .true.
18250 OBC%segment(l_seg)%open = .true.
18260 OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18270 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18280 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'OBLIQUE_TAN') then
18290 OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique = .true.
18300 OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique_tan = .true.
18310 OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18320 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'OBLIQUE_GRAD') then
18330 OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique = .true.
18340 OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique_grad = .true.
18350 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'NUDGED') then
18360 OBC%segment(l_seg)%nudged = .true.
18370 OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18380 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'NUDGED_TAN') then
18390 OBC%segment(l_seg)%nudged_tan = .true.
18400 OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18410 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'NUDGED_GRAD') then
18420 OBC%segment(l_seg)%nudged_grad = .true.
18430 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'GRADIENT') then
18440 OBC%segment(l_seg)%gradient = .true.
18450 OBC%segment(l_seg)%open = .true.
18460 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true.
18470 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'SIMPLE') then
18480 OBC%segment(l_seg)%specified = .true.
18490 OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally = .true. ! This avoids deallocation
18500 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'SIMPLE_TAN') then
18510 OBC%segment(l_seg)%specified_tan = .true.
18520 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'SIMPLE_GRAD') then
18530 OBC%segment(l_seg)%specified_grad = .true.
1854 else
1855 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, setup_u_point_obc: "//&
18560 "String '"//trim(action_str(a_loop))//"' not understood.")
1857 endif
18580 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%nudged .or. OBC%segment(l_seg)%nudged_tan) then
18590 write(segment_param_str(1:43),"('OBC_SEGMENT_',i3.3,'_VELOCITY_NUDGING_TIMESCALES')") l_seg_io
18600 allocate(tnudge(2))
1861 call get_param(PF, mdl, segment_param_str(1:43), tnudge, &
1862 "Timescales in days for nudging along a segment, "//&
1863 "for inflow, then outflow. Setting both to zero should "//&
1864 "behave like SIMPLE obcs for the baroclinic velocities.", &
18650 fail_if_missing=.true., units="days", scale=86400.0*US%s_to_T)
18660 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in = tnudge(1)
18670 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out = tnudge(2)
18680 deallocate(tnudge)
1869 endif
1870
1871 enddo ! a_loop
1872
18730 OBC%segment(l_seg)%is_E_or_W_2 = .true.
1874
18750 if (I_obc<=G%HI%IsdB+1 .or. I_obc>=G%HI%IedB-1) return ! Boundary is not on tile
18760 if (Je_obc<=G%HI%JsdB .or. Js_obc>=G%HI%JedB) return ! Segment is not on tile
1877
18780 OBC%segment(l_seg)%on_pe = .true.
18790 OBC%segment(l_seg)%is_E_or_W = .true.
1880
18810 do j=G%HI%jsd, G%HI%jed
18820 if (j>Js_obc .and. j<=Je_obc) then
18830 OBC%segnum_u(I_obc,j) = l_seg
18840 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) OBC%segnum_u(I_obc,j) = -l_seg
18850 OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
1886 endif
1887 enddo
18880 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Is_obc = I_obc
18890 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Ie_obc = I_obc
18900 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Js_obc = Js_obc
18910 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Je_obc = Je_obc
18920 call allocate_OBC_segment_data(OBC, OBC%segment(l_seg))
1893
18940 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique .and. OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation) &
1895 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, setup_u_point_obc: \n"//&
18960 "Orlanski and Oblique OBC options cannot be used together on one segment.")
18970end subroutine setup_u_point_obc
1898
1899!> Parse an OBC_SEGMENT_%%% string starting with "J=" and configure placement and type of OBC accordingly

19230 Ie_obc = Ie_obc - G%idg_offset ! Convert to local tile indices on this tile

19690 elseif (trim(action_str(a_loop)) == 'NUDGED_TAN') then

2002 enddo ! a_loop
2003
20040 if (J_obc<=G%HI%JsdB+1 .or. J_obc>=G%HI%JedB-1) return ! Boundary is not on tile
20050 if (Ie_obc<=G%HI%IsdB .or. Is_obc>=G%HI%IedB) return ! Segment is not on tile
2006

2009
20100 do i=G%HI%isd, G%HI%ied
20110 if (i>Is_obc .and. i<=Ie_obc) then
20120 OBC%segnum_v(i,J_obc) = l_seg
20130 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) OBC%segnum_v(i,J_obc) = -l_seg
20140 OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = .true.
2015 endif
2016 enddo
20170 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Is_obc = Is_obc
20180 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Ie_obc = Ie_obc
20190 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Js_obc = J_obc
20200 OBC%segment(l_seg)%Je_obc = J_obc
20210 call allocate_OBC_segment_data(OBC, OBC%segment(l_seg))
2022
20230 if (OBC%segment(l_seg)%oblique .and. OBC%segment(l_seg)%radiation) &

20250 "Orlanski and Oblique OBC options cannot be used together on one segment.")

20270end subroutine setup_v_point_obc
