2029!> Parse an OBC_SEGMENT_%%% string
20300subroutine parse_segment_str(ni_global, nj_global, segment_str, l, m, n, action_str, reentrant)
2031 integer, intent(in) :: ni_global !< Number of h-points in zonal direction
2032 integer, intent(in) :: nj_global !< Number of h-points in meridional direction
2033 character(len=*), intent(in) :: segment_str !< A string in form of "I=l,J=m:n,string" or "J=l,I=m,n,string"
2034 integer, intent(out) :: l !< The value of I=l, if segment_str begins with I=l, or the value of J=l
2035 integer, intent(out) :: m !< The value of J=m, if segment_str begins with I=, or the value of I=m
2036 integer, intent(out) :: n !< The value of J=n, if segment_str begins with I=, or the value of I=n
2037 character(len=*), intent(out) :: action_str(:) !< The "string" part of segment_str
2038 logical, intent(in) :: reentrant !< is domain reentrant in relevant direction?
2039 ! Local variables
2040 character(len=24) :: word1, word2, m_word, n_word !< Words delineated by commas in a string in form of
2041 !! "I=%,J=%:%,string"
2042 character(len=3) :: max_words !< maximum number of OBC types per segment
2043 integer :: l_max !< Either ni_global or nj_global, depending on whether segment_str begins with "I=" or "J="
2044 integer :: mn_max !< Either nj_global or ni_global, depending on whether segment_str begins with "I=" or "J="
2045 integer :: j
2046 integer, parameter :: halo = 10
2047
2048 ! Process first word which will started with either 'I=' or 'J='
20490 word1 = extract_word(segment_str,',',1)
20500 word2 = extract_word(segment_str,',',2)
20510 if (word1(1:2)=='I=') then
20520 l_max = ni_global
20530 mn_max = nj_global
20540 if (.not. (word2(1:2)=='J=')) call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20550 "Second word of string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' must start with 'J='.")
20560 elseif (word1(1:2)=='J=') then ! Note that the file_parser uniformly expands "=" to " = "
20570 l_max = nj_global
20580 mn_max = ni_global
20590 if (.not. (word2(1:2)=='I=')) call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20600 "Second word of string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' must start with 'I='.")
2061 else
2062 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20630 "String '"//segment_str//"' must start with 'I=' or 'J='.")
2064 endif
2065
2066 ! Read l
20670 l = interpret_int_expr( word1(3:24), l_max )
20680 if (l<0 .or. l>l_max) then
2069 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20700 "First value from string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' is outside of the physical domain.")
2071 endif
2072
2073 ! Read m
20740 m_word = extract_word(word2(3:24),':',1)
20750 m = interpret_int_expr( m_word, mn_max )
20760 if (reentrant) then
20770 if (m<-halo .or. m>mn_max+halo) then
2078 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20790 "Beginning of range in string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' is outside of the physical domain.")
2080 endif
2081 else
20820 if (m<-1 .or. m>mn_max+1) then
2083 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20840 "Beginning of range in string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' is outside of the physical domain.")
2085 endif
2086 endif
2087
2088 ! Read n
20890 n_word = extract_word(word2(3:24),':',2)
20900 n = interpret_int_expr( n_word, mn_max )
20910 if (reentrant) then
20920 if (n<-halo .or. n>mn_max+halo) then
2093 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20940 "End of range in string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' is outside of the physical domain.")
2095 endif
2096 else
20970 if (n<-1 .or. n>mn_max+1) then
2098 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
20990 "End of range in string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' is outside of the physical domain.")
2100 endif
2101 endif
2102
21030 if (abs(n-m)==0) then
2104 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
21050 "Range in string '"//trim(segment_str)//"' must span one cell.")
2106 endif
2107
2108 ! checking if the number of provided OBC types is less than or equal to 8
21090 if (extract_word(segment_str,',',3+size(action_str))/="") then
21100 write(max_words, '(I0)') size(action_str)
2111 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "// &
2112 "Number of OBC descriptor words in '" // trim(segment_str) // "' is too large. " // &
21130 "There can be at most " // trim(max_words) // " descriptor words.")
2114 endif
2115
2116 ! Type of open boundary condition
21170 do j = 1, size(action_str)
21180 action_str(j) = extract_word(segment_str,',',2+j)
2119 enddo
2120
2121 contains
2122
2123 ! Returns integer value interpreted from string in form of %I, N or N+-%I
21240 integer function interpret_int_expr(string, imax)
2125 character(len=*), intent(in) :: string !< Integer in form or %I, N or N-%I
2126 integer, intent(in) :: imax !< Value to replace 'N' with
2127 ! Local variables
2128 integer slen
2129
21300 slen = len_trim(string)
21310 if (slen==0) call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
21320 "Parsed string was empty!")
21330 if (len_trim(string)==1 .and. string(1:1)=='N') then
21340 interpret_int_expr = imax
21350 elseif (string(1:1)=='N') then
21360 if (string(2:2)=='+') then
21370 read(string(3:slen),*,err=911) interpret_int_expr
21380 interpret_int_expr = imax + interpret_int_expr
21390 elseif (string(2:2)=='-') then
21400 read(string(3:slen),*,err=911) interpret_int_expr
21410 interpret_int_expr = imax - interpret_int_expr
2142 endif
2143 else
21440 read(string(1:slen),*,err=911) interpret_int_expr
2145 endif
21460 return
2147 911 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_str: "//&
21480 "Problem reading value from string '"//trim(string)//"'.")
21490 end function interpret_int_expr
2150end subroutine parse_segment_str
2151
2152
2153!> Parse an OBC_SEGMENT_%%%_DATA string and determine its fields
21540subroutine parse_segment_manifest_str(segment_str, num_fields, fields)
2155 character(len=*), intent(in) :: segment_str !< A string in form of
2156 !< "VAR1=file:foo1.nc(varnam1),VAR2=file:foo2.nc(varnam2),..."
2157 integer, intent(out) :: num_fields !< The number of fields in the segment data
2158 character(len=*), dimension(NUM_PHYS_FIELDS), intent(out) :: fields
2159 !< List of fieldnames for each segment
2160
2161 ! Local variables
2162 character(len=128) :: field_spec, field
2163 integer :: i
2164
21650 num_fields = 0
21660 fields(:) = ''
2167
21680 do
21690 field_spec = extract_word(segment_str, ',', num_fields + 1)
21700 if (trim(field_spec) == '') exit
2171
21720 if (num_fields >= NUM_PHYS_FIELDS) &
2173 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_manifest_str: " // &
21740 "too many fields in OBC segment manifest '" //trim(segment_str) // "'.")
2175
21760 field = trim(extract_word(field_spec, '=', 1))
2177
2178 ! Check for duplicate fields
21790 do i=1, num_fields
21800 if (fields(i) == trim(field)) &
2181 call MOM_error(FATAL, "MOM_open_boundary.F90, parse_segment_manifest_str: "//&
21820 "duplicate field '" // trim(field) // "' in '" // trim(segment_str) // "'.")
2183 enddo
2184
21850 num_fields = num_fields + 1
21860 fields(num_fields) = trim(field)
2187 enddo
21880end subroutine parse_segment_manifest_str
2189
2190
2191!> Parse an OBC_SEGMENT_%%%_DATA string
21920subroutine parse_segment_data_str(segment_str, idx, var, value, filename, fieldname)
2193 character(len=*), intent(in) :: segment_str !< A string in form of
2194 !! "VAR1=file:foo1.nc(varnam1),VAR2=file:foo2.nc(varnam2),..."
2195 integer, intent(in) :: idx !< Index of segment_str record
2196 character(len=*), intent(in) :: var !< The name of the variable for which parameters are needed
2197 character(len=*), intent(out) :: filename !< The name of the input file if using "file" method
2198 character(len=*), intent(out) :: fieldname !< The name of the variable in the input file if using
2199 !! "file" method
2200 real, optional, intent(out) :: value !< A constant value if using the "value" method in various
2201 !! units but without the internal rescaling [various units]
2202
2203 ! Local variables
2204 character(len=128) :: word1, word2, word3, method
2205 integer :: lword
2206
2207 ! Process first word which will start with the fieldname
22080 word3 = extract_word(segment_str, ',', idx)
22090 word1 = extract_word(word3, ':', 1)
2210 !if (trim(word1) == '') exit
22110 word2 = extract_word(word1, '=', 1)
22120 if (trim(word2) == trim(var)) then
22130 method = trim(extract_word(word1, '=', 2))
22140 lword = len_trim(method)
22150 if (method(lword-3:lword) == 'file') then
2216 ! raise an error id filename/fieldname not in argument list
22170 word1 = extract_word(word3, ':', 2)
22180 filename = extract_word(word1, '(', 1)
22190 fieldname = extract_word(word1, '(', 2)
22200 lword = len_trim(fieldname)
22210 fieldname = fieldname(1:lword-1) ! remove trailing parenth
22220 value = -999.
22230 elseif (method(lword-4:lword) == 'value') then
22240 filename = 'none'
22250 fieldname = 'none'
22260 word1 = extract_word(word3, ':', 2)
22270 lword = len_trim(word1)
22280 read(word1(1:lword), *, end=986, err=987) value
2229 endif
2230 endif
2231
22320 return
22330986 call MOM_error(FATAL,'End of record while parsing segment data specification! '//trim(segment_str))
22340987 call MOM_error(FATAL,'Error while parsing segment data specification! '//trim(segment_str))
22350end subroutine parse_segment_data_str
2236
2237!> Parse all the OBC_SEGMENT_%%%_DATA strings again
2238!! to see which need tracer reservoirs (all pes need to know).
22390subroutine parse_for_tracer_reservoirs(OBC, PF, use_temperature)
2240 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2241 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: PF !< Parameter file handle
2242 logical, intent(in) :: use_temperature !< If true, T and S are used
2243
2244 ! Local variables
2245 integer :: n ! The segment number used to read in input data
2246 integer :: n_seg ! The internal segment number
2247 integer :: m, num_fields ! Used to loop over the fields on a segment
2248 integer :: na
2249 character(len=1024) :: segstr
2250 character(len=256) :: filename
2251 character(len=20) :: segname, suffix
2252 character(len=32) :: fieldname
2253 real :: value ! A value that is parsed from the segment data string [various units]
2254 character(len=32), dimension(NUM_PHYS_FIELDS) :: fields ! segment field names
2255 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
2256
22570 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
22580 n_seg = n ; if (OBC%reverse_segment_order) n_seg = OBC%number_of_segments + 1 - n
22590 segment => OBC%segment(n_seg)
22600 write(segname, "('OBC_SEGMENT_',i3.3,'_DATA')") n
22610 write(suffix, "('_segment_',i3.3)") n
2262 ! Clear out any old values
22630 segstr = ''
22640 call get_param(PF, mdl, segname, segstr)
22650 if (segstr == '') cycle
2266
22670 call parse_segment_manifest_str(trim(segstr), num_fields, fields)
22680 if (num_fields == 0) cycle
2269
2270 ! At this point, just search for TEMP and SALT as tracers 1 and 2.
22710 do m=1,num_fields
22720 call parse_segment_data_str(trim(segstr), m, trim(fields(m)), value, filename, fieldname)
22730 if (trim(filename) /= 'none') then
22740 if (fields(m) == 'TEMP') then
22750 if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) then
22760 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(1) = .true.
2277 else
22780 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(1) = .true.
2279 endif
2280 endif
22810 if (fields(m) == 'SALT') then
22820 if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) then
22830 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(2) = .true.
2284 else
22850 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(2) = .true.
2286 endif
2287 endif
2288 endif
2289 enddo
2290 ! Alternately, set first two to true if use_temperature is true
22910 if (use_temperature) then
22920 if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) then
22930 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(1) = .true.
22940 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(2) = .true.
2295 else
22960 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(1) = .true.
22970 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(2) = .true.
2298 endif
2299 endif
2300 !Add reservoirs for external/obgc tracers
2301 !There is a diconnect in the above logic between tracer index and reservoir index.
2302 !It arbitarily assigns reservoir indexes 1&2 to tracers T&S,
2303 !So we need to start from reservoir index for non-native tracers from 3, hence na=2 below.
2304 !num_fields is the number of vars in segstr (6 of them now, U,V,SSH,TEMP,SALT,dye)
2305 !but OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used is allocated to size Reg%ntr, which is the total number of tracers
23060 na = 2 ! Number of native MOM6 tracers (T&S) with reservoirs
23070 do m=1,OBC%num_obgc_tracers
2308 !This logic assumes all external tarcers need a reservoir
2309 !The segments for tracers are not initialized yet (that happens later in initialize_segment_data())
2310 !so we cannot query to determine if this tracer needs a reservoir.
23110 if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) then
23120 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(m+na) = .true.
2313 else
23140 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(m+na) = .true.
2315 endif
2316 enddo
2317 enddo
2318
23190 return
2320
2321end subroutine parse_for_tracer_reservoirs
2322
2323!> Do any necessary halo updates on OBC-related fields.
23240subroutine open_boundary_halo_update(G, OBC)
2325 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2326 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2327
2328 ! Local variables
2329 integer :: m
2330
23310 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
2332
23330 id_clock_pass = cpu_clock_id('(Ocean OBC halo updates)', grain=CLOCK_ROUTINE)
23340 if (OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally) call pass_vector(OBC%rx_normal, OBC%ry_normal, G%Domain, &
23350 To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23360 if (OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally) then
2337! call pass_vector(OBC%rx_oblique_u, OBC%ry_oblique_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
2338! call pass_vector(OBC%ry_oblique_u, OBC%rx_oblique_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
2339! call pass_vector(OBC%cff_normal_u, OBC%cff_normal_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23400 call create_group_pass(OBC%pass_oblique, OBC%rx_oblique_u, OBC%ry_oblique_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23410 call create_group_pass(OBC%pass_oblique, OBC%ry_oblique_u, OBC%rx_oblique_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23420 call create_group_pass(OBC%pass_oblique, OBC%cff_normal_u, OBC%cff_normal_v, G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23430 call do_group_pass(OBC%pass_oblique, G%Domain)
2344 endif
23450 if (allocated(OBC%tres_x) .and. allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then
23460 do m=1,OBC%ntr
23470 call pass_vector(OBC%tres_x(:,:,:,m), OBC%tres_y(:,:,:,m), G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
2348 enddo
23490 elseif (allocated(OBC%tres_x)) then
23500 do m=1,OBC%ntr
23510 call pass_var(OBC%tres_x(:,:,:,m), G%Domain, position=EAST_FACE)
2352 enddo
23530 elseif (allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then
23540 do m=1,OBC%ntr
23550 call pass_var(OBC%tres_y(:,:,:,m), G%Domain, position=NORTH_FACE)
2356 enddo
2357 endif
23580 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_x) .and. allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) then
23590 call pass_vector(OBC%h_res_x(:,:,:), OBC%h_res_y(:,:,:), G%Domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
23600 elseif (allocated(OBC%h_res_x)) then
23610 call pass_var(OBC%h_res_x(:,:,:), G%Domain, position=EAST_FACE)
23620 elseif (allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) then
23630 call pass_var(OBC%h_res_y(:,:,:), G%Domain, position=NORTH_FACE)
2364 endif
2365
2366end subroutine open_boundary_halo_update

23680logical function open_boundary_query(OBC, apply_open_OBC, apply_specified_OBC, apply_Flather_OBC, &
2369 apply_nudged_OBC, needs_ext_seg_data)
2370 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2371 logical, optional, intent(in) :: apply_open_OBC !< Returns True if open_*_BCs_exist_globally is true
2372 logical, optional, intent(in) :: apply_specified_OBC !< Returns True if specified_*_BCs_exist_globally is true
2373 logical, optional, intent(in) :: apply_Flather_OBC !< Returns True if Flather_*_BCs_exist_globally is true
2374 logical, optional, intent(in) :: apply_nudged_OBC !< Returns True if nudged_*_BCs_exist_globally is true
2375 logical, optional, intent(in) :: needs_ext_seg_data !< Returns True if external segment data needed
23760 open_boundary_query = .false.

23780 if (present(apply_open_OBC)) open_boundary_query = OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
23790 OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally
23800 if (present(apply_specified_OBC)) open_boundary_query = OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
23810 OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally
23820 if (present(apply_Flather_OBC)) open_boundary_query = OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
23830 OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally
23840 if (present(apply_nudged_OBC)) open_boundary_query = OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
23850 OBC%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally
23860 if (present(needs_ext_seg_data)) open_boundary_query = OBC%any_needs_IO_for_data
2387
23880end function open_boundary_query

2390!> Deallocate open boundary data
23910subroutine open_boundary_dealloc(OBC)
2392 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure

2394 integer :: n
2395
23960 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
2397
23980 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
23990 segment => OBC%segment(n)
24000 call deallocate_OBC_segment_data(segment)
2401 enddo

24030 if (allocated(OBC%segnum_u)) deallocate(OBC%segnum_u)
24040 if (allocated(OBC%segnum_v)) deallocate(OBC%segnum_v)
24050 if (allocated(OBC%rx_normal)) deallocate(OBC%rx_normal)
24060 if (allocated(OBC%ry_normal)) deallocate(OBC%ry_normal)
24070 if (allocated(OBC%rx_oblique_u)) deallocate(OBC%rx_oblique_u)
24080 if (allocated(OBC%ry_oblique_u)) deallocate(OBC%ry_oblique_u)
24090 if (allocated(OBC%rx_oblique_v)) deallocate(OBC%rx_oblique_v)
24100 if (allocated(OBC%ry_oblique_v)) deallocate(OBC%ry_oblique_v)
24110 if (allocated(OBC%cff_normal_u)) deallocate(OBC%cff_normal_u)
24120 if (allocated(OBC%cff_normal_v)) deallocate(OBC%cff_normal_v)
24130 if (allocated(OBC%tres_x)) deallocate(OBC%tres_x)
24140 if (allocated(OBC%tres_y)) deallocate(OBC%tres_y)
24150 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_x)) deallocate(OBC%h_res_x)
24160 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) deallocate(OBC%h_res_y)
24170 if (associated(OBC%remap_z_CS)) deallocate(OBC%remap_z_CS)
24180 if (associated(OBC%remap_h_CS)) deallocate(OBC%remap_h_CS)

2428!> Sets the slope of bathymetry normal to an open boundary to zero.
24290subroutine open_boundary_impose_normal_slope(OBC, G, depth)
2430 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2431 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2432 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), intent(inout) :: depth !< Bathymetry at h-points, in [Z ~> m] or other units
2433 ! Local variables
2434 integer :: i, j, n
2435 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2436
24370 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
2438
24390 if (.not.(OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally .or. &
2440 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally)) &
24410 return
2442
24430 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
24440 segment => OBC%segment(n)
24450 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
24460 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
24470 I=segment%HI%IsdB
24480 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
24490 depth(i+1,j) = depth(i,j)
2450 enddo
24510 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
24520 I=segment%HI%IsdB
24530 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
24540 depth(i,j) = depth(i+1,j)
2455 enddo
24560 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
24570 J=segment%HI%JsdB
24580 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
24590 depth(i,j+1) = depth(i,j)
2460 enddo
24610 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
24620 J=segment%HI%JsdB
24630 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
24640 depth(i,j) = depth(i,j+1)
2465 enddo
2466 endif
2467 enddo
2468
2469end subroutine open_boundary_impose_normal_slope
2470
2471!> Reconcile masks and open boundaries, deallocate OBC on PEs where it is not needed.
2472!! Also adjust u- and v-point cell area on specified open boundaries and mask all
2473!! points outside open boundaries.
24740subroutine open_boundary_impose_land_mask(OBC, G, areaCu, areaCv, US)
2475 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2476 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2477 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
2478 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)), intent(inout) :: areaCu !< Area of a u-cell [L2 ~> m2]
2479 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)), intent(inout) :: areaCv !< Area of a u-cell [L2 ~> m2]
2480 ! Local variables
2481 integer :: i, j, n
2482 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2483 logical :: any_U, any_V
2484
24850 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
2486
24870 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
24880 segment => OBC%segment(n)
24890 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
24900 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
2491 ! Sweep along u-segments and delete the OBC for blocked points.
2492 ! Also, mask all points outside.
24930 I=segment%HI%IsdB
24940 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
24950 if (G%mask2dCu(I,j) == 0) OBC%segnum_u(I,j) = 0
24960 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
24970 G%mask2dT(i,j) = 0.0
2498 else
24990 G%mask2dT(i+1,j) = 0.0
2500 endif
2501 enddo
25020 do J=segment%HI%JsdB+1,segment%HI%JedB-1
25030 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
25040 G%mask2dCv(i,J) = 0 ; G%OBCmaskCv(i,J) = 0.0 ; G%IdyCv_OBCmask(i,J) = 0.0
2505 else
25060 G%mask2dCv(i+1,J) = 0.0 ; G%OBCmaskCv(i+1,J) = 0.0 ; G%IdyCv_OBCmask(i+1,J) = 0.0
2507 endif
2508 enddo
2509 else
2510 ! Sweep along v-segments and delete the OBC for blocked points.
25110 J=segment%HI%JsdB
25120 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
25130 if (G%mask2dCv(i,J) == 0) OBC%segnum_v(i,J) = 0
25140 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
25150 G%mask2dT(i,j) = 0.0
2516 else
25170 G%mask2dT(i,j+1) = 0.0
2518 endif
2519 enddo
25200 do I=segment%HI%IsdB+1,segment%HI%IedB-1
25210 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
25220 G%mask2dCu(I,j) = 0.0 ; G%OBCmaskCu(I,j) = 0.0 ; G%IdxCu_OBCmask(I,j) = 0.0
2523 else
25240 G%mask2dCu(I,j+1) = 0.0 ; G%OBCmaskCu(I,j+1) = 0.0 ; G%IdxCu_OBCmask(I,j+1) = 0.0
2525 endif
2526 enddo
2527 endif
2528 enddo
2529
25300 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
25310 segment => OBC%segment(n)
25320 if (.not. (segment%on_pe .and. segment%open)) cycle
2533 ! Set the OBCmask values to help eliminate certain terms at u- or v- OBC points.
2534 ! Testing suggests this could be applied at all u- or v- OBC points without changing answers.
25350 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
25360 I=segment%HI%IsdB
25370 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
25380 G%OBCmaskCu(I,j) = 0.0 ; G%IdxCu_OBCmask(I,j) = 0.0
2539 enddo
2540 else
25410 J=segment%HI%JsdB
25420 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
25430 G%OBCmaskCv(i,J) = 0.0 ; G%IdyCv_OBCmask(i,J) = 0.0
2544 enddo
2545 endif
2546 enddo
2547
25480 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
25490 segment => OBC%segment(n)
25500 if (.not. segment%on_pe .or. .not. segment%specified) cycle
25510 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
2552 ! Sweep along u-segments and for %specified BC points reset the u-point area which was masked out
25530 I=segment%HI%IsdB
25540 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
25550 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
25560 areaCu(I,j) = G%areaT(i,j) ! Both of these are in [L2 ~> m2]
2557 else ! West
25580 areaCu(I,j) = G%areaT(i+1,j) ! Both of these are in [L2 ~> m2]
2559 endif
2560 enddo
2561 else
2562 ! Sweep along v-segments and for %specified BC points reset the v-point area which was masked out
25630 J=segment%HI%JsdB
25640 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
25650 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
25660 areaCv(i,J) = G%areaT(i,j+1) ! Both of these are in [L2 ~> m2]
2567 else ! North
25680 areaCv(i,J) = G%areaT(i,j) ! Both of these are in [L2 ~> m2]
2569 endif
2570 enddo
2571 endif
2572 enddo
2573
2574 ! G%mask2du will be open wherever bathymetry allows it.
2575 ! Bathymetry outside of the open boundary was adjusted to match
2576 ! the bathymetry inside so these points will be open unless the
2577 ! bathymetry inside the boundary was too shallow and flagged as land.
25780 any_U = .false.
25790 any_V = .false.
25800 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
25810 segment => OBC%segment(n)
25820 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
25830 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
25840 I=segment%HI%IsdB
25850 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
25860 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) /= 0) any_U = .true.
2587 enddo
2588 else
25890 J=segment%HI%JsdB
25900 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
25910 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) /= 0) any_V = .true.
2592 enddo
2593 endif
2594 enddo
2595
25960 OBC%u_OBCs_on_PE = any_U
25970 OBC%v_OBCs_on_PE = any_V
25980 OBC%OBC_pe = (any_U .or. any_V)
2599
2600end subroutine open_boundary_impose_land_mask
2601
2602!> Initialize the tracer reservoirs values, perhaps only if they have not been set via a restart file.
26030subroutine setup_OBC_tracer_reservoirs(G, GV, OBC, restart_CS)
2604 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2605 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
2606 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2607 type(MOM_restart_CS), optional, intent(in) :: restart_CS !< MOM restart control structure
2608
2609 ! Local variables
2610 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2611 real :: I_scale ! The inverse of the scaling factor for the tracers.
2612 ! For salinity the units would be [ppt S-1 ~> 1]
2613 logical :: set_tres_x, set_tres_y
2614 character(len=12) :: x_var_name, y_var_name
2615 integer :: i, j, k, m, n
2616
26170 do m=1,OBC%ntr
2618
26190 set_tres_x = allocated(OBC%tres_x) .and. OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(m)
26200 set_tres_y = allocated(OBC%tres_y) .and. OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(m)
2621
26220 if (present(restart_CS)) then
2623 ! Set the names of the reservoirs for this tracer in the restart file, and inquire whether
2624 ! they have been initialized
26250 if (modulo(G%HI%turns, 2) == 0) then
26260 write(x_var_name,'("tres_x_",I3.3)') m
26270 write(y_var_name,'("tres_y_",I3.3)') m
2628 else
26290 write(x_var_name,'("tres_y_",I3.3)') m
26300 write(y_var_name,'("tres_x_",I3.3)') m
2631 endif
26320 if (set_tres_x) set_tres_x = .not.query_initialized(OBC%tres_x, x_var_name, restart_CS)
26330 if (set_tres_y) set_tres_y = .not.query_initialized(OBC%tres_y, y_var_name, restart_CS)
2634 endif
2635
26360 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
26370 segment => OBC%segment(n)
26380 if (associated(segment%tr_Reg)) then ; if (allocated(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres)) then
26390 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
2640
26410 if (segment%is_E_or_W .and. set_tres_x) then
26420 I = segment%HI%IsdB
26430 if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%is_initialized) then
26440 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
26450 OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,j,k)
2646 enddo ; enddo
2647 else
26480 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
26490 OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%t(i,j,k)
2650 enddo ; enddo
2651 endif
26520 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S .and. set_tres_y) then
26530 J = segment%HI%JsdB
26540 if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%is_initialized) then
26550 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
26560 OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k)
2657 enddo ; enddo
2658 else
26590 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
26600 OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%t(i,J,k)
2661 enddo ; enddo
2662 endif
2663 endif
2664 endif ; endif
2665 enddo
2666 enddo
2667
26680end subroutine setup_OBC_tracer_reservoirs
2669
2670!> Initialize the thickness reservoirs values, perhaps only if they have not been set via a restart file.
26710subroutine setup_OBC_thickness_reservoirs(G, GV, OBC, restart_CS)
2672 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2673 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
2674 type(ocean_OBC_type), target, intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2675 type(MOM_restart_CS), optional, intent(in) :: restart_CS !< MOM restart control structure
2676

2683 integer :: i, j, k, n
2684
26850 set_h_res_x = allocated(OBC%h_res_x) .and. OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used
26860 set_h_res_y = allocated(OBC%h_res_y) .and. OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used

26920 write(x_var_name,'("h_res_x")')
26930 write(y_var_name,'("h_res_y")')
2694 else
26950 write(x_var_name,'("h_res_y")')
26960 write(y_var_name,'("h_res_x")')
2697 endif

26990 if (set_h_res_y) set_h_res_y = .not.query_initialized(OBC%h_res_y, y_var_name, restart_CS)

27040 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) then ; if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then
27050 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%h_Reg%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%h_Reg%scale

27100 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
27110 OBC%h_res_x(I,j,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,j,k)
2712 enddo ; enddo
2713 else
27140 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
27150 OBC%h_res_x(I,j,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h(i,j,k)
2716 enddo ; enddo
2717 endif
27180 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S .and. set_h_res_y) then
27190 J = segment%HI%JsdB
27200 if (segment%h_Reg%is_initialized) then
27210 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
27220 OBC%h_res_y(i,J,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k)
2723 enddo ; enddo
2724 else
27250 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
27260 OBC%h_res_y(i,J,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h(i,J,k)
2727 enddo ; enddo
2728 endif
2729 endif
2730 endif ; endif
2731 enddo

2735!> Record that the tracer reservoirs have been initialized so that their values are not reset later.
27360subroutine set_initialized_OBC_tracer_reservoirs(G, OBC, restart_CS)

2752

2759!> Copy radiation and oblique boundary condition coefficients (phase speeds and normalizing
2760!! denominator) from the global restart arrays into the per-segment arrays.
27610subroutine copy_OBC_radiation_coefs(OBC)
2762 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2763
2764 ! Local variables
2765 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2766 integer :: nz, i, j, k, n, is, ie, js, je
2767
27680 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
27690 if (OBC%gamma_uv >= 1.0) return
2770
27710 nz = OBC%ke
27720 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
27730 segment => OBC%segment(n)
27740 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
27750 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then ! EW segment
27760 I = segment%HI%IsdB ; js = segment%HI%jsd ; je = segment%HI%jed
27770 if (segment%radiation) then
27780 do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je
27790 segment%rx_norm_rad(I,j,k) = OBC%rx_normal(I,j,k)
2780 enddo ; enddo
2781 endif
27820 if (segment%oblique) then
27830 do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je
27840 segment%rx_norm_obl(I,j,k) = OBC%rx_oblique_u(I,j,k)
27850 segment%ry_norm_obl(I,j,k) = OBC%ry_oblique_u(I,j,k)
27860 segment%cff_normal(I,j,k) = OBC%cff_normal_u(I,j,k)
2787 enddo ; enddo
2788 endif
27890 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then ! NS segment
27900 J = segment%HI%JsdB ; is = segment%HI%isd ; ie = segment%HI%ied
27910 if (segment%radiation) then
27920 do k=1,nz ; do i=is,ie
27930 segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k) = OBC%ry_normal(i,J,k)
2794 enddo ; enddo
2795 endif
27960 if (segment%oblique) then
27970 do k=1,nz ; do i=is,ie
27980 segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k) = OBC%rx_oblique_v(i,J,k)
27990 segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k) = OBC%ry_oblique_v(i,J,k)
28000 segment%cff_normal(i,J,k) = OBC%cff_normal_v(i,J,k)
2801 enddo ; enddo
2802 endif
2803 endif
2804 enddo
2805
2806end subroutine copy_OBC_radiation_coefs
2807
2808!> Copy restart fields OBC%tres_x/y to per-segment tracer reservoir segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres.
28090subroutine copy_OBC_tracer_reservoirs(OBC)
2810 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2811
2812 ! Local variables
2813 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2814 integer :: n, m, i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, nz
2815
28160 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
2817 ! The allocated checks are needed for some user cases (e.g. "dyed_obcs"), where per-segment
2818 ! tracers are registered after global restart arrays OBC%tres_x/y are allocated (or not).
28190 if (.not. (allocated(OBC%tres_x) .or. allocated(OBC%tres_y))) return
2820
28210 nz = OBC%ke
28220 do n=1, OBC%number_of_segments
28230 segment => OBC%segment(n)
28240 if (.not. (segment%on_pe .and. associated(segment%tr_Reg))) cycle
28250 if (segment%is_E_or_W .and. allocated(OBC%tres_x)) then ! EW segment
28260 I = segment%HI%IsdB ; js = segment%HI%jsd ; je = segment%HI%jed
28270 do m=1, segment%tr_Reg%ntseg ; do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je
28280 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,k) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale * OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,m)
2829 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
28300 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S .and. allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then ! NS segment
28310 J = segment%HI%JsdB ; is = segment%HI%isd ; ie = segment%HI%ied
28320 do m=1, segment%tr_Reg%ntseg ; do k=1,nz ; do i=is,ie
28330 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale * OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,m)
2834 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
2835 endif
2836 enddo ! end segment loop
2837end subroutine copy_OBC_tracer_reservoirs
2838
2839!> Fill segment%h_Reg from restart fields.
28400subroutine copy_OBC_thickness_reservoirs(OBC, G, GV)
2841 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2842 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
2843 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2844 ! Local variables
2845 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2846 integer :: i, j, k, n
2847 logical :: sym
2848
28490 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
2850
28510 if (.not.(OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used .or. OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used)) &
28520 return
2853
2854 ! Now thickness reservoirs
28550 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
28560 segment=>OBC%segment(n)
28570 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) then
28580 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
28590 I = segment%HI%IsdB
28600 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then
28610 do k=1,GV%ke
28620 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
28630 segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,k) = segment%h_Reg%scale * OBC%h_res_x(I,j,k)
2864 enddo
2865 enddo
2866 endif
2867 else
28680 J = segment%HI%JsdB
28690 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then
28700 do k=1,GV%ke
28710 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
28720 segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k) = segment%h_Reg%scale * OBC%h_res_y(i,J,k)
2873 enddo
2874 enddo
2875 endif
2876 endif
2877 endif
2878 enddo
2879
28800 if (OBC%debug) then
28810 sym = G%Domain%symmetric
28820 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_x) .and. allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) then
2883 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%h_res_[xy]", OBC%h_res_x(:,:,:), OBC%h_res_y(:,:,:), G%HI, &
28840 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0)
2885 endif
2886 endif
2887
2888end subroutine copy_OBC_thickness_reservoirs
2889
2890!> Apply radiation conditions to 3D u,v at open boundaries
28910subroutine radiation_open_bdry_conds(OBC, u_new, u_old, v_new, v_old, G, GV, US, dt)
2892 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
2893 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
2894 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
2895 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: u_new !< On exit, new u values on open boundaries
2896 !! On entry, the old time-level u but including
2897 !! barotropic accelerations [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
2898 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: u_old !< Original unadjusted u [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
2899 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: v_new !< On exit, new v values on open boundaries.
2900 !! On entry, the old time-level v but including
2901 !! barotropic accelerations [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
2902 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: v_old !< Original unadjusted v [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
2903 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
2904 real, intent(in) :: dt !< Appropriate timestep [T ~> s]
2905 ! Local variables
2906 real :: dhdt, dhdx, dhdy ! One-point differences in time or space [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
2907 real :: gamma_u, gamma_2 ! Fractional weightings of new values [nondim]
2908 real :: tau ! A local nudging timescale [T ~> s]
2909 real :: rx_max, ry_max ! coefficients for radiation [nondim]
2910 real :: rx_new, rx_avg ! coefficients for radiation [nondim] or [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
2911 real :: ry_new, ry_avg ! coefficients for radiation [nondim] or [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
2912 real :: cff_new, cff_avg ! denominator in oblique [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
2913 real, allocatable, dimension(:,:,:) :: &
29140 rx_tang_rad, & ! The phase speed at u-points for tangential oblique OBCs
2915 ! in units of grid points per timestep [nondim],
2916 ! discretized at the corner (PV) points.
29170 ry_tang_rad, & ! The phase speed at v-points for tangential oblique OBCs
2918 ! in units of grid points per timestep [nondim],
2919 ! discretized at the corner (PV) points.
29200 rx_tang_obl, & ! The x-coefficient for tangential oblique OBCs [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2],
2921 ! discretized at the corner (PV) points.
29220 ry_tang_obl, & ! The y-coefficient for tangential oblique OBCs [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2],
2923 ! discretized at the corner (PV) points.
29240 cff_tangential ! The denominator for tangential oblique OBCs [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2],
2925 ! discretized at the corner (PV) points.
2926 real :: eps ! A small velocity squared [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
2927 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
2928 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, m, nz, n
2929 integer :: is_obc, ie_obc, js_obc, je_obc
2930 logical :: sym
2931 character(len=3) :: var_num
2932
29330 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
2934
29350 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
2936
29370 if (.not.(OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally .or. OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally)) &

3673 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) + &
36740 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_tangential_grad(I,J,k)
3675 enddo ; enddo
3676 endif
36770 deallocate(rx_tang_obl)
36780 deallocate(ry_tang_obl)
36790 deallocate(cff_tangential)
3680 endif
3681 endif
3682
36830 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
36840 J=segment%HI%JsdB
36850 if (J>G%HI%JecB) cycle
36860 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
36870 if (segment%radiation) then
36880 dhdt = (v_old(i,J+1,k) - v_new(i,J+1,k)) !old-new
36890 dhdy = (v_new(i,J+1,k) - v_new(i,J+2,k)) !in new time backward sashay for J-1
36900 ry_new = 0.0
36910 if (dhdt*dhdy > 0.0) ry_new = min( (dhdt/dhdy), ry_max)
36920 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
36930 ry_avg = (1.0-gamma_u)*segment%ry_norm_rad(I,j,k) + gamma_u*ry_new
3694 else
36950 ry_avg = ry_new
3696 endif
36970 segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k) = ry_avg
3698 ! The new boundary value is interpolated between future interior
3699 ! value, v_new(J+1) and past boundary value but with barotropic
3700 ! accelerations, v_new(J).
37010 segment%normal_vel(i,J,k) = (v_new(i,J,k) + ry_avg*v_new(i,J+1,k)) / (1.0+ry_avg)
37020 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
3703 ! Copy restart fields into 3-d arrays. This is an inefficient and temporary issues
3704 ! implemented as a work-around to limitations in restart capability
37050 OBC%ry_normal(i,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k)
3706 endif
37070 elseif (segment%oblique) then
37080 dhdt = (v_old(i,J+1,k) - v_new(i,J+1,k)) !old-new
37090 dhdy = (v_new(i,J+1,k) - v_new(i,J+2,k)) !in new time backward sashay for J-1
37100 if (dhdt*(segment%grad_normal(I,1,k) + segment%grad_normal(I-1,1,k)) > 0.0) then
37110 dhdx = segment%grad_normal(I-1,1,k)
37120 elseif (dhdt*(segment%grad_normal(I,1,k) + segment%grad_normal(I-1,1,k)) == 0.0) then
37130 dhdx = 0.0
3714 else
37150 dhdx = segment%grad_normal(I,1,k)
3716 endif
37170 if (dhdt*dhdy < 0.0) dhdt = 0.0
3718
37190 cff_new = max((dhdx*dhdx) + (dhdy*dhdy), eps)
37200 ry_new = min(dhdt*dhdy, cff_new*ry_max)
37210 rx_new = min(cff_new,max(dhdt*dhdx,-cff_new))
37220 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
37230 rx_avg = (1.0-gamma_u)*segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k) + gamma_u*rx_new
37240 ry_avg = (1.0-gamma_u)*segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k) + gamma_u*ry_new
37250 cff_avg = (1.0-gamma_u)*segment%cff_normal(i,J,k) + gamma_u*cff_new
3726 else
37270 rx_avg = rx_new
37280 ry_avg = ry_new
37290 cff_avg = cff_new
3730 endif
37310 segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k) = rx_avg
37320 segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k) = ry_avg
37330 segment%cff_normal(i,J,k) = cff_avg
3734 segment%normal_vel(i,J,k) = ((cff_avg*v_new(i,J,k) + ry_avg*v_new(i,J+1,k)) - &
3735 (max(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_normal(I-1,2,k) + &
3736 min(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_normal(I,2,k))) / &
37370 (cff_avg + ry_avg)
37380 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
3739 ! Copy restart fields into 3-d arrays. This is an inefficient and temporary issues
3740 ! implemented as a work-around to limitations in restart capability
37410 OBC%rx_oblique_v(i,J,k) = segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k)
37420 OBC%ry_oblique_v(i,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k)
37430 OBC%cff_normal_v(i,J,k) = segment%cff_normal(i,J,k)
3744 endif
37450 elseif (segment%gradient) then
37460 segment%normal_vel(i,J,k) = v_new(i,J+1,k)
3747 endif
37480 if ((segment%radiation .or. segment%oblique) .and. segment%nudged) then
3749 ! dhdt gets set to 0 on inflow in oblique case
37500 if (dhdt*dhdy <= 0.0) then
37510 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
3752 else
37530 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
3754 endif
37550 gamma_2 = dt / (tau + dt)
3756 segment%normal_vel(i,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%normal_vel(i,J,k) + &
37570 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_normal_vel(i,J,k)
3758 endif
3759 enddo ; enddo
37600 if (segment%radiation_tan .or. segment%radiation_grad) then
37610 J=segment%HI%JsdB
37620 allocate(ry_tang_rad(segment%HI%IsdB:segment%HI%IedB,segment%HI%JsdB:segment%HI%JedB,nz))
37630 do k=1,nz
37640 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
37650 ry_tang_rad(segment%HI%IsdB,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_rad(segment%HI%isd,J,k)
37660 ry_tang_rad(segment%HI%IedB,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_rad(segment%HI%ied,J,k)
37670 do I=segment%HI%IsdB+1,segment%HI%IedB-1
37680 ry_tang_rad(I,J,k) = 0.5*(segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k) + segment%ry_norm_rad(i+1,J,k))
3769 enddo
3770 else
37710 do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
37720 dhdt = u_old(I,j+1,k)-u_new(I,j+1,k) !old-new
37730 dhdy = u_new(I,j+1,k)-u_new(I,j+2,k) !in new time backward sashay for I-1
37740 ry_tang_rad(I,J,k) = 0.0
37750 if (dhdt*dhdy > 0.0) ry_tang_rad(I,J,k) = min( (dhdt/dhdy), rx_max) ! outward phase speed
3776 enddo
3777 endif
3778 enddo
37790 if (segment%radiation_tan) then
37800 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
37810 ry_avg = ry_tang_rad(I,J,k)
37820 segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) = (u_new(I,j+1,k) + ry_avg*u_new(I,j+2,k)) / (1.0+ry_avg)
3783 enddo ; enddo
3784 endif
37850 if (segment%nudged_tan) then
37860 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
3787 ! dhdt gets set to 0 on inflow in oblique case
37880 if (ry_tang_rad(I,J,k) <= 0.0) then
37890 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
3790 else
37910 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
3792 endif
37930 gamma_2 = dt / (tau + dt)
3794 segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) + &
37950 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_tangential_vel(I,J,k)
3796 enddo ; enddo
3797 endif
37980 if (segment%radiation_grad) then
37990 Is_obc = max(segment%HI%IsdB,G%isd+1)
38000 Ie_obc = min(segment%HI%IedB,G%ied-1)
38010 do k=1,nz ; do I=Is_obc,Ie_obc
38020 ry_avg = ry_tang_rad(I,J,k)
3803 ! if (G%mask2dCv(i,J+1) > 0.0 .and. G%mask2dCv(i+1,J+1) > 0.0) then
3804 ! ry_avg = 0.5*(v_new(i,J+1,k) + v_new(i+1,J+1,k)) * dt * G%IdyBu(I,J+1)
3805 ! elseif (G%mask2dCv(i,J+1) > 0.0) then
3806 ! ry_avg = v_new(i,J+1,k) * dt * G%IdyBu(I,J+1)
3807 ! elseif (G%mask2dCv(i+1,J+1) > 0.0) then
3808 ! ry_avg = v_new(i+1,J+1,k) * dt * G%IdyBu(I,J+1)
3809 ! else
3810 ! ry_avg = 0.0
3811 ! endif
3812 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = ((u_new(I,j+2,k) - u_new(I,j+1,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+1) + &
38130 ry_avg*(u_new(I,j+3,k) - u_new(I,j+2,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+2)) / (1.0+ry_avg)
3814 enddo ; enddo
3815 endif
38160 if (segment%nudged_grad) then
38170 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
3818 ! dhdt gets set to 0 on inflow in oblique case
38190 if (ry_tang_rad(I,J,k) <= 0.0) then
38200 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
3821 else
38220 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
3823 endif
38240 gamma_2 = dt / (tau + dt)
3825 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) + &
38260 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_tangential_grad(I,J,k)
3827 enddo ; enddo
3828 endif
38290 deallocate(ry_tang_rad)
3830 endif
38310 if (segment%oblique_tan .or. segment%oblique_grad) then
38320 J=segment%HI%JsdB
38330 allocate(rx_tang_obl(segment%HI%IsdB:segment%HI%IedB,segment%HI%JsdB:segment%HI%JedB,nz))
38340 allocate(ry_tang_obl(segment%HI%IsdB:segment%HI%IedB,segment%HI%JsdB:segment%HI%JedB,nz))
38350 allocate(cff_tangential(segment%HI%IsdB:segment%HI%IedB,segment%HI%JsdB:segment%HI%JedB,nz))
38360 do k=1,nz
38370 if (gamma_u < 1.0) then
38380 rx_tang_obl(segment%HI%IsdB,J,k) = segment%rx_norm_obl(segment%HI%isd,J,k)
38390 rx_tang_obl(segment%HI%IedB,J,k) = segment%rx_norm_obl(segment%HI%ied,J,k)
38400 ry_tang_obl(segment%HI%IsdB,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_obl(segment%HI%isd,J,k)
38410 ry_tang_obl(segment%HI%IedB,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_obl(segment%HI%ied,J,k)
38420 cff_tangential(segment%HI%IsdB,J,k) = segment%cff_normal(segment%HI%isd,J,k)
38430 cff_tangential(segment%HI%IedB,J,k) = segment%cff_normal(segment%HI%ied,J,k)
38440 do I=segment%HI%IsdB+1,segment%HI%IedB-1
38450 rx_tang_obl(I,J,k) = 0.5*(segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k) + segment%rx_norm_obl(i+1,J,k))
38460 ry_tang_obl(I,J,k) = 0.5*(segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k) + segment%ry_norm_obl(i+1,J,k))
38470 cff_tangential(I,J,k) = 0.5*(segment%cff_normal(i,J,k) + segment%cff_normal(i+1,J,k))
3848 enddo
3849 else
38500 do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
38510 dhdt = u_old(I,j+1,k)-u_new(I,j+1,k) !old-new
38520 dhdy = u_new(I,j+1,k)-u_new(I,j+2,k) !in new time backward sashay for I-1
38530 if (dhdt*(segment%grad_tan(i,1,k) + segment%grad_tan(i+1,1,k)) > 0.0) then
38540 dhdx = segment%grad_tan(i,1,k)
38550 elseif (dhdt*(segment%grad_tan(i,1,k) + segment%grad_tan(i+1,1,k)) == 0.0) then
38560 dhdx = 0.0
3857 else
38580 dhdx = segment%grad_tan(i+1,1,k)
3859 endif
38600 if (dhdt*dhdy < 0.0) dhdt = 0.0
38610 cff_new = max((dhdx*dhdx) + (dhdy*dhdy), eps)
38620 ry_new = min(dhdt*dhdy, cff_new*ry_max)
38630 rx_new = min(cff_new,max(dhdt*dhdx,-cff_new))
38640 rx_tang_obl(I,J,k) = rx_new
38650 ry_tang_obl(I,J,k) = ry_new
38660 cff_tangential(I,J,k) = cff_new
3867 enddo
3868 endif
3869 enddo
38700 if (segment%oblique_tan) then
38710 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
38720 rx_avg = rx_tang_obl(I,J,k)
38730 ry_avg = ry_tang_obl(I,J,k)
38740 cff_avg = cff_tangential(I,J,k)
3875 segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) = ((cff_avg*u_new(I,j+1,k) + ry_avg*u_new(I,j+2,k)) - &
3876 (max(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_tan(i,2,k) + &
3877 min(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_tan(i+1,2,k)) ) / &
38780 (cff_avg + ry_avg)
3879 enddo ; enddo
3880 endif
38810 if (segment%nudged_tan) then
38820 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB,segment%HI%IedB
3883 ! dhdt gets set to 0 on inflow in oblique case
38840 if (ry_tang_obl(I,J,k) <= 0.0) then
38850 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
3886 else
38870 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
3888 endif
38890 gamma_2 = dt / (tau + dt)
3890 segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) + &
38910 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_tangential_vel(I,J,k)
3892 enddo ; enddo
3893 endif
38940 if (segment%oblique_grad) then
38950 Is_obc = max(segment%HI%IsdB,G%isd+1)
38960 Ie_obc = min(segment%HI%IedB,G%ied-1)
38970 do k=1,nz ; do I=segment%HI%IsdB+1,segment%HI%IedB-1
38980 rx_avg = rx_tang_obl(I,J,k)
38990 ry_avg = ry_tang_obl(I,J,k)
39000 cff_avg = cff_tangential(I,J,k)
3901 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = &
3902 ((cff_avg*(u_new(I,j+2,k) - u_new(I,j+1,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+1) + &
3903 ry_avg*(u_new(I,j+3,k) - u_new(I,j+2,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+2)) - &
3904 (max(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_gradient(i,2,k) + &
3905 min(rx_avg,0.0)*segment%grad_gradient(i+1,2,k))) / &
39060 (cff_avg + ry_avg)
3907 enddo ; enddo
3908 endif
39090 if (segment%nudged_grad) then
39100 do k=1,nz ; do J=segment%HI%JsdB,segment%HI%JedB
3911 ! dhdt gets set to 0 on inflow in oblique case
39120 if (ry_tang_obl(I,J,k) <= 0.0) then
39130 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
3914 else
39150 tau = segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
3916 endif
39170 gamma_2 = dt / (tau + dt)
3918 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = (1.0 - gamma_2) * segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) + &
39190 gamma_2 * segment%nudged_tangential_grad(I,J,k)
3920 enddo ; enddo
3921 endif
39220 deallocate(rx_tang_obl)
39230 deallocate(ry_tang_obl)
39240 deallocate(cff_tangential)
3925 endif
3926 endif
3927 enddo
3928
3929 ! Actually update u_new, v_new
39300 call open_boundary_apply_normal_flow(OBC, G, GV, u_new, v_new)
3931
39320 call pass_vector(u_new, v_new, G%Domain, clock=id_clock_pass)
3933
39340 if (OBC%debug) then
39350 sym = G%Domain%symmetric
39360 if (OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally) then
3937 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%r[xy]_normal", OBC%rx_normal, OBC%ry_normal, G%HI, &
39380 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0)
3939 endif
39400 if (OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally) then
3941 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%r[xy]_oblique_[uv]", OBC%rx_oblique_u, OBC%ry_oblique_v, G%HI, &
39420 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0/US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
3943 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%r[yx]_oblique_[uv]", OBC%ry_oblique_u, OBC%rx_oblique_v, G%HI, &
39440 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0/US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
3945 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%cff_normal_[uv]", OBC%cff_normal_u, OBC%cff_normal_v, G%HI, &
39460 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0/US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
3947 endif
39480 if ((OBC%ntr > 0) .and. allocated(OBC%tres_x) .and. allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then
39490 do m=1,OBC%ntr
39500 write(var_num,'(I3.3)') m
3951 call uvchksum("radiation_OBCs: OBC%tres_[xy]_"//var_num, OBC%tres_x(:,:,:,m), OBC%tres_y(:,:,:,m), G%HI, &
39520 haloshift=0, symmetric=sym, scalar_pair=.true., unscale=1.0)
3953 enddo
3954 endif
3955 endif
3956
39570end subroutine radiation_open_bdry_conds
3958
3959!> Applies OBC values stored in segments to 3d u,v fields
39600subroutine open_boundary_apply_normal_flow(OBC, G, GV, u, v)
3961 ! Arguments
3962 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
3963 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
3964 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
3965 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: u !< u field to update on open
3966 !! boundaries [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3967 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: v !< v field to update on open
3968 !! boundaries [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
3969 ! Local variables
3970 integer :: i, j, k, n
3971 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
3972
39730 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return ! Bail out if OBC is not available
3974
39750 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
39760 segment => OBC%segment(n)
39770 if (.not. segment%on_pe) then
39780 cycle
39790 elseif (segment%radiation .or. segment%oblique .or. segment%gradient) then
39800 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
39810 I=segment%HI%IsdB
39820 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
39830 u(I,j,k) = segment%normal_vel(I,j,k)
3984 enddo ; enddo
39850 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
39860 J=segment%HI%JsdB
39870 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
39880 v(i,J,k) = segment%normal_vel(i,J,k)
3989 enddo ; enddo
3990 endif
3991 endif
3992 enddo
3993
3994end subroutine open_boundary_apply_normal_flow
3995
3996!> Applies zero values to 3d u,v fields on OBC segments
39970subroutine open_boundary_zero_normal_flow(OBC, G, GV, u, v)
3998 ! Arguments
3999 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary control structure
4000 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4001 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
4002 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: u !< u field to update on open boundaries [arbitrary]
4003 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(inout) :: v !< v field to update on open boundaries [arbitrary]
4004 ! Local variables
4005 integer :: i, j, k, n
4006 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
4007
40080 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return ! Bail out if OBC is not available
4009
40100 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
40110 segment => OBC%segment(n)
40120 if (.not. segment%on_pe) then
40130 cycle
40140 elseif (segment%is_E_or_W) then
40150 I=segment%HI%IsdB
40160 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
40170 u(I,j,k) = 0.
4018 enddo ; enddo
40190 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
40200 J=segment%HI%JsdB
40210 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
40220 v(i,J,k) = 0.
4023 enddo ; enddo
4024 endif
4025 enddo
4026
4027end subroutine open_boundary_zero_normal_flow
4028
4029!> Calculate the tangential gradient of the normal flow at the boundary q-points.
40300subroutine gradient_at_q_points(G, GV, segment, uvel, vvel)
4031 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4032 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
4033 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< OBC segment structure
4034 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: uvel !< zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
4035 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: vvel !< meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
4036 integer :: i,j,k
4037
40380 if (.not. segment%on_pe) return
4039
40400 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
40410 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
40420 I=segment%HI%isdB
40430 do k=1,GV%ke
40440 do J=max(segment%HI%JsdB, G%HI%JsdB+1),min(segment%HI%JedB, G%HI%JedB-1)
40450 segment%grad_normal(J,1,k) = (uvel(I-1,j+1,k)-uvel(I-1,j,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I-1,J)
40460 segment%grad_normal(J,2,k) = (uvel(I,j+1,k)-uvel(I,j,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J)
4047 enddo
4048 enddo
40490 if (segment%oblique_tan) then
40500 do k=1,GV%ke
40510 do J=max(segment%HI%jsd-1, G%HI%jsd),min(segment%HI%jed+1, G%HI%jed)
40520 segment%grad_tan(j,1,k) = (vvel(i-1,J,k)-vvel(i-1,J-1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i-1,j)
40530 segment%grad_tan(j,2,k) = (vvel(i,J,k)-vvel(i,J-1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i,j)
4054 enddo
4055 enddo
4056 endif
40570 if (segment%oblique_grad) then
40580 do k=1,GV%ke
40590 do J=max(segment%HI%jsd, G%HI%jsd+1),min(segment%HI%jed, G%HI%jed-1)
4060 segment%grad_gradient(j,1,k) = (((vvel(i-1,J,k) - vvel(i-2,J,k))*G%IdxBu(I-2,J)) - &
40610 ((vvel(i-1,J-1,k) - vvel(i-2,J-1,k))*G%IdxBu(I-2,J-1))) * G%mask2dCu(I-2,j)
4062 segment%grad_gradient(j,2,k) = (((vvel(i,J,k) - vvel(i-1,J,k))*G%IdxBu(I-1,J)) - &
40630 ((vvel(i,J-1,k) - vvel(i-1,J-1,k))*G%IdxBu(I-1,J-1))) * G%mask2dCu(I-1,j)
4064 enddo
4065 enddo
4066 endif
4067 else ! western segment
40680 I=segment%HI%isdB
40690 do k=1,GV%ke
40700 do J=max(segment%HI%JsdB, G%HI%JsdB+1),min(segment%HI%JedB, G%HI%JedB-1)
40710 segment%grad_normal(J,1,k) = (uvel(I+1,j+1,k)-uvel(I+1,j,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I+1,J)
40720 segment%grad_normal(J,2,k) = (uvel(I,j+1,k)-uvel(I,j,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J)
4073 enddo
4074 enddo
40750 if (segment%oblique_tan) then
40760 do k=1,GV%ke
40770 do J=max(segment%HI%jsd-1, G%HI%jsd),min(segment%HI%jed+1, G%HI%jed)
40780 segment%grad_tan(j,1,k) = (vvel(i+2,J,k)-vvel(i+2,J-1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i+2,j)
40790 segment%grad_tan(j,2,k) = (vvel(i+1,J,k)-vvel(i+1,J-1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i+1,j)
4080 enddo
4081 enddo
4082 endif
40830 if (segment%oblique_grad) then
40840 do k=1,GV%ke
40850 do J=max(segment%HI%jsd, G%HI%jsd+1),min(segment%HI%jed, G%HI%jed-1)
4086 segment%grad_gradient(j,1,k) = (((vvel(i+3,J,k) - vvel(i+2,J,k))*G%IdxBu(I+2,J)) - &
40870 ((vvel(i+3,J-1,k) - vvel(i+2,J-1,k))*G%IdxBu(I+2,J-1))) * G%mask2dCu(I+2,j)
4088 segment%grad_gradient(j,2,k) = (((vvel(i+2,J,k) - vvel(i+1,J,k))*G%IdxBu(I+1,J)) - &
40890 ((vvel(i+2,J-1,k) - vvel(i+1,J-1,k))*G%IdxBu(I+1,J-1))) * G%mask2dCu(I+1,j)
4090 enddo
4091 enddo
4092 endif
4093 endif
40940 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
40950 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
40960 J=segment%HI%jsdB
40970 do k=1,GV%ke
40980 do I=max(segment%HI%IsdB, G%HI%IsdB+1),min(segment%HI%IedB, G%HI%IedB-1)
40990 segment%grad_normal(I,1,k) = (vvel(i+1,J-1,k)-vvel(i,J-1,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J-1)
41000 segment%grad_normal(I,2,k) = (vvel(i+1,J,k)-vvel(i,J,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J)
4101 enddo
4102 enddo
41030 if (segment%oblique_tan) then
41040 do k=1,GV%ke
41050 do I=max(segment%HI%isd-1, G%HI%isd),min(segment%HI%ied+1, G%HI%ied)
41060 segment%grad_tan(i,1,k) = (uvel(I,j-1,k)-uvel(I-1,j-1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i,j-1)
41070 segment%grad_tan(i,2,k) = (uvel(I,j,k)-uvel(I-1,j,k)) * G%mask2dT(i,j)
4108 enddo
4109 enddo
4110 endif
41110 if (segment%oblique_grad) then
41120 do k=1,GV%ke
41130 do I=max(segment%HI%isd, G%HI%isd+1),min(segment%HI%ied, G%HI%ied-1)
4114 segment%grad_gradient(i,1,k) = (((uvel(I,j-1,k) - uvel(I,j-2,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J-2)) - &
41150 ((uvel(I-1,j-1,k) - uvel(I-1,j-2,k))*G%IdyBu(I-1,J-2))) * G%mask2dCv(i,J-2)
4116 segment%grad_gradient(i,2,k) = (((uvel(I,j,k) - uvel(I,j-1,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J-1)) - &
41170 ((uvel(I-1,j,k) - uvel(I-1,j-1,k))*G%IdyBu(I-1,J-1))) * G%mask2dCv(i,J-1)
4118 enddo
4119 enddo
4120 endif
4121 else ! south segment
41220 J=segment%HI%jsdB
41230 do k=1,GV%ke
41240 do I=max(segment%HI%IsdB, G%HI%IsdB+1),min(segment%HI%IedB, G%HI%IedB-1)
41250 segment%grad_normal(I,1,k) = (vvel(i+1,J+1,k)-vvel(i,J+1,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J+1)
41260 segment%grad_normal(I,2,k) = (vvel(i+1,J,k)-vvel(i,J,k)) * G%mask2dBu(I,J)
4127 enddo
4128 enddo
41290 if (segment%oblique_tan) then
41300 do k=1,GV%ke
41310 do I=max(segment%HI%isd-1, G%HI%isd),min(segment%HI%ied+1, G%HI%ied)
41320 segment%grad_tan(i,1,k) = (uvel(I,j+2,k)-uvel(I-1,j+2,k)) * G%mask2dT(i,j+2)
41330 segment%grad_tan(i,2,k) = (uvel(I,j+1,k)-uvel(I-1,j+1,k)) * G%mask2dT(i,j+1)
4134 enddo
4135 enddo
4136 endif
41370 if (segment%oblique_grad) then
41380 do k=1,GV%ke
41390 do I=max(segment%HI%isd, G%HI%isd+1),min(segment%HI%ied, G%HI%ied-1)
4140 segment%grad_gradient(i,1,k) = (((uvel(I,j+3,k) - uvel(I,j+2,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+2)) - &
41410 ((uvel(I-1,j+3,k) - uvel(I-1,j+2,k))*G%IdyBu(I-1,J+2))) * G%mask2dCv(i,J+2)
4142 segment%grad_gradient(i,2,k) = (((uvel(I,j+2,k) - uvel(I,j+1,k))*G%IdyBu(I,J+1)) - &
41430 ((uvel(I-1,j+2,k) - uvel(I-1,j+1,k))*G%IdyBu(I-1,J+1))) * G%mask2dCv(i,J+1)
4144 enddo
4145 enddo
4146 endif
4147 endif
4148 endif
4149
4150end subroutine gradient_at_q_points

4153!> Return the field number on the segment for the named field, or -1 if there is no field with that name.
41540function lookup_seg_field(OBC_seg, field)
4155 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(in) :: OBC_seg !< OBC segment
4156 character(len=32), intent(in) :: field !< The field name
4157 integer :: lookup_seg_field
4158 ! Local variables
4159 integer :: n
4160
41610 lookup_seg_field = -1
41620 do n=1,OBC_seg%num_fields
41630 if (trim(field) == OBC_seg%field(n)%name) then
41640 lookup_seg_field = n
41650 return
4166 endif

41690end function lookup_seg_field

4171!> Return the tracer index from its name
41720function get_tracer_index(OBC_seg,tr_name)
4173 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: OBC_seg !< OBC segment
4174 character(len=*), intent(in) :: tr_name !< The field name
4175 integer :: get_tracer_index, it
41760 get_tracer_index = -1
41770 it = 1
41780 do while(allocated(OBC_seg%tr_Reg%Tr(it)%t))
41790 if (trim(OBC_seg%tr_Reg%Tr(it)%name) == trim(tr_name)) then
41800 get_tracer_index = it
41810 exit
4182 endif
41830 it = it + 1
4184 enddo
41850end function get_tracer_index

4187!> Allocate segment data fields
41880subroutine allocate_OBC_segment_data(OBC, segment)
4189 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(in) :: OBC !< Open boundary structure

4191 ! Local variables
4192 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed
4193 integer :: IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
4194 integer :: IscB, IecB, JscB, JecB
4195
41960 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
41970 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
41980 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
41990 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
42000 IscB = segment%HI%IscB ; IecB = segment%HI%IecB
42010 JscB = segment%HI%JscB ; JecB = segment%HI%JecB
4202
42030 if (.not. segment%on_pe) return
4204
42050 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
4206 ! If these are just Flather, change update_OBC_segment_data accordingly
42070 allocate(segment%Htot(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)

4209 ! it is interpolated to OBC vorticity points.

42120 allocate(segment%SSH(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)

42140 if (segment%radiation) &
42150 allocate(segment%rx_norm_rad(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42160 allocate(segment%normal_vel(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42170 allocate(segment%normal_vel_bt(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)
42180 allocate(segment%normal_trans(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42190 allocate(segment%normal_trans_bt(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)
42200 allocate(segment%tidal_vn(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed), source=0.0)
42210 if (segment%nudged) &
42220 allocate(segment%nudged_normal_vel(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4223 if (segment%radiation_tan .or. segment%nudged_tan .or. &
4224 segment%specified_tan .or. segment%oblique_tan .or. &
42250 (OBC%vorticity_config == OBC_VORTICITY_COMPUTED) .or. &
4226 (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_COMPUTED)) then
42270 allocate(segment%tangential_vel(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42280 allocate(segment%tidal_vt(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
4229 endif
42300 if (segment%nudged_tan) &
42310 allocate(segment%nudged_tangential_vel(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42320 if (segment%nudged_grad) &
42330 allocate(segment%nudged_tangential_grad(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4234 if (segment%radiation_grad .or. segment%oblique_grad .or. segment%specified_grad .or. &
42350 (OBC%vorticity_config == OBC_VORTICITY_SPECIFIED) .or. &
4236 (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_SPECIFIED)) &
42370 allocate(segment%tangential_grad(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42380 if (segment%oblique) then
42390 allocate(segment%grad_normal(JsdB:JedB,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42400 allocate(segment%rx_norm_obl(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42410 allocate(segment%ry_norm_obl(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42420 allocate(segment%cff_normal(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4243 endif
42440 if (segment%oblique_tan) &
42450 allocate(segment%grad_tan(jsd-1:jed+1,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42460 if (segment%oblique_grad) &
42470 allocate(segment%grad_gradient(jsd:jed,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4248 endif
4249
42500 if (segment%is_N_or_S) then
4251 ! If these are just Flather, change update_OBC_segment_data accordingly
42520 allocate(segment%Htot(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
4253 ! Allocate dZtot with extra values at the end to avoid segmentation faults in cases where
4254 ! it is interpolated to OBC vorticity points.
42550 allocate(segment%dz(isd-1:ied+1,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42560 allocate(segment%dZtot(isd-1:ied+1,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42570 allocate(segment%SSH(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42580 allocate(segment%tidal_elev(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42590 if (segment%radiation) &
42600 allocate(segment%ry_norm_rad(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42610 allocate(segment%normal_vel(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42620 allocate(segment%normal_vel_bt(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42630 allocate(segment%normal_trans(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42640 allocate(segment%normal_trans_bt(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42650 allocate(segment%tidal_vn(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
42660 if (segment%nudged) &
42670 allocate(segment%nudged_normal_vel(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4268 if (segment%radiation_tan .or. segment%nudged_tan .or. &
4269 segment%specified_tan .or. segment%oblique_tan .or. &
42700 (OBC%vorticity_config == OBC_VORTICITY_COMPUTED) .or. &
4271 (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_COMPUTED)) then
42720 allocate(segment%tangential_vel(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42730 allocate(segment%tidal_vt(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB), source=0.0)
4274 endif
42750 if (segment%nudged_tan) &
42760 allocate(segment%nudged_tangential_vel(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42770 if (segment%nudged_grad) &
42780 allocate(segment%nudged_tangential_grad(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4279 if (segment%radiation_grad .or. segment%oblique_grad .or. segment%specified_grad .or. &
42800 (OBC%vorticity_config == OBC_VORTICITY_SPECIFIED) .or. &
4281 (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_SPECIFIED)) &
42820 allocate(segment%tangential_grad(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42830 if (segment%oblique) then
42840 allocate(segment%grad_normal(IsdB:IedB,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42850 allocate(segment%rx_norm_obl(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42860 allocate(segment%ry_norm_obl(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42870 allocate(segment%cff_normal(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
4288 endif
42890 if (segment%oblique_tan) &
42900 allocate(segment%grad_tan(isd-1:ied+1,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)
42910 if (segment%oblique_grad) &
42920 allocate(segment%grad_gradient(isd:ied,2,OBC%ke), source=0.0)

4295end subroutine allocate_OBC_segment_data

4297!> Deallocate segment data fields
42980subroutine deallocate_OBC_segment_data(segment)
4299 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< Open boundary segment
4300
43010 if (.not. segment%on_pe) return
4302
43030 if (allocated(segment%Htot)) deallocate(segment%Htot)

43050 if (allocated(segment%dZtot)) deallocate(segment%dZtot)
43060 if (allocated(segment%SSH)) deallocate(segment%SSH)

43090 if (allocated(segment%ry_norm_rad)) deallocate(segment%ry_norm_rad)
43100 if (allocated(segment%rx_norm_obl)) deallocate(segment%rx_norm_obl)
43110 if (allocated(segment%ry_norm_obl)) deallocate(segment%ry_norm_obl)
43120 if (allocated(segment%cff_normal)) deallocate(segment%cff_normal)
43130 if (allocated(segment%grad_normal)) deallocate(segment%grad_normal)
43140 if (allocated(segment%grad_tan)) deallocate(segment%grad_tan)
43150 if (allocated(segment%grad_gradient)) deallocate(segment%grad_gradient)
43160 if (allocated(segment%normal_vel)) deallocate(segment%normal_vel)
43170 if (allocated(segment%normal_vel_bt)) deallocate(segment%normal_vel_bt)
43180 if (allocated(segment%normal_trans)) deallocate(segment%normal_trans)
43190 if (allocated(segment%normal_trans_bt)) deallocate(segment%normal_trans_Bt)
43200 if (allocated(segment%tidal_vn)) deallocate(segment%tidal_vn)
43210 if (allocated(segment%tidal_vt)) deallocate(segment%tidal_vt)
43220 if (allocated(segment%nudged_normal_vel)) deallocate(segment%nudged_normal_vel)
43230 if (allocated(segment%tangential_vel)) deallocate(segment%tangential_vel)
43240 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_vel)) deallocate(segment%nudged_tangential_vel)
43250 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_grad)) deallocate(segment%nudged_tangential_grad)
43260 if (allocated(segment%tangential_grad)) deallocate(segment%tangential_grad)
4327
43280 if (associated(segment%tr_Reg)) call segment_tracer_registry_end(segment%tr_Reg)
43290 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) call segment_thickness_registry_end(segment%h_Reg)
4330
4331end subroutine deallocate_OBC_segment_data
