4333!> Set tangential velocities outside of open boundaries to silly values
4334!! (used for checking the interior state is independent of values outside
4335!! of the domain).
43360subroutine open_boundary_test_extern_uv(G, GV, OBC, u, v)
4337 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4338 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
4339 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4340 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)),intent(inout) :: u !< Zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
4341 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)),intent(inout) :: v !< Meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
4342 ! Local variables
4343 integer :: i, j, k, n
4344
43450 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
4346
43470 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
43480 do k = 1, GV%ke
43490 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S) then
43500 J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB
43510 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
43520 do I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB, OBC%segment(n)%HI%IedB
43530 u(I,j+1,k) = OBC%silly_u
4354 enddo
4355 else
43560 do I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB, OBC%segment(n)%HI%IedB
43570 u(I,j,k) = OBC%silly_u
4358 enddo
4359 endif
43600 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W) then
43610 I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
43620 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
43630 do J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB, OBC%segment(n)%HI%JedB
43640 v(i+1,J,k) = OBC%silly_u
4365 enddo
4366 else
43670 do J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB, OBC%segment(n)%HI%JedB
43680 v(i,J,k) = OBC%silly_u
4369 enddo
4370 endif
4371 endif
4372 enddo
4373 enddo
4374
4375end subroutine open_boundary_test_extern_uv
4376
4377!> Set thicknesses outside of open boundaries to silly values
4378!! (used for checking the interior state is independent of values outside
4379!! of the domain).
43800subroutine open_boundary_test_extern_h(G, GV, OBC, h)
4381 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4382 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4383 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4384 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G), SZK_(GV)),intent(inout) :: h !< Layer thickness [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4385 ! Local variables
4386 real :: silly_h ! A silly thickness for testing [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4387 integer :: i, j, k, n
4388
43890 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
4390
43910 silly_h = GV%Z_to_H * OBC%silly_h ! This rescaling is here because GV was initialized after OBC.
4392
43930 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
43940 do k = 1, GV%ke
43950 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S) then
43960 J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB
43970 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
43980 do i = OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd, OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied
43990 h(i,j+1,k) = silly_h
4400 enddo
4401 else
44020 do i = OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd, OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied
44030 h(i,j,k) = silly_h
4404 enddo
4405 endif
44060 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W) then
44070 I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
44080 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
44090 do j = OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd, OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed
44100 h(i+1,j,k) = silly_h
4411 enddo
4412 else
44130 do j = OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd, OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed
44140 h(i,j,k) = silly_h
4415 enddo
4416 endif
4417 endif
4418 enddo
4419 enddo
4420
4421end subroutine open_boundary_test_extern_h
4422
4423!> Read and remap segment data for a single field index m. This is the shared per-field subroutine
4424!! used by read_OBC_dynamics_data and read_OBC_tracer_data.
44250subroutine read_OBC_field_data(G, GV, US, OBC, segment, m, Time)
4426 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4427 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4428 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4429 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4430 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment !< Segment whose field is being read
4431 integer, intent(in) :: m !< Field index within segment%field
4432 type(time_type), intent(in) :: Time !< Model time
4433
4434 ! Local variables
4435 integer :: i, j
4436 integer :: IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
4437 real, dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: tmp_buffer_in => NULL() ! Unrotated input [various units]
44380 real, dimension(:,:,:), allocatable, target :: tmp_buffer ! A buffer for input data [various units]
44390 real :: dz_stack(SZK_(GV)) ! Distance between the interfaces at corner points [Z ~> m]
4440 integer :: ni_seg, nj_seg ! number of src gridpoints along the segments
4441 integer :: ni_buf, nj_buf ! Number of filled values in tmp_buffer
4442 integer :: i_seg_offset, j_seg_offset, bug_offset
4443 real :: net_dz_src ! Total vertical extent of the incoming flow in the source field [Z ~> m]
4444 real :: net_dz_int ! Total vertical extent of the incoming flow in the model [Z ~> m]
4445 real :: scl_fac ! A scaling factor to compensate for differences in total thicknesses [nondim]
4446 integer :: turns ! Number of index quarter turns
4447 logical :: flip_buffer ! If true, the input buffer needs to be transposed
4448
44490 if (segment%field(m)%required .and. (.not. allocated(segment%field(m)%buffer_dst))) &
44500 call MOM_error(FATAL, 'buffer_dst not allocated')
4451
44520 if (.not. segment%field(m)%use_IO) return
4453
44540 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
44550 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
4456
44570 ni_seg = segment%ie_obc - segment%is_obc + 1 ! Global number of q points
44580 nj_seg = segment%je_obc - segment%js_obc + 1 ! Global number of q points
44590 i_seg_offset = G%idg_offset - segment%HI%IsgB
44600 j_seg_offset = G%jdg_offset - segment%HI%JsgB
4461
44620 turns = modulo(G%HI%turns, 4)
4463
4464 ! read source data interpolated to the current model time
4465 ! NOTE: buffer is sized for vertex points, but may be used for faces
44660 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
44670 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode) then
44680 allocate(tmp_buffer(1,nj_seg*2-1,segment%field(m)%nk_src)) ! segment data is currently on supergrid
4469 else
44700 allocate(tmp_buffer(1,nj_seg,segment%field(m)%nk_src)) ! segment data is currently on native grid
4471 endif
4472 else
44730 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode) then
44740 allocate(tmp_buffer(ni_seg*2-1,1,segment%field(m)%nk_src)) ! segment data is currently on supergrid
4475 else
44760 allocate(tmp_buffer(ni_seg,1,segment%field(m)%nk_src)) ! segment data is currently on native grid
4477 endif
4478 endif
4479
4480 ! TODO: Since we conditionally rotate a subset of tmp_buffer_in after
4481 ! reading the value, it is currently not possible to use the rotated
4482 ! implementation of time_interp_extern.
4483 ! For now, we must explicitly allocate and rotate this array.
44840 if (turns /= 0) then
44850 if (modulo(turns, 2) /= 0) then
44860 allocate(tmp_buffer_in(size(tmp_buffer, 2), size(tmp_buffer, 1), size(tmp_buffer, 3)))
4487 else
44880 allocate(tmp_buffer_in(size(tmp_buffer, 1), size(tmp_buffer, 2), size(tmp_buffer, 3)))
4489 endif
4490 else
44910 tmp_buffer_in => tmp_buffer
4492 endif
4493
4494 ! This is where the data values are actually read in.
44950 call time_interp_external(segment%field(m)%handle, Time, tmp_buffer_in, scale=segment%field(m)%scale)
4496
4497 ! NOTE: Rotation of face-points require that we skip the final value when not in brushcutter mode.
44980 if (turns /= 0) then
44990 flip_buffer = ((turns==1) .or. (turns==3))
45000 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode .or. (.not.flip_buffer)) then
45010 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in, turns, tmp_buffer)
45020 elseif (flip_buffer .and. segment%is_E_or_W .and. segment%field(m)%on_face) then
45030 nj_buf = size(tmp_buffer, 2) - 1
45040 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in(:nj_buf,:,:), turns, tmp_buffer(:,:nj_buf,:))
45050 elseif (flip_buffer .and. segment%is_N_or_S .and. segment%field(m)%on_face) then
45060 ni_buf = size(tmp_buffer, 1) - 1
45070 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in(:,:ni_buf,:), turns, tmp_buffer(:ni_buf,:,:))
4508 else
45090 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in, turns, tmp_buffer)
4510 endif
4511
4512 if (((segment%field(m)%name == 'U') .and. ((turns==1).or.(turns==2))) .or. &
4513 ((segment%field(m)%name == 'V') .and. ((turns==2).or.(turns==3))) .or. &
4514 ((segment%field(m)%name == 'Vamp') .and. ((turns==2).or.(turns==3))) .or. &
4515 ((segment%field(m)%name == 'Uamp') .and. ((turns==1).or.(turns==2))) .or. &
45160 ((segment%field(m)%name == 'DVDX') .and. ((turns==1).or.(turns==3))) .or. &
4517 ((segment%field(m)%name == 'DUDY') .and. ((turns==1).or.(turns==3))) ) then
45180 tmp_buffer(:,:,:) = -tmp_buffer(:,:,:)
4519 endif
4520 endif
4521
45220 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode) then
4523 ! In brushcutter mode, the input data includes vales at both the vorticity point nodes and
4524 ! the velocity point faces of the OBC segments. The vorticity node values are at the odd
4525 ! positions in tmp_buffer, while the faces are at the even points. The bug that is being
4526 ! corrected here is the use of the odd indexed points for both the corners and the faces.
45270 bug_offset = 0 ; if (OBC%hor_index_bug) bug_offset = -1
45280 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
45290 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4530 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45310 tmp_buffer(1, 2*(JsdB+j_seg_offset+1)-1:2*(JedB+j_seg_offset)+1:2, :)
4532 else
4533 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45340 tmp_buffer(1, 2*(JsdB+j_seg_offset+1)+bug_offset:2*(JedB+j_seg_offset):2, :)
4535 endif
4536 else
45370 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4538 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
45390 tmp_buffer(2*(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1)-1:2*(IedB+i_seg_offset)+1:2, 1, :)
4540 else
4541 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
45420 tmp_buffer(2*(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1)+bug_offset:2*(IedB+i_seg_offset):2, 1, :)
4543 endif
4544 endif
4545 else ! Not brushcutter_mode.
45460 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
45470 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4548 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45490 tmp_buffer(1,JsdB+j_seg_offset+1:JedB+j_seg_offset+1,:)
4550 else
4551 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45520 tmp_buffer(1,JsdB+j_seg_offset+1:JedB+j_seg_offset,:)
4553 endif
4554 else
45550 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4556 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
45570 tmp_buffer(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1:IedB+i_seg_offset+1,1,:)
4558 else
4559 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
45600 tmp_buffer(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1:IedB+i_seg_offset,1,:)
4561 endif
4562 endif
4563 endif
4564
4565 ! no dz for tidal variables
45660 if (segment%field(m)%nk_src <= 1) then ! This is 2-d data with no remapping.
45670 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(:,:,1) = segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,:,1)
45680 elseif (field_is_tidal(segment%field(m)%name)) then
4569 ! The 3rd axis for tidal variables is the tidal constituent, so there is no remapping.
45700 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(:,:,:) = segment%field(m)%buffer_src(:,:,:)
4571 else
4572 ! Read in 3-d data that may need to be remapped onto the new grid
4573 ! This is also where the 2-d tidal data values (apart from phase and amp) are actually read in.
45740 call time_interp_external(segment%field(m)%dz_handle, Time, tmp_buffer_in, scale=US%m_to_Z)
4575
45760 if (turns /= 0) then
45770 flip_buffer = ((turns==1) .or. (turns==3))
45780 if (flip_buffer .and. segment%is_E_or_W .and. segment%field(m)%on_face) then
45790 nj_buf = size(tmp_buffer, 2) - 1
45800 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in(:nj_buf,:,:), turns, tmp_buffer(:,:nj_buf,:))
45810 elseif (flip_buffer .and. segment%is_N_or_S .and. segment%field(m)%on_face) then
45820 ni_buf = size(tmp_buffer, 1) - 1
45830 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in(:,:ni_buf,:), turns, tmp_buffer(:ni_buf,:,:))
4584 else
45850 call rotate_array(tmp_buffer_in, turns, tmp_buffer)
4586 endif
4587 endif ! End of rotation
4588
45890 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode) then
45900 bug_offset = 0 ; if (OBC%hor_index_bug) bug_offset = -1
45910 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
45920 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4593 segment%field(m)%dz_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45940 tmp_buffer(1, 2*(JsdB+j_seg_offset+1)-1:2*(JedB+j_seg_offset)+1:2, :)
4595 else
4596 segment%field(m)%dz_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
45970 tmp_buffer(1, 2*(JsdB+j_seg_offset+1)+bug_offset:2*(JedB+j_seg_offset):2, :)
4598 endif
4599 else
46000 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4601 segment%field(m)%dz_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
46020 tmp_buffer(2*(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1)-1:2*(IedB+i_seg_offset)+1:2, 1, :)
4603 else
4604 segment%field(m)%dz_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
46050 tmp_buffer(2*(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1)+bug_offset:2*(IedB+i_seg_offset):2, 1, :)
4606 endif
4607 endif
4608 else ! Not brushcutter_mode.
46090 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
46100 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4611 segment%field(m)%dz_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
46120 tmp_buffer(1,JsdB+j_seg_offset+1:JedB+j_seg_offset+1,:)
4613 else
4614 segment%field(m)%dz_src(IsdB,:,:) = &
46150 tmp_buffer(1,JsdB+j_seg_offset+1:JedB+j_seg_offset,:)
4616 endif
4617 else
46180 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4619 segment%field(m)%dz_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
46200 tmp_buffer(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1:IedB+i_seg_offset+1,1,:)
4621 else
4622 segment%field(m)%dz_src(:,JsdB,:) = &
46230 tmp_buffer(IsdB+i_seg_offset+1:IedB+i_seg_offset,1,:)
4624 endif
4625 endif
4626 endif
4627
46280 if ((.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) .and. (.not.OBC%hor_index_bug)) then
4629 ! This point is at the OBC vorticity point nodes, rather than the OBC velocity point faces.
46300 call adjustSegmentEtaToFitBathymetry(G, GV, US, segment, m, at_node=.true.)
4631 else
46320 call adjustSegmentEtaToFitBathymetry(G, GV, US, segment, m, at_node=.false.)
4633 endif
4634
46350 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
46360 I = IsdB
46370 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4638 ! Do q points for the whole segment
46390 do J = max(JsdB, G%jsd), min(JedB, G%jed-1)
4640 ! Using the h remapping approach
4641 ! Pretty sure we need to check for source/target grid consistency here
4642 !### For a concave corner between OBC segments, there are 3 thicknesses we might
4643 ! consider using.
46440 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,J,:) = 0.0 ! initialize remap destination buffer
46450 if ((G%mask2dCu(I,j) > 0.0) .or. (G%mask2dCu(I,j+1) > 0.0)) then
4646 dz_stack(:) = (1.0 / (G%mask2dCu(I,j) + G%mask2dCu(I,j+1))) * &
46470 (G%mask2dCu(I,j) * segment%dz(I,j,:) + G%mask2dCu(I,j+1) * segment%dz(I,j+1,:))
4648 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_z_CS, &
4649 segment%field(m)%nk_src, segment%field(m)%dz_src(I,J,:), &
4650 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(I,J,:), &
46510 GV%ke, dz_stack, segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,J,:))
4652 endif
4653 enddo
4654 else
46550 do j = JsdB+1, JedB
4656 ! Using the h remapping approach
4657 ! Pretty sure we need to check for source/target grid consistency here
46580 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,j,:) = 0.0 ! initialize remap destination buffer
46590 if (G%mask2dCu(I,j)>0.) then
46600 net_dz_src = sum( segment%field(m)%dz_src(I,j,:) )
46610 net_dz_int = sum( segment%dz(I,j,:) )
46620 scl_fac = net_dz_int / net_dz_src
4663 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_z_CS, &
4664 segment%field(m)%nk_src, scl_fac*segment%field(m)%dz_src(I,j,:), &
4665 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(I,j,:), &
46660 GV%ke, segment%dz(I,j,:), segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,j,:))
4667 endif
4668 enddo
4669 endif
4670 else
46710 J = JsdB
46720 if (.not.segment%field(m)%on_face) then
4673 ! Do q points for the whole segment
46740 do I = max(IsdB, G%isd), min(IedB, G%ied-1)
46750 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,J,:) = 0.0 ! initialize remap destination buffer
46760 if ((G%mask2dCv(i,J) > 0.0) .or. (G%mask2dCv(i+1,J) > 0.0)) then
4677 ! Using the h remapping approach
4678 ! Pretty sure we need to check for source/target grid consistency here
4679 dz_stack(:) = (1.0 / (G%mask2dCv(i,J) + G%mask2dCv(i+1,J))) * &
46800 (G%mask2dCv(i,J) * segment%dz(i,J,:) + G%mask2dCv(i+1,J) * segment%dz(i+1,J,:))
4681 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_z_CS, &
4682 segment%field(m)%nk_src, segment%field(m)%dz_src(I,J,:), &
4683 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(I,J,:), &
46840 GV%ke, dz_stack, segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(I,J,:))
4685 endif
4686 enddo
4687 else
46880 do i = IsdB+1, IedB
4689 ! Using the h remapping approach
4690 ! Pretty sure we need to check for source/target grid consistency here
46910 segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(i,J,:) = 0.0 ! initialize remap destination buffer
46920 if (G%mask2dCv(i,J)>0.) then
46930 net_dz_src = sum( segment%field(m)%dz_src(i,J,:) )
46940 net_dz_int = sum( segment%dz(i,J,:) )
46950 scl_fac = net_dz_int / net_dz_src
4696 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_z_CS, &
4697 segment%field(m)%nk_src, scl_fac* segment%field(m)%dz_src(i,J,:), &
4698 segment%field(m)%buffer_src(i,J,:), &
46990 GV%ke, segment%dz(i,J,:), segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(i,J,:))
4700 endif
4701 enddo
4702 endif
4703 endif
4704 endif
47050 deallocate(tmp_buffer)
47060 if (turns /= 0) deallocate(tmp_buffer_in)
47070end subroutine read_OBC_field_data
4708
4709!> Read OBC segment data for the dynamical fields, with field indices
4710!! m=1..NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-2 (U, V, gradients, SSH, and tidal constituents).
47110subroutine read_OBC_dynamics_data(G, GV, US, OBC, tv, h, Time)
4712 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4713 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4714 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4715 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4716 type(thermo_var_ptrs), intent(in) :: tv !< Thermodynamics structure
4717 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4718 intent(in) :: h !< Thickness [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4719 type(time_type), intent(in) :: Time !< Model time
4720
4721 ! Local variables
4722 integer :: n, m
4723 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
4724
47250 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
47260 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) return
4727
47280 call update_OBC_segment_dz(G, GV, US, OBC, h, tv)
4729
47300 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
47310 segment => OBC%segment(n)
4732
47330 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle ! continue to next segment if not in data domain
4734
47350 do m=1, NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-2
47360 call read_OBC_field_data(G, GV, US, OBC, segment, m, Time)
4737 enddo ! end dynamical field loop
4738 enddo ! end segment loop
4739end subroutine read_OBC_dynamics_data
4740
4741!> Read OBC segment data for tracer fields, with field indices
4742!! m=NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1..segment%num_fields (T, S, and BGC tracers).
4743!! If optional arguments h and tv are not given, it is assumed that segment%dz has been calculated
4744!! by a prior call to read_OBC_dynamics_data. Otherwise, segment%dz is recalculated with h and tv.
4745!! The optional argument include_bgc (default .true.) allows BGC fields to be read
4746!! independently.
47470subroutine read_OBC_tracer_data(G, GV, US, OBC, Time, h, tv, include_bgc)
4748 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4749 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4750 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4751 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4752 type(time_type), intent(in) :: Time !< Model time
4753 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4754 optional, intent(in) :: h !< Thickness for recomputing dz [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4755 type(thermo_var_ptrs), optional, intent(in) :: tv !< Thermodynamics structure for recomputing dz
4756 logical, optional, intent(in) :: include_bgc !< Read BGC tracers
4757
4758 ! Local variables
4759 logical :: do_bgc ! If true, read BGC tracer fields
4760 integer :: n, m
4761 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
4762
47630 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
47640 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) return
4765
47660 do_bgc = .true. ; if (present(include_bgc)) do_bgc = include_bgc
4767
47680 if (present(h) .and. present(tv)) &
47690 call update_OBC_segment_dz(G, GV, US, OBC, h, tv)
4770
47710 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
47720 segment => OBC%segment(n)
47730 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle ! continue to next segment if not in data domain
4774
47750 do m=NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1, segment%num_fields
47760 if (.not. allocated(segment%field(m)%buffer_dst)) cycle
47770 if (segment%field(m)%bgc_tracer .and. (.not. do_bgc)) cycle
47780 call read_OBC_field_data(G, GV, US, OBC, segment, m, Time)
4779 enddo ! end tracer field loop
4780 enddo ! end segment loop
47810end subroutine read_OBC_tracer_data
4782
4783!> Compute segment%dz and segment%dZtot at all OBC segments from the current layer thicknesses.
4784!! These arrays are the target vertical grid used for remapping OBC data to the model grid.
47850subroutine update_OBC_segment_dz(G, GV, US, OBC, h, tv)
4786 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4787 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4788 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4789 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4790 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
4791 intent(in) :: h !< Thickness [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4792 type(thermo_var_ptrs), intent(in) :: tv !< Thermodynamics structure
4793
4794 ! Local variables
4795 integer :: i, j, k, n
4796 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
47970 real :: dz(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)) ! Distance between interfaces around a layer [Z ~> m]
4798
47990 dz(:,:,:) = 0.0
48000 call thickness_to_dz(h, tv, dz, G, GV, US)
48010 call pass_var(dz, G%Domain)
4802
48030 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
48040 segment => OBC%segment(n)
48050 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
4806
4807 ! dZtot may extend one point past the end of the segment on the current PE for use at vorticity points
48080 segment%dZtot(:,:) = 0.0
48090 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
48100 I = segment%HI%IsdB
48110 do k=1,GV%ke ; do j=max(segment%HI%jsd-1, G%jsd), min(segment%HI%jed+1, G%jed)
48120 segment%dz(I,j,k) = dz(segment%HI%isd,j,k)
48130 segment%dZtot(I,j) = segment%dZtot(I,j) + segment%dz(I,j,k)
4814 enddo ; enddo
4815 else
48160 J = segment%HI%JsdB
48170 do k=1,GV%ke ; do i=max(segment%HI%isd-1, G%isd), min(segment%HI%ied+1, G%ied)
48180 segment%dz(i,J,k) = dz(i,segment%HI%jsd,k)
48190 segment%dZtot(i,J) = segment%dZtot(i,J) + segment%dz(i,J,k)
4820 enddo ; enddo
4821 endif
4822 enddo ! end segment loop
48230end subroutine update_OBC_segment_dz
4824
4825!> Update OBC segment dynamical fields: normal/tangential velocity, gradient, SSH, and
4826!! the thickness reservoir.
48270subroutine update_OBC_dynamics_data(G, GV, US, OBC, h, Time)
4828 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
4829 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
4830 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
4831 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
4832 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h !< Thickness [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4833 type(time_type), intent(in) :: Time !< Model time
4834
4835 ! Local variables
4836 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
4837 integer :: c, i, j, k, n, nz
4838 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
4839 integer :: is_seg, ie_seg, js_seg, je_seg ! Orientation-agnostic loop ranges
4840 integer :: i_offset_in, j_offset_in ! Indexing offset for interior cells
4841 integer :: F_G, F_VN, F_VNAMP, F_VNPHASE, F_VT, F_VTAMP, F_VTPHASE ! Field indices
4842 real :: ramp_value ! If OBC%ramp is True, where we are on the ramp from 0 to 1, or 1 otherwise [nondim].
4843 real :: time_delta ! Time since tidal reference date [T ~> s]
4844 real :: tidal_amp, tidal_phase ! Tidal amplitude [Z ~> m] and phase [rad]
4845
48460 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
48470 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) return
4848
48490 nz = GV%ke
4850
48510 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents) &
48520 time_delta = time_minus_signed(Time, OBC%time_ref, scale=US%s_to_T)
4853
48540 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
48550 segment => OBC%segment(n)
4856
48570 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle ! continue to next segment if not in data domain
4858
4859 ! Segment indices are on q points:
4860 ! | x | x | x | x | jsd/jed (if southern boundary)
4861 ! |-----------|-----------|-----------|-----------| JsdB/JedB
4862 ! IsdB isd ied IedB
4863 ! | x | x | x | x | jsd/jed (if northern boundary)
4864
48650 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied ; IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
48660 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed ; JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
48670 i_offset_in = ied - IedB ! = 0 if East, South, North; = 1 if West
48680 j_offset_in = jed - JedB ! = 0 if North, West, East ; = 1 if South
4869
48700 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
48710 is_seg = IsdB ; ie_seg = is_seg
48720 js_seg = jsd ; je_seg = jed
48730 F_VN = F_U ; F_VNAMP = F_UAMP ; F_VNPHASE = F_UPHASE
48740 F_VT = F_V ; F_VTAMP = F_VAMP ; F_VTPHASE = F_VPHASE ; F_G = F_VX
4875 else
48760 is_seg = isd ; ie_seg = ied
48770 js_seg = JsdB ; je_seg = js_seg
48780 F_VN = F_V ; F_VNAMP = F_VAMP ; F_VNPHASE = F_VPHASE
48790 F_VT = F_U ; F_VTAMP = F_UAMP ; F_VTPHASE = F_UPHASE ; F_G = F_UY
4880 endif
4881
4882 ! Update normal velocity, transport. Split by orientation for now because of G%dyCu and G%dxCv.
48830 if (allocated(segment%field(F_VN)%buffer_dst)) then
4884 ! Update tidal normal velocity
48850 segment%tidal_vn(:,:) = 0.0
48860 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents) then
48870 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
48880 tidal_amp = OBC%tide_fn(c) * segment%field(F_VNAMP)%buffer_dst(i,j,c)
4889 tidal_phase = (time_delta * OBC%tide_frequencies(c) - segment%field(F_VNPHASE)%buffer_dst(i,j,c)) &
48900 + (OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) + OBC%tide_un(c))
48910 segment%tidal_vn(i,j) = segment%tidal_vn(i,j) + tidal_amp * cos(tidal_phase)
4892 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4893 endif
4894
48950 segment%Htot(:,:) = 0.0
48960 segment%normal_trans_bt(:,:) = 0.0
48970 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
48980 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
48990 segment%Htot(i,j) = segment%Htot(i,j) + h(i+i_offset_in,j+j_offset_in,k)
49000 segment%normal_vel(i,j,k) = segment%field(F_VN)%buffer_dst(i,j,k) + segment%tidal_vn(i,j)
4901 segment%normal_trans(i,j,k) = &
49020 segment%normal_vel(i,j,k) * h(i+i_offset_in,j+j_offset_in,k) * G%dyCu(i,j)
49030 segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) = segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) + segment%normal_trans(i,j,k)
4904 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
49050 do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
4906 segment%normal_vel_bt(i,j) = segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) &
49070 / (max(segment%Htot(i,j), 1.e-12 * GV%m_to_H) * G%dyCu(i,j))
4908 enddo ; enddo
4909 else
49100 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
49110 segment%Htot(i,j) = segment%Htot(i,j) + h(i+i_offset_in,j+j_offset_in,k)
49120 segment%normal_vel(i,j,k) = segment%field(F_VN)%buffer_dst(i,j,k) + segment%tidal_vn(i,j)
4913 segment%normal_trans(i,j,k) = &
49140 segment%normal_vel(i,j,k) * h(i+i_offset_in,j+j_offset_in,k) * G%dxCv(i,j)
49150 segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) = segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) + segment%normal_trans(i,j,k)
4916 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
49170 do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
4918 segment%normal_vel_bt(i,j) = segment%normal_trans_bt(i,j) &
49190 / (max(segment%Htot(i,j), 1.e-12 * GV%m_to_H) * G%dxCv(i,j))
4920 enddo ; enddo
4921 endif
4922
49230 if (allocated(segment%nudged_normal_vel)) then
49240 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
49250 segment%nudged_normal_vel(i,j,k) = segment%normal_vel(i,j,k)
4926 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4927 endif
4928 endif
4929
4930 ! Update tangential velocity
49310 if (allocated(segment%tangential_vel) .and. allocated(segment%field(F_VT)%buffer_dst)) then
4932 ! Update tidal tangential velocity
49330 segment%tidal_vt(:,:) = 0.0
49340 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents) then
49350 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents ; do J=JsdB,JedB ; do I=IsdB,IedB
49360 tidal_amp = OBC%tide_fn(c) * segment%field(F_VTAMP)%buffer_dst(I,J,c)
4937 tidal_phase = (time_delta * OBC%tide_frequencies(c) - segment%field(F_VTPHASE)%buffer_dst(I,J,c)) &
49380 + (OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) + OBC%tide_un(c))
49390 segment%tidal_vt(I,J) = segment%tidal_vt(I,J) + tidal_amp * cos(tidal_phase)
4940 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4941 endif
4942
49430 do k=1,nz ; do J=JsdB,JedB ; do I=IsdB,IedB
49440 segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k) = segment%field(F_VT)%buffer_dst(I,J,k) + segment%tidal_vt(I,J)
4945 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4946
49470 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_vel)) then
49480 do k=1,nz ; do J=JsdB,JedB ; do I=IsdB,IedB
49490 segment%nudged_tangential_vel(I,J,k) = segment%tangential_vel(I,J,k)
4950 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4951 endif
4952 endif
4953
4954 ! Update tangential gradient dvdx and dudy
49550 if (allocated(segment%tangential_grad) .and. allocated(segment%field(F_G)%buffer_dst)) then
49560 do k=1,nz ; do J=JsdB,JedB ; do I=IsdB,IedB
49570 segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k) = segment%field(F_G)%buffer_dst(I,J,k)
4958 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4959
49600 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_grad)) then
49610 do k=1,nz ; do J=JsdB,JedB ; do I=IsdB,IedB
49620 segment%nudged_tangential_grad(I,J,k) = segment%tangential_grad(I,J,k)
4963 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4964 endif
4965 endif
4966
4967 ! Update SSH
49680 if (allocated(segment%field(F_Z)%buffer_dst)) then
4969 ! Update tidal SSH
49700 segment%tidal_elev(:,:) = 0.0
49710 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents) then
49720 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
49730 tidal_amp = OBC%tide_fn(c) * segment%field(F_ZAMP)%buffer_dst(i,j,c)
4974 tidal_phase = (time_delta * OBC%tide_frequencies(c) - segment%field(F_ZPHASE)%buffer_dst(i,j,c)) &
49750 + (OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) + OBC%tide_un(c))
49760 segment%tidal_elev(i,j) = segment%tidal_elev(i,j) + tidal_amp * cos(tidal_phase)
4977 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4978 endif
4979
49800 ramp_value = 1.0 ; if (OBC%ramp) ramp_value = OBC%ramp_value
49810 do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
49820 segment%SSH(i,j) = ramp_value * (segment%field(F_Z)%buffer_dst(i,j,1) + segment%tidal_elev(i,j))
4983 enddo ; enddo
4984 endif
4985
4986 ! Update thickness registry
49870 if (OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used .or. OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used) then
49880 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
49890 segment%h_Reg%h(i,j,k) = h(i+i_offset_in,j+j_offset_in,k)
4990 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
4991 endif
4992 enddo ! end segment loop
4993end subroutine update_OBC_dynamics_data
4994
4995!> Update the OBC segment tracer reservoir from segment%field(m)%buffer_dst for tracer field
4996!! indices m=NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1..segment%num_fields. The optional argument include_bgc (default
4997!! true) allows BGC fields to be updated independently.
49980subroutine update_OBC_tracer_data(OBC, include_bgc)
4999 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5000 logical, optional, intent(in) :: include_bgc !< Update BGC tracers
5001
5002 ! Local variables
5003 logical :: do_bgc ! If true, update BGC tracer fields
5004 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
5005 integer :: i, j, k, n, m, nt, nz
5006 integer :: is_seg, ie_seg, js_seg, je_seg ! Orientation-agnostic loop ranges
5007
50080 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
50090 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) return
5010
50110 do_bgc = .true. ; if (present(include_bgc)) do_bgc = include_bgc
5012
50130 nz = OBC%ke
5014
50150 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
50160 segment => OBC%segment(n)
50170 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle ! continue to next segment if not in data domain
5018
50190 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
50200 is_seg = segment%HI%IsdB ; ie_seg = is_seg
50210 js_seg = segment%HI%jsd ; je_seg = segment%HI%jed
5022 else
50230 is_seg = segment%HI%isd ; ie_seg = segment%HI%ied
50240 js_seg = segment%HI%JsdB ; je_seg = js_seg
5025 endif
5026
50270 do m=NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1, segment%num_fields ! F_T = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1 and F_S = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS
50280 if (.not. allocated(segment%field(m)%buffer_dst)) cycle
50290 if (segment%field(m)%bgc_tracer .and. (.not. do_bgc)) cycle
50300 nt = segment%field(m)%tr_index
50310 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
50320 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(i,j,k) = segment%field(m)%buffer_dst(i,j,k)
5033 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
5034 enddo ! end tracer loop
5035 enddo ! end segment loop
5036end subroutine update_OBC_tracer_data
5037
5038!> Initialize thickness and tracer reservoirs to external value.
50390subroutine initialize_OBC_segment_reservoirs(GV, OBC)
5040 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
5041 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5042
5043 ! Local variables
5044 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
5045 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
5046 integer :: is_seg, ie_seg, js_seg, je_seg, nz
5047 integer :: n, m, nt, i, j, k
5048 character(len=256) :: msg ! Error message
5049
50500 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5051
50520 nz = GV%ke
5053
50540 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
50550 segment => OBC%segment(n)
5056
50570 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
5058
50590 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied ; IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
50600 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed ; JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5061
50620 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
50630 is_seg = IsdB ; ie_seg = IedB ! = is_seg
50640 js_seg = jsd ; je_seg = jed
5065 else
50660 is_seg = isd ; ie_seg = ied
50670 js_seg = JsdB ; je_seg = JedB ! = js_seg
5068 endif
5069
5070 ! Thickness
5071 ! If the thickness reservoir has not yet been initialized, then set to external value.
50720 if (OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used .or. OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used) then
50730 if (.not. segment%h_Reg%is_initialized) then ! h_Reg may be initialized by fill_thickness_segments
50740 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
50750 segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,j,k) = segment%h_Reg%h(i,j,k)
5076 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
50770 segment%h_Reg%is_initialized = .true.
5078 endif
5079 endif
5080
5081 ! Tracers
5082 ! If the tracer reservoir has not yet been initialized, then set to external value.
50830 do m=NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1, segment%num_fields ! F_T = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS-1 and F_S = NUM_PHYS_FIELDS
50840 if ((.not. allocated(segment%field(m)%buffer_dst)) .or. &
50850 (segment%field(m)%bgc_tracer .and. (.not. OBC%update_OBC_seg_data))) cycle
50860 nt = segment%field(m)%tr_index
50870 if (.not. segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%is_initialized) then ! T/S may be initialized by fill_temp_salt_segments
50880 do k=1,nz ; do j=js_seg,je_seg ; do i=is_seg,ie_seg
50890 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%tres(i,j,k) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(i,j,k)
5090 enddo ; enddo ; enddo
50910 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%is_initialized = .true.
5092 endif
5093 enddo ! end tracer field loop
5094 enddo ! end segment loop
5095end subroutine initialize_OBC_segment_reservoirs
5096
5097!> Update the OBC ramp value as a function of time.
5098!! If called with the optional argument activate=.true., record the
5099!! value of Time as the beginning of the ramp period.
51000subroutine update_OBC_ramp(Time, OBC, US, activate)
5101 type(time_type), target, intent(in) :: Time !< Current model time
5102 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(inout) :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5103 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5104 logical, optional, intent(in) :: activate !< Specify whether to record the value of
5105 !! Time as the beginning of the ramp period
5106
5107 ! Local variables
5108 real :: deltaTime ! The time since start of ramping [T ~> s]
5109 real :: wghtA ! A temporary variable used to set OBC%ramp_value [nondim]
5110 character(len=12) :: msg
5111
51120 if (.not. OBC%ramp) return ! This indicates the ramping is turned off
5113
5114 ! We use the optional argument to indicate this Time should be recorded as the
5115 ! beginning of the ramp-up period.
51160 if (present(activate)) then
51170 if (activate) then
51180 OBC%ramp_start_time = Time ! Record the current time
51190 OBC%ramping_is_activated = .true.
51200 OBC%trunc_ramp_time = OBC%ramp_timescale ! times 3.0 for tanh
5121 endif
5122 endif
51230 if (.not.OBC%ramping_is_activated) return
51240 deltaTime = max(0., time_minus_signed(Time, OBC%ramp_start_time, scale=US%s_to_T))
51250 if (deltaTime >= OBC%trunc_ramp_time) then
51260 OBC%ramp_value = 1.0
51270 OBC%ramp = .false. ! This turns off ramping after this call
5128 else
51290 wghtA = min( 1., deltaTime / OBC%ramp_timescale ) ! Linear profile in time
5130 !wghtA = wghtA*wghtA ! Convert linear profile to parabolic profile in time
5131 !wghtA = wghtA*wghtA*(3. - 2.*wghtA) ! Convert linear profile to cosine profile
5132 !wghtA = 1. - ( (1. - wghtA)**2 ) ! Convert linear profile to inverted parabolic profile
5133 !wghtA = tanh(wghtA) ! Convert linear profile to tanh
51340 OBC%ramp_value = wghtA
5135 endif
51360 write(msg(1:12),'(es12.3)') OBC%ramp_value
51370 call MOM_error(NOTE, "MOM_open_boundary: update_OBC_ramp set OBC ramp to "//trim(msg))
5138end subroutine update_OBC_ramp
5139
5140!> register open boundary objects for boundary updates.
51410subroutine register_OBC(name, param_file, Reg)
5142 character(len=32), intent(in) :: name !< OBC name used for error messages
5143 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< file to parse for model parameter values
5144 type(OBC_registry_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to the tracer registry
5145 integer :: nobc
5146 character(len=256) :: mesg ! Message for error messages.
5147
51480 if (.not. associated(Reg)) call OBC_registry_init(param_file, Reg)
5149
51500 if (Reg%nobc>=MAX_FIELDS_) then
5151 write(mesg, '("Increase MAX_FIELDS_ in MOM_memory.h to at least ",I0," to allow for &
51520 &all the open boundaries being registered via register_OBC.")') Reg%nobc+1
51530 call MOM_error(FATAL,"MOM register_OBC: "//mesg)
5154 endif
51550 Reg%nobc = Reg%nobc + 1
51560 nobc = Reg%nobc
5157
51580 Reg%OB(nobc)%name = name
5159
51600 if (Reg%locked) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
5161 "MOM register_OBC was called for OBC "//trim(Reg%OB(nobc)%name)//&
51620 " with a locked OBC registry.")
5163
51640end subroutine register_OBC
5165
5166!> This routine include declares and sets the variable "version".
51670subroutine OBC_registry_init(param_file, Reg)
5168 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< open file to parse for model parameters
5169 type(OBC_registry_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to OBC registry
5170
5171 integer, save :: init_calls = 0
5172
5173# include "version_variable.h"
5174 character(len=256) :: mesg ! Message for error messages.
5175
51760 if (.not.associated(Reg)) then ; allocate(Reg)
51770 else ; return ; endif
5178
5179 ! Read all relevant parameters and write them to the model log.
5180! call log_version(param_file, mdl, version, "")
5181
51820 init_calls = init_calls + 1
51830 if (init_calls > 1) then
51840 write(mesg,'("OBC_registry_init called ",I0," times with different registry pointers.")') init_calls
51850 if (is_root_pe()) call MOM_error(WARNING,"MOM_open_boundary: "//trim(mesg))
5186 endif
5187
5188end subroutine OBC_registry_init
5189
5190!> Add file to OBC registry.
51910function register_file_OBC(param_file, CS, US, OBC_Reg)
5192 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< parameter file.
5193 type(file_OBC_CS), pointer :: CS !< file control structure.

5246!> Initialize all the segment thickness reservoirs.
52470subroutine segment_thickness_reservoir_init(GV, US, OBC, param_file)
5248 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< open file to parse for model parameters
5249 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5250 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling type
5251 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5252! real, optional, intent(in) :: OBC_scalar !< If present, use scalar value for segment tracer
5253! !! inflow concentration, including any rescaling to
5254! !! put the tracer concentration into its internal units,
5255! !! like [S ~> ppt] for salinity.
5256! logical, optional, intent(in) :: OBC_array !< If true, use array values for segment tracer
5257! !! inflow concentration.
5258! Local variables
5259 real :: rescale ! A multiplicatively corrected scaling factor, in units like [S ppt-1 ~> 1] for
5260 ! salinity, or other various units depending on what rescaling has occurred previously.
5261 integer :: nseg, m, isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
5262 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5263 integer, save :: init_calls = 0
5264
5265! This include declares and sets the variable "version".
5266# include "version_variable.h"
5267 character(len=40) :: mdl = "segment_thickness_reservoir_init" ! This routine's name.
5268
52690 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5270
52710 do nseg=1, OBC%number_of_segments
52720 segment=>OBC%segment(nseg)
52730 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
5274
52750 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) &
52760 call MOM_error(FATAL,"segment_thickness_reservoir_init: thickness array was previously allocated")
52770 allocate(segment%h_Reg)
5278
52790 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
52800 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
52810 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
52820 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5283
52840 segment%h_Reg%scale = US%Z_to_m
52850 do m=1,segment%num_fields
52860 if (uppercase(segment%field(m)%name) == uppercase(segment%h_Reg%name)) then
52870 if (.not. segment%field(m)%use_IO) then
52880 rescale = 1.0
52890 if ((segment%field(m)%scale /= 0.0) .and. (segment%field(m)%scale /= 1.0)) &
52900 rescale = 1.0 / segment%field(m)%scale
52910 segment%field(m)%value = rescale * segment%field(m)%value
5292 endif
5293 endif
5294 enddo
5295
52960 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
52970 allocate(segment%h_Reg%h(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,1:GV%ke), source=0.0)
52980 allocate(segment%h_Reg%h_res(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,1:GV%ke), source=0.0)
52990 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
53000 allocate(segment%h_Reg%h(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,1:GV%ke), source=0.0)
53010 allocate(segment%h_Reg%h_res(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,1:GV%ke), source=0.0)
5302 endif
53030 segment%h_Reg%is_initialized = .false.
5304
53050 init_calls = init_calls + 1
5306
5307 ! Read all relevant parameters and write them to the model log.
53080 if (init_calls == 1) call log_version(param_file, mdl, version, "")
5309 enddo
5310
5311end subroutine segment_thickness_reservoir_init
5312
5313!> Register a tracer on an OBC segment, allocate its t and tres arrays, and set the
5314!! per-tracer inverse length scales (I_Lscale_in/out) that control reservoir relaxation.
53150subroutine register_segment_tracer(tr_ptr, ntr_index, param_file, GV, segment, OBC_scalar, &
5316 scale, resrv_lfac_in, resrv_lfac_out)
5317 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5318 type(tracer_type), target :: tr_ptr !< Tracer to register; must persist in the caller's
5319 !! control structure for the lifetime of the segment.
5320 integer, intent(in) :: ntr_index !< index of segment tracer in the global tracer registry
5321 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< file to parse for model parameter values
5322 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< current segment data structure
5323 real, optional, intent(in) :: OBC_scalar !< If present, use this spatially uniform value as the
5324 !! OBC inflow concentration in the tracer's internal
5325 !! units, like [S ~> ppt] for salinity. Mutually
5326 !! exclusive with resrv_lfac_in and resrv_lfac_out.
5327 real, optional, intent(in) :: scale !< A scaling factor that should be used with any
5328 !! data that is read in to convert it to the internal
5329 !! units of this tracer, in units like [S ppt-1 ~> 1]
5330 !! for salinity.
5331 real, optional, intent(in) :: resrv_lfac_in !< Per-tracer multiplier for the inward reservoir
5332 !! relaxation length scale [nondim].
5333 real, optional, intent(in) :: resrv_lfac_out !< Per-tracer multiplier for the outward reservoir
5334 !! relaxation length scale [nondim].
5335
5336 ! Local variables
5337 real :: rescale ! A multiplicatively corrected scaling factor, in units like [S ppt-1 ~> 1] for
5338 ! salinity, or other various units depending on what rescaling has occurred previously.
5339 integer :: ntseg, m, isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
5340 character(len=256) :: mesg ! Message for error messages.
5341 real :: init_value ! Initial tracer concentration in OBC-rescaled units [A ~> a]
5342
53430 if (present(OBC_scalar) .and. (present(resrv_lfac_in) .or. present(resrv_lfac_out))) &
5344 call MOM_error(FATAL, "register_segment_tracer: OBC_scalar and resrv_lfac_in/out are "// &
53450 "mutually exclusive for tracer "//trim(tr_ptr%name))
5346
53470 call segment_tracer_registry_init(param_file, segment)
5348
53490 if (segment%tr_Reg%ntseg>=MAX_FIELDS_) then
5350 write(mesg,'("Increase MAX_FIELDS_ in MOM_memory.h to at least ",I0," to allow for &
53510 &all the tracers being registered via register_segment_tracer.")') segment%tr_Reg%ntseg+1
53520 call MOM_error(FATAL,"MOM register_segment_tracer: "//mesg)
5353 endif
53540 segment%tr_Reg%ntseg = segment%tr_Reg%ntseg + 1
53550 ntseg = segment%tr_Reg%ntseg
5356
53570 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
53580 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
53590 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
53600 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5361
53620 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%name = tr_ptr%name
53630 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%ntr_index = ntr_index
5364
53650 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%scale = 1.0
53660 if (present(scale)) then
53670 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%scale = scale
53680 do m=1,segment%num_fields
5369 ! Store the scaling factor for fields with exactly matching names, and possibly
5370 ! rescale the previously stored input values. Note that calls to register_segment_tracer
5371 ! can come before or after calls to initialize_segment_data.
53720 if (uppercase(segment%field(m)%name) == uppercase(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%name)) then
53730 if (.not. segment%field(m)%use_IO) then
53740 rescale = scale
53750 if ((segment%field(m)%scale /= 0.0) .and. (segment%field(m)%scale /= 1.0)) &
53760 rescale = scale / segment%field(m)%scale
53770 segment%field(m)%value = rescale * segment%field(m)%value
5378 endif
53790 segment%field(m)%scale = scale
5380 endif
5381 enddo
5382 endif
5383
53840 if (segment%tr_Reg%locked) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
5385 "MOM register_segment_tracer was called for variable "//trim(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%name)//&
53860 " with a locked tracer registry.")
5387
53880 if (present(OBC_scalar)) then
53890 init_value = OBC_scalar
53900 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%is_initialized = .true.
53910 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_in = 0.0
53920 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_out = 0.0
5393 else
53940 init_value = 0.0
53950 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%is_initialized = .false.
5396 ! Currently, resrv_lfac_in/out are for BGC tracers only.
53970 if (present(resrv_lfac_in)) segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_in = resrv_lfac_in
53980 if (present(resrv_lfac_out)) segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_out = resrv_lfac_out
5399 endif
5400
54010 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
54020 allocate(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%t(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,1:GV%ke), source=init_value)
54030 allocate(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%tres(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,1:GV%ke), source=init_value)
54040 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
54050 allocate(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%t(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,1:GV%ke), source=init_value)
54060 allocate(segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%tres(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,1:GV%ke), source=init_value)
5407 endif
5408
5409 ! Assign per-tracer inverse length scales from the per-tracer factor (resrv_lfac) and the
5410 ! segment-level inverse length scale (Tr_InvLscale). Three regimes for each direction:
5411 ! I_Lscale > 0 : finite relaxation length scale.
5412 ! I_Lscale = 0 : infinite length scale; reservoir does not update.
5413 ! I_Lscale = -1 : instant-update sentinel; reservoir is immediately replaced by interior or
5414 ! external values.
5415 ! For the two edge cases, resrv_lfac overrides Tr_InvLscale entirely, i.e.,
5416 ! resrv_lfac = 0 : I_Lscale = 0
5417 ! resrv_lfac = -1 : I_Lscale = -1
5418 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_in = &
54190 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_in * segment%Tr_InvLscale_in
54200 if ((segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_in == -1.0) .or. &
5421 (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_in < 0.0)) &
54220 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_in = -1.0
5423 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_out = &
54240 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_out * segment%Tr_InvLscale_out
54250 if ((segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%resrv_lfac_out == -1.0) .or. &
5426 (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_out < 0.0)) &
54270 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(ntseg)%I_Lscale_out = -1.0
54280end subroutine register_segment_tracer
5429
5430!> Clean up the segment tracer registry.
54310subroutine segment_tracer_registry_end(Reg)
5432 type(segment_tracer_registry_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to tracer registry
5433
5434 ! Local variables
5435 integer :: n
5436
54370 if (associated(Reg)) then
54380 do n=1, Reg%ntseg
54390 if (allocated(Reg%Tr(n)%t)) deallocate(Reg%Tr(n)%t)
54400 if (allocated(Reg%Tr(n)%tres)) deallocate(Reg%Tr(n)%tres)
5441 enddo
54420 deallocate(Reg)
5443 endif
54440end subroutine segment_tracer_registry_end
5445
5446!> Clean up the segment thickness object
54470subroutine segment_thickness_registry_end(Reg)
5448 type(OBC_segment_thickness_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to thickness reservoir
5449
54500 if (associated(Reg)) then
54510 if (allocated(Reg%h)) deallocate(Reg%h)
54520 if (allocated(Reg%h_res)) deallocate(Reg%h_res)
54530 deallocate(Reg)
5454 endif
54550end subroutine segment_thickness_registry_end
5456
5457!> Registers the temperature and salinity in the segment tracer registry.
54580subroutine register_temp_salt_segments(GV, US, OBC, tr_Reg, param_file)
5459 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5460 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling type
5461 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5462 type(tracer_registry_type), pointer :: tr_Reg !< Tracer registry
5463 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< file to parse for model parameter values
5464
5465 ! Local variables
5466 integer :: n, ntr_id
5467 character(len=32) :: name
5468 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5469 type(tracer_type), pointer :: tr_ptr => NULL()
5470
54710 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5472
54730 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
54740 segment => OBC%segment(n)
54750 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
5476
54770 if (associated(segment%tr_Reg)) &
54780 call MOM_error(FATAL,"register_temp_salt_segments: tracer array was previously allocated")
5479
54800 name = 'temp'
54810 call tracer_name_lookup(tr_Reg, ntr_id, tr_ptr, name)
54820 call register_segment_tracer(tr_ptr, ntr_id, param_file, GV, segment, scale=US%degC_to_C)
54830 name = 'salt'
54840 call tracer_name_lookup(tr_Reg, ntr_id, tr_ptr, name)
54850 call register_segment_tracer(tr_ptr, ntr_id, param_file, GV, segment, scale=US%ppt_to_S)
5486 enddo
5487
5488end subroutine register_temp_salt_segments
5489
5490!> Sets the OBC properties of external obgc tracers, such as their source file and field name
54910subroutine set_obgc_segments_props(OBC,tr_name,obc_src_file_name,obc_src_field_name,lfac_in,lfac_out)
5492 type(ocean_OBC_type),pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5493 character(len=*), intent(in) :: tr_name !< Tracer name
5494 character(len=*), intent(in) :: obc_src_file_name !< OBC source file name
5495 character(len=*), intent(in) :: obc_src_field_name !< name of the field in the source file
5496 real, intent(in) :: lfac_in !< factors for tracer reservoir inbound length scales [nondim]
5497 real, intent(in) :: lfac_out !< factors for tracer reservoir outbound length scales [nondim]
5498
5499 type(external_tracers_segments_props),pointer :: node_ptr => NULL() !pointer to type that keeps
5500 ! the tracer segment properties
55010 allocate(node_ptr)
55020 node_ptr%tracer_name = trim(tr_name)
55030 node_ptr%tracer_src_file = trim(obc_src_file_name)
55040 node_ptr%tracer_src_field = trim(obc_src_field_name)
55050 node_ptr%lfac_in = lfac_in
55060 node_ptr%lfac_out = lfac_out
5507 ! Reversed Linked List implementation! Make this new node to be the head of the list.
55080 node_ptr%next => OBC%obgc_segments_props
55090 OBC%obgc_segments_props => node_ptr
55100 OBC%num_obgc_tracers = OBC%num_obgc_tracers+1
55110end subroutine set_obgc_segments_props
5512
5513!> Get the OBC properties of external obgc tracers, such as their source file, field name,
5514!! reservoir length scale factors
55150subroutine get_obgc_segments_props(node, tr_name,obc_src_file_name,obc_src_field_name,lfac_in,lfac_out)
5516 type(external_tracers_segments_props),pointer :: node !< pointer to tracer segment properties
5517 character(len=*), intent(out) :: tr_name !< Tracer name
5518 character(len=*), intent(out) :: obc_src_file_name !< OBC source file name
5519 character(len=*), intent(out) :: obc_src_field_name !< name of the field in the source file
5520 real, intent(out) :: lfac_in !< multiplicative factor for inbound reservoir length scale [nondim]
5521 real, intent(out) :: lfac_out !< multiplicative factor for outbound reservoir length scale [nondim]
55220 tr_name = trim(node%tracer_name)
55230 obc_src_file_name = trim(node%tracer_src_file)
55240 obc_src_field_name = trim(node%tracer_src_field)
55250 lfac_in = node%lfac_in
55260 lfac_out = node%lfac_out
55270 node => node%next
55280end subroutine get_obgc_segments_props
5529
5530!> Registers a named tracer in the segment tracer registries for the OBC segments on which it is active.
55310subroutine register_obgc_segments(GV, OBC, tr_Reg, param_file, tr_name)
5532 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5533 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5534 type(tracer_registry_type), pointer :: tr_Reg !< Tracer registry
5535 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< file to parse for model parameter values
5536 character(len=*), intent(in) :: tr_name !< Tracer name
5537
5538 ! Local variables
5539 integer :: ntr_id
5540 integer :: n, m
5541 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5542 type(tracer_type), pointer :: tr_ptr => NULL()
5543 real :: resrv_lfac_in ! Per-tracer multiplier for the inward reservoir
5544 ! relaxation length scale [nondim].
5545 real :: resrv_lfac_out ! Per-tracer multiplier for the outward reservoir
5546 ! relaxation length scale [nondim].
5547
55480 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5549
55500 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
55510 segment => OBC%segment(n)
55520 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
55530 call tracer_name_lookup(tr_Reg, ntr_id, tr_ptr, tr_name)
55540 resrv_lfac_in = 1.0
55550 resrv_lfac_out = 1.0
55560 do m=1,segment%num_fields
55570 if (lowercase(segment%field(m)%name) == lowercase(tr_name)) then
55580 resrv_lfac_in = segment%field(m)%resrv_lfac_in
55590 resrv_lfac_out = segment%field(m)%resrv_lfac_out
5560 endif
5561 enddo
5562 call register_segment_tracer(tr_ptr, ntr_id, param_file, GV, segment, &
55630 resrv_lfac_in=resrv_lfac_in, resrv_lfac_out=resrv_lfac_out)
5564 enddo
55650end subroutine register_obgc_segments
5566
5567!> Stores the interior tracer values on the segment, and in some cases also sets the tracer reservoir values.
55680subroutine fill_obgc_segments(G, GV, OBC, tr_ptr, tr_name)
5569 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
5570 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5571 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5572 real, dimension(:,:,:), pointer :: tr_ptr !< Pointer to tracer field in scaled concentration
5573 !! units, like [S ~> ppt] for salinity.
5574 character(len=*), intent(in) :: tr_name !< Tracer name
5575! Local variables
5576 integer :: isd, ied, IsdB, IedB, jsd, jed, JsdB, JedB, n, nz, nt
5577 integer :: i, j, k
5578 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5579 real :: I_scale ! A factor that unscales the internal units of a tracer, like [ppt S-1 ~> 1] for salinity
5580
55810 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
55820 call pass_var(tr_ptr, G%Domain)
55830 nz = G%ke
55840 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
55850 segment => OBC%segment(n)
55860 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
55870 nt = get_tracer_index(segment, tr_name)
55880 if (nt < 0) then
55890 call MOM_error(FATAL,"fill_obgc_segments: Did not find tracer "// tr_name)
5590 endif
55910 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
55920 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
55930 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
55940 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5595
5596 ! Fill segments with Tracer values
55970 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
55980 I = segment%HI%IsdB
55990 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
56000 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(I,j,k) = tr_ptr(i+1,j,k)
5601 enddo ; enddo
56020 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
56030 I = segment%HI%IsdB
56040 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
56050 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(I,j,k) = tr_ptr(i,j,k)
5606 enddo ; enddo
56070 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
56080 J = segment%HI%JsdB
56090 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
56100 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(i,J,k) = tr_ptr(i,j+1,k)
5611 enddo ; enddo
56120 elseif (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
56130 J = segment%HI%JsdB
56140 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
56150 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(i,J,k) = tr_ptr(i,j,k)
5616 enddo ; enddo
5617 endif
5618
56190 if (.not.segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%is_initialized) &
56200 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%tres(:,:,:) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%t(:,:,:)
5621
56220 if (OBC%reservoir_init_bug) then
5623 ! OBC%tres_x and OBC%tres_y should not be set here, but in a subsequent call to setup_OBC_tracer_reservoirs.
5624 ! Note that fill_obgc_segments is not called for runs that start from a restart file.
56250 I_scale = 1.0
56260 if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%scale
56270 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
56280 if (allocated(OBC%tres_x)) then
56290 I = segment%HI%IsdB
56300 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
56310 OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,nt) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%tres(I,j,k)
5632 enddo ; enddo
5633 endif
5634 else ! segment%is_N_or_S
56350 if (allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then
56360 J = segment%HI%JsdB
56370 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
56380 OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,nt) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(nt)%tres(i,J,k)
5639 enddo ; enddo
5640 endif
5641 endif
5642 endif
5643
5644 enddo ! End of loop over segments.
5645
56460end subroutine fill_obgc_segments
5647
5648!> Set the value of temperatures and salinities on OBC segments
56490subroutine fill_temp_salt_segments(G, GV, US, OBC, tv)
5650 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
5651 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5652 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling
5653 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5654 type(thermo_var_ptrs), intent(in) :: tv !< Thermodynamics structure
5655
5656 integer :: isd, ied, IsdB, IedB, jsd, jed, JsdB, JedB, n, nz
5657 integer :: i, j, k
5658 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5659
56600 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
56610 if (.not. associated(tv%T) .and. associated(tv%S)) return
5662 ! Both temperature and salinity fields
5663
56640 nz = GV%ke
5665
56660 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
56670 segment => OBC%segment(n)
56680 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
5669
56700 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
56710 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
56720 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
56730 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5674
5675 ! Fill with T and S values
56760 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
56770 I=segment%HI%IsdB
56780 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
56790 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
56800 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%t(I,j,k) = tv%T(i+1,j,k)
56810 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%t(I,j,k) = tv%S(i+1,j,k)
5682 else
56830 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%t(I,j,k) = tv%T(i,j,k)
56840 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%t(I,j,k) = tv%S(i,j,k)
5685 endif
5686 enddo ; enddo
5687 else
56880 J=segment%HI%JsdB
56890 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
56900 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
56910 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%t(i,J,k) = tv%T(i,j+1,k)
56920 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%t(i,J,k) = tv%S(i,j+1,k)
5693 else
56940 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%t(i,J,k) = tv%T(i,j,k)
56950 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%t(i,J,k) = tv%S(i,j,k)
5696 endif
5697 enddo ; enddo
5698 endif
56990 if (.not.segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%is_initialized) &
57000 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%tres(:,:,:) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(1)%t(:,:,:)
57010 if (.not.segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%is_initialized) &
57020 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%tres(:,:,:) = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(2)%t(:,:,:)
5703 enddo
5704
5705end subroutine fill_temp_salt_segments
5706
5707!> Set the value of temperatures and salinities on OBC segments
57080subroutine fill_thickness_segments(G, GV, US, OBC, h)
5709 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
5710 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< ocean vertical grid structure
5711 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling
5712 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5713 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2]
5714
5715 integer :: isd, ied, IsdB, IedB, jsd, jed, JsdB, JedB, n, nz
5716 integer :: i, j, k
5717 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
5718
57190 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5720 ! Both temperature and salinity fields
5721
57220 nz = GV%ke
5723
57240 do n=1, OBC%number_of_segments
57250 segment => OBC%segment(n)
57260 if (.not. segment%on_pe) cycle
5727
57280 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied
57290 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed
57300 IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
57310 JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
5732
5733 ! Fill with thickness
57340 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
57350 I=segment%HI%IsdB
57360 do k=1,nz ; do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
57370 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
57380 segment%h_Reg%h(I,j,k) = h(i+1,j,k)
5739 else
57400 segment%h_Reg%h(I,j,k) = h(i,j,k)
5741 endif
5742 enddo ; enddo
5743 else
57440 J=segment%HI%JsdB
57450 do k=1,nz ; do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
57460 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
57470 segment%h_Reg%h(i,J,k) = h(i,j+1,k)
5748 else
57490 segment%h_Reg%h(i,J,k) = h(i,j,k)
5750 endif
5751 enddo ; enddo
5752 endif
57530 if (.not.segment%h_Reg%is_initialized) then
57540 segment%h_Reg%h_res(:,:,:) = segment%h_Reg%h(:,:,:)
57550 segment%h_Reg%is_initialized = .true.
5756 endif
5757 enddo
5758
5759end subroutine fill_thickness_segments
5760
5761!> Find the region outside of all open boundary segments and
5762!! make sure it is set to land mask. Gonna need to know global land
5763!! mask as well to get it right...
57640subroutine mask_outside_OBCs(G, US, param_file, OBC)
5765 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
5766 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< Parameter file handle
5767 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
5768 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
5769
5770 ! Local variables
5771 integer :: i, j
5772 logical :: fatal_error = .False.
5773 real :: min_depth ! The minimum depth for ocean points [Z ~> m]
5774 real :: mask_depth ! The masking depth for ocean points [Z ~> m]
5775 real :: Dmask ! The depth for masking in the same units as G%bathyT [Z ~> m].
5776 integer, parameter :: cin = 3, cout = 4, cland = -1, cedge = -2
5777 character(len=256) :: mesg ! Message for error messages.
57780 real, allocatable, dimension(:,:) :: color, color2 ! For sorting inside from outside,
5779 ! two different ways [nondim]
5780
57810 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
5782
5783 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "MINIMUM_DEPTH", min_depth, &
57840 units="m", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_Z, do_not_log=.true.)
5785 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "MASKING_DEPTH", mask_depth, &
57860 units="m", default=-9999.0, scale=US%m_to_Z, do_not_log=.true.)
5787
57880 Dmask = mask_depth
57890 if (mask_depth == -9999.0*US%m_to_Z) Dmask = min_depth
5790
5791 ! The reference depth on a dyn_horgrid is 0, otherwise would need: min_depth = min_depth - G%Z_ref
5792
57930 allocate(color(G%isd:G%ied, G%jsd:G%jed), source=0.0)
57940 allocate(color2(G%isd:G%ied, G%jsd:G%jed), source=0.0)
5795
5796 ! Paint a frame around the outside.
57970 do j=G%jsd,G%jed
57980 color(G%isd,j) = cedge
57990 color(G%ied,j) = cedge
58000 color2(G%isd,j) = cedge
58010 color2(G%ied,j) = cedge
5802 enddo
58030 do i=G%isd,G%ied
58040 color(i,G%jsd) = cedge
58050 color(i,G%jed) = cedge
58060 color2(i,G%jsd) = cedge
58070 color2(i,G%jed) = cedge
5808 enddo
5809
5810 ! Set color to cland in the land. Note that this is before the land
5811 ! mask has been initialized, set mask values based on depth.
58120 do j=G%jsd,G%jed
58130 do i=G%isd,G%ied
58140 if (G%bathyT(i,j) <= min_depth) color(i,j) = cland
58150 if (G%bathyT(i,j) <= min_depth) color2(i,j) = cland
5816 enddo
5817 enddo
5818
58190 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do i=G%IsdB+1,G%IedB-1
58200 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) < 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_W
58210 if (color(i,j) == 0.0) color(i,j) = cout
58220 if (color(i+1,j) == 0.0) color(i+1,j) = cin
58230 elseif (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) > 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_E
58240 if (color(i,j) == 0.0) color(i,j) = cin
58250 if (color(i+1,j) == 0.0) color(i+1,j) = cout
5826 endif
5827 enddo ; enddo
58280 do J=G%JsdB+1,G%JedB-1 ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
58290 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) < 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_S
58300 if (color(i,j) == 0.0) color(i,j) = cout
58310 if (color(i,j+1) == 0.0) color(i,j+1) = cin
58320 elseif (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) > 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_N
58330 if (color(i,j) == 0.0) color(i,j) = cin
58340 if (color(i,j+1) == 0.0) color(i,j+1) = cout
5835 endif
5836 enddo ; enddo
5837
58380 do J=G%JsdB+1,G%JedB-1 ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
58390 if (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) < 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_S
58400 if (color2(i,j) == 0.0) color2(i,j) = cout
58410 if (color2(i,j+1) == 0.0) color2(i,j+1) = cin
58420 elseif (OBC%segnum_v(i,J) > 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_N
58430 if (color2(i,j) == 0.0) color2(i,j) = cin
58440 if (color2(i,j+1) == 0.0) color2(i,j+1) = cout
5845 endif
5846 enddo ; enddo
58470 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do i=G%IsdB+1,G%IedB-1
58480 if (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) < 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_W
58490 if (color2(i,j) == 0.0) color2(i,j) = cout
58500 if (color2(i+1,j) == 0.0) color2(i+1,j) = cin
58510 elseif (OBC%segnum_u(I,j) > 0) then ! OBC_DIRECTION_E
58520 if (color2(i,j) == 0.0) color2(i,j) = cin
58530 if (color2(i+1,j) == 0.0) color2(i+1,j) = cout
5854 endif
5855 enddo ; enddo
5856
5857 ! Do the flood fill until there are no more uncolored cells.
58580 call flood_fill(G, color, cin, cout, cland)
58590 call flood_fill2(G, color2, cin, cout, cland)
5860
5861 ! Use the color to set outside to min_depth on this process.
58620 do j=G%jsd,G%jed ; do i=G%isd,G%ied
58630 if (color(i,j) /= color2(i,j)) then
58640 fatal_error = .True.
5865 write(mesg,'("MOM_open_boundary: problem with OBC segments specification at ",I0,",",I0," during\n", &
58660 &"the masking of the outside grid points.")') i, j
58670 call MOM_error(WARNING,"MOM mask_outside_OBCs: "//mesg, all_print=.true.)
5868 endif
58690 if (color(i,j) == cout) G%bathyT(i,j) = Dmask
5870 enddo ; enddo
58710 if (fatal_error) call MOM_error(FATAL, &
58720 "MOM_open_boundary: inconsistent OBC segments.")
5873
58740 deallocate(color)
58750 deallocate(color2)
58760end subroutine mask_outside_OBCs
5877
5878!> flood the cin, cout values
58790subroutine flood_fill(G, color, cin, cout, cland)
5880 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< Ocean grid structure
5881 real, dimension(:,:), intent(inout) :: color !< For sorting inside from outside [nondim]
5882 integer, intent(in) :: cin !< color for inside the domain
5883 integer, intent(in) :: cout !< color for outside the domain
5884 integer, intent(in) :: cland !< color for inside the land mask
5885
5886! Local variables
5887 integer :: i, j, ncount
5888
58890 ncount = 1
58900 do while (ncount > 0)
58910 ncount = 0
58920 do j=G%jsd+1,G%jed-1
58930 do i=G%isd+1,G%ied-1
58940 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i-1,j) > 0.0) then
58950 color(i,j) = color(i-1,j)
58960 ncount = ncount + 1
5897 endif
58980 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i+1,j) > 0.0) then
58990 color(i,j) = color(i+1,j)
59000 ncount = ncount + 1
5901 endif
59020 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i,j-1) > 0.0) then
59030 color(i,j) = color(i,j-1)
59040 ncount = ncount + 1
5905 endif
59060 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i,j+1) > 0.0) then
59070 color(i,j) = color(i,j+1)
59080 ncount = ncount + 1
5909 endif
5910 enddo
5911 enddo
59120 do j=G%jed-1,G%jsd+1,-1
59130 do i=G%ied-1,G%isd+1,-1
59140 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i-1,j) > 0.0) then
59150 color(i,j) = color(i-1,j)
59160 ncount = ncount + 1
5917 endif
59180 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i+1,j) > 0.0) then
59190 color(i,j) = color(i+1,j)
59200 ncount = ncount + 1
5921 endif
59220 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i,j-1) > 0.0) then
59230 color(i,j) = color(i,j-1)
59240 ncount = ncount + 1
5925 endif
59260 if (color(i,j) == 0.0 .and. color(i,j+1) > 0.0) then
59270 color(i,j) = color(i,j+1)
59280 ncount = ncount + 1
5929 endif
5930 enddo
5931 enddo
59320 call pass_var(color, G%Domain)
59330 call sum_across_PEs(ncount)
5934 enddo
5935
59360end subroutine flood_fill
5937
