5998!> Register OBC segment data for restarts
59990subroutine open_boundary_register_restarts(HI, GV, US, OBC, Reg, param_file, restart_CS, &
6000 use_temperature)
6001 type(hor_index_type), intent(in) :: HI !< Horizontal indices
6002 type(verticalGrid_type), pointer :: GV !< Container for vertical grid information
6003 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
6004 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< OBC data structure, data intent(inout)
6005 type(tracer_registry_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to tracer registry
6006 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< Parameter file handle
6007 type(MOM_restart_CS), intent(inout) :: restart_CS !< MOM restart control structure
6008 logical, intent(in) :: use_temperature !< If true, T and S are used
6009 ! Local variables
60100 type(vardesc) :: vd(2)
6011 integer :: m
6012 character(len=100) :: mesg, var_name
6013
60140 if (.not. associated(OBC)) &
6015 call MOM_error(FATAL, "open_boundary_register_restarts: Called with "//&
60160 "uninitialized OBC control structure")
6017
6018 ! ### This is a temporary work around for restarts with OBC segments.
6019 ! This implementation uses 3D arrays solely for restarts. We need
6020 ! to be able to add 2D ( x,z or y,z ) data to restarts to avoid using
6021 ! so much memory and disk space.
60220 if (OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally) then
60230 allocate(OBC%rx_normal(HI%isdB:HI%iedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60240 allocate(OBC%ry_normal(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke), source=0.0)
6025
60260 vd(1) = var_desc("rx_normal", "gridpoint timestep-1", "Normal Phase Speed for EW radiation OBCs", 'u', 'L')
60270 vd(2) = var_desc("ry_normal", "gridpoint timestep-1", "Normal Phase Speed for NS radiation OBCs", 'v', 'L')
60280 call register_restart_pair(OBC%rx_normal, OBC%ry_normal, vd(1), vd(2), .false., restart_CS, scalar_pair=.true.)
6029 ! The rx_normal and ry_normal arrays used with radiation OBCs are currently in units of grid
6030 ! points per timestep, but if this were to be corrected to [L T-1 ~> m s-1] or [T-1 ~> s-1] to
6031 ! permit timesteps to change between calls to the OBC code, the following would be needed instead:
6032 ! vd(1) = var_desc("rx_normal", "m s-1", "Normal Phase Speed for EW radiation OBCs", 'u', 'L')
6033 ! vd(2) = var_desc("ry_normal", "m s-1", "Normal Phase Speed for NS radiation OBCs", 'v', 'L')
6034 ! call register_restart_pair(OBC%rx_normal, OBC%ry_normal, vd(1), vd(2), .false., restart_CS, &
6035 ! conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s, scalar_pair=.true.)
6036 endif
6037
60380 if (OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally) then
60390 allocate(OBC%rx_oblique_u(HI%isdB:HI%iedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60400 allocate(OBC%ry_oblique_u(HI%isdB:HI%iedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60410 allocate(OBC%cff_normal_u(HI%IsdB:HI%IedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60420 allocate(OBC%rx_oblique_v(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60430 allocate(OBC%ry_oblique_v(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60440 allocate(OBC%cff_normal_v(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke), source=0.0)
6045
60460 vd(1) = var_desc("rx_oblique_u", "m2 s-2", "X-Direction Radiation Speed Squared for EW oblique OBCs", 'u', 'L')
60470 vd(2) = var_desc("ry_oblique_v", "m2 s-2", "Y-Direction Radiation Speed Squared for NS oblique OBCs", 'v', 'L')
6048 call register_restart_pair(OBC%rx_oblique_u, OBC%ry_oblique_v, vd(1), vd(2), .false., &
60490 restart_CS, conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
60500 vd(1) = var_desc("ry_oblique_u", "m2 s-2", "Y-Direction Radiation Speed Squared for EW oblique OBCs", 'u', 'L')
60510 vd(2) = var_desc("rx_oblique_v", "m2 s-2", "X-Direction Radiation Speed Squared for NS oblique OBCs", 'v', 'L')
6052 call register_restart_pair(OBC%ry_oblique_u, OBC%rx_oblique_v, vd(1), vd(2), .false., &
60530 restart_CS, conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
6054
6055 vd(1) = var_desc("norm_oblique_u", "m2 s-2", "Denominator for normalizing EW oblique OBC radiation rates", &
60560 'u', 'L')
6057 vd(2) = var_desc("norm_oblique_v", "m2 s-2", "Denominator for normalizing NS oblique OBC radiation rates", &
60580 'v', 'L')
6059 call register_restart_pair(OBC%cff_normal_u, OBC%cff_normal_v, vd(1), vd(2), .false., &
60600 restart_CS, conversion=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
6061 endif
6062
60630 if (OBC%thickness_x_reservoirs_used) then
60640 allocate(OBC%h_res_x(HI%isdB:HI%iedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60650 if (modulo(HI%turns, 2) /= 0) then
60660 write(var_name,'("h_res_y")')
6067 call register_restart_field(OBC%h_res_x(:,:,:), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
60680 longname="Layer thickness for NS OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='v')
6069 else
60700 write(var_name,'("h_res_x")')
6071 call register_restart_field(OBC%h_res_x(:,:,:), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
60720 longname="Layer thickness for EW OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='u')
6073 endif
6074 endif
60750 if (OBC%thickness_y_reservoirs_used) then
60760 allocate(OBC%h_res_y(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke), source=0.0)
60770 if (modulo(HI%turns, 2) /= 0) then
60780 write(var_name,'("h_res_x")')
6079 call register_restart_field(OBC%h_res_y(:,:,:), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
60800 longname="Layer thickness for EW OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='u')
6081 else
60820 write(var_name,'("h_res_y")')
6083 call register_restart_field(OBC%h_res_y(:,:,:), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
60840 longname="Layer thickness for NS OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='v')
6085 endif
6086 endif
6087
60880 if (Reg%ntr == 0) return
60890 if (.not. allocated(OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used)) then
60900 OBC%ntr = Reg%ntr
60910 allocate(OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(Reg%ntr), source=.false.)
60920 allocate(OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(Reg%ntr), source=.false.)
60930 call parse_for_tracer_reservoirs(OBC, param_file, use_temperature)
6094 else
6095 ! This would be coming from user code such as DOME.
60960 if (OBC%ntr /= Reg%ntr) then
6097! call MOM_error(FATAL, "open_boundary_register_restarts: Inconsistent value for ntr")
60980 write(mesg,'("Inconsistent values for ntr ", I0," and ",I0,".")') OBC%ntr, Reg%ntr
60990 call MOM_error(WARNING, 'open_boundary_register_restarts: '//mesg)
6100 endif
6101 endif
6102
6103 ! Still painfully inefficient, now in four dimensions.
61040 if (any(OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used)) then
61050 allocate(OBC%tres_x(HI%isdB:HI%iedB,HI%jsd:HI%jed,GV%ke,OBC%ntr), source=0.0)
61060 do m=1,OBC%ntr
61070 if (OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(m)) then
61080 if (modulo(HI%turns, 2) /= 0) then
61090 write(var_name,'("tres_y_",I3.3)') m
6110 call register_restart_field(OBC%tres_x(:,:,:,m), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
61110 longname="Tracer concentration for NS OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='v')
6112 else
61130 write(var_name,'("tres_x_",I3.3)') m
6114 call register_restart_field(OBC%tres_x(:,:,:,m), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
61150 longname="Tracer concentration for EW OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='u')
6116 endif
6117 endif
6118 enddo
6119 endif
61200 if (any(OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used)) then
61210 allocate(OBC%tres_y(HI%isd:HI%ied,HI%jsdB:HI%jedB,GV%ke,OBC%ntr), source=0.0)
61220 do m=1,OBC%ntr
61230 if (OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(m)) then
61240 if (modulo(HI%turns, 2) /= 0) then
61250 write(var_name,'("tres_x_",I3.3)') m
6126 call register_restart_field(OBC%tres_y(:,:,:,m), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
61270 longname="Tracer concentration for EW OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='u')
6128 else
61290 write(var_name,'("tres_y_",I3.3)') m
6130 call register_restart_field(OBC%tres_y(:,:,:,m), var_name, .false., restart_CS, &
61310 longname="Tracer concentration for NS OBCs", units="Conc", hor_grid='v')
6132 endif
6133 endif
6134 enddo
6135 endif
6136
6137end subroutine open_boundary_register_restarts
6138
6139!> Update OBC tracer reservoirs (segment%tr_Reg%Tr%tres) using a backward-Euler implicit step,
6140!! then copy the result into OBC%tres_x / OBC%tres_y for restart I/O.
6141!!
6142!! The reservoir at each boundary cell is nudged toward the adjacent interior tracer (on outflow)
6143!! or the open-ocean boundary value (on inflow), weighted by the volume flux and the per-tracer
6144!! inverse length scale I_Lscale. Three regimes, set at registration via I_Lscale_in/out:
6145!! - **Frozen** (I_Lscale = 0): tres is unchanged every timestep.
6146!! - **Finite length scale** (I_Lscale > 0): tres relaxes toward the interior or boundary value
6147!! at a rate proportional to the flux and I_Lscale.
6148!! - **Instant update** (I_Lscale = -1): tres is immediately replaced by the interior value
6149!! (outflow) or the boundary value (inflow).
61500subroutine update_segment_tracer_reservoirs(G, GV, uhr, vhr, h, OBC, Reg)
6151 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
6152 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
6153 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: uhr !< accumulated volume/mass flux through
6154 !! the zonal face [H L2 ~> m3 or kg]
6155 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: vhr !< accumulated volume/mass flux through
6156 !! the meridional face [H L2 ~> m3 or kg]
6157 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h !< layer thickness after advection
6158 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6159 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
6160 type(tracer_registry_type), pointer :: Reg !< pointer to tracer registry
6161
6162 ! Local variables
6163 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL()
6164 integer :: dir ! Sign convention so that positive flux_to_res means flow toward the
6165 ! reservoir: -1 for W/S segments, +1 for E/N segments.
6166 real :: face_area ! Interior cell face area adjacent to the OBC boundary [H L ~> m2 or kg m-1].
6167 real :: flux_to_res ! Signed volume/mass flux directed toward the reservoir (positive = interior
6168 ! to reservoir), equals dir * uhr or dir * vhr [H L2 ~> m3 or kg].
6169 real :: resrv_lfac_out ! Per-tracer multiplier on segment%Tr_InvLscale_out for the outward
6170 ! direction [nondim].
6171 real :: resrv_lfac_in ! Per-tracer multiplier on segment%Tr_InvLscale_in for the inward
6172 ! direction [nondim].
6173 real :: L_out, L_in ! Nondimensional exchange weight = flux * InvLscale * resrv_lfac / face_area
6174 ! for the outflow (L_out >= 0) and inflow (L_in <= 0) directions [nondim].
6175 ! Active only in finite/infinite length-scale mode (mask_L = 1).
6176 real :: a_out, a_in ! In instant-update (zero length scale) mode: +1 on outflow (a_out) or
6177 ! -1 on inflow (a_in), selecting which boundary value is applied instantly
6178 ! to the reservoir. Both are 0 in finite/infinite length-scale mode, and
6179 ! a_out and a_in cannot be simultaneously non-zero [nondim].
6180 real :: mask_L_out, mask_L_in ! 1 in finite/infinite length-scale mode (activates L term);
6181 ! 0 in instant-update mode [nondim]. mask_L = 1 - mask_a.
6182 real :: mask_a_out, mask_a_in ! 1 in instant-update (zero length scale) mode (activates a term);
6183 ! 0 in finite/infinite length-scale mode [nondim].
6184 real :: fac1 ! Implicit-update denominator = 1 + L_out - L_in [nondim].
6185 real :: I_scale ! The inverse of the scaling factor for the tracers.
6186 ! For salinity the units would be [ppt S-1 ~> 1]
6187 integer :: i, j, k, m, n, nz, ntr_id
6188 integer :: is, ie, js, je, ii, ji
6189
61900 if (.not. associated(OBC)) return
61910 if (.not. OBC%OBC_pe) return
6192
61930 nz = GV%ke
6194
61950 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
61960 segment => OBC%segment(n)
61970 if (.not.(segment%on_pe .and. associated(segment%tr_Reg))) cycle
6198 ! dir switches the sign of the flow so that positive is into the reservoir
61990 if ((segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) .or. (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S)) then
62000 dir = -1
6201 else
62020 dir = 1
6203 endif
62040 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
62050 I = segment%HI%IsdB ; ii = segment%HI%isd
62060 js = segment%HI%jsd ; je = segment%HI%jed
62070 do m=1,segment%tr_Reg%ntseg
62080 ntr_id = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%ntr_index
62090 resrv_lfac_out = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%resrv_lfac_out
62100 resrv_lfac_in = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%resrv_lfac_in
62110 mask_a_in = max(0.0, -segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%I_Lscale_in) ; mask_L_in = 1.0 - mask_a_in
62120 mask_a_out = max(0.0, -segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%I_Lscale_out) ; mask_L_out = 1.0 - mask_a_out
62130 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
62140 do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je
6215 ! Calculate weights. Both a and L are nondim. Adding them together has no meaning.
6216 ! However, since they cannot be both non-zero, adding them works like a switch.
6217 ! When InvLscale_out is 0 and outflow, only interior data is applied to reservoirs
6218 ! When InvLscale_in is 0 and inflow, only nudged data is applied to reservoirs
62190 flux_to_res = dir * uhr(I,j,k)
6220 ! I_face_area would be more efficient but it changes answers.
62210 face_area = (h(ii,j,k) + GV%H_subroundoff) * G%dyCu(I,j)
62220 a_out = mask_a_out * max(0.0, sign(1.0, flux_to_res))
62230 a_in = mask_a_in * min(0.0, sign(1.0, flux_to_res))
6224 ! Below, segment%Tr_InvLscale_out * resrv_lfac_out can be replaced by segment%I_Lscale_out,
6225 ! but it changes answers.
6226 L_out = mask_L_out * G%mask2dT(ii,j) * max(0.0, &
62270 flux_to_res * segment%Tr_InvLscale_out * resrv_lfac_out / face_area)
6228 L_in = mask_L_in * G%mask2dT(ii,j) * min(0.0, &
62290 flux_to_res * segment%Tr_InvLscale_in * resrv_lfac_in / face_area)
62300 fac1 = 1.0 + (L_out - L_in)
6231 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,k) = (1.0 / fac1) * &
6232 ((1.0 - a_out + a_in) * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,k) + &
6233 ((L_out + a_out) * Reg%Tr(ntr_id)%t(ii,j,k) - &
62340 (L_in + a_in ) * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%t(I,j,k)))
6235 enddo ; enddo
62360 if (allocated(OBC%tres_x)) then ; do k=1,nz ; do j=js,je
62370 OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,k)
6238 enddo ; enddo ; endif
6239 enddo
62400 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
62410 J = segment%HI%JsdB ; ji = segment%HI%jsd
62420 is = segment%HI%isd ; ie = segment%HI%ied
62430 do m=1,segment%tr_Reg%ntseg
62440 ntr_id = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%ntr_index
62450 resrv_lfac_out = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%resrv_lfac_out
62460 resrv_lfac_in = segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%resrv_lfac_in
62470 mask_a_in = max(0.0, -segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%I_Lscale_in) ; mask_L_in = 1.0 - mask_a_in
62480 mask_a_out = max(0.0, -segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%I_Lscale_out) ; mask_L_out = 1.0 - mask_a_out
62490 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
62500 do k=1,nz ; do i=is,ie
62510 flux_to_res = dir * vhr(i,J,k)
62520 face_area = (h(i,ji,k) + GV%H_subroundoff) * G%dxCv(i,J)
62530 a_out = mask_a_out * max(0.0, sign(1.0, flux_to_res))
62540 a_in = mask_a_in * min(0.0, sign(1.0, flux_to_res))
6255 L_out = mask_L_out * G%mask2dT(i,ji) * max(0.0, &
62560 flux_to_res * segment%Tr_InvLscale_out * resrv_lfac_out / face_area)
6257 L_in = mask_L_in * G%mask2dT(i,ji) * min(0.0, &
62580 flux_to_res * segment%Tr_InvLscale_in * resrv_lfac_in / face_area)
62590 fac1 = 1.0 + (L_out - L_in)
6260 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k) = (1.0 / fac1) * &
6261 ((1.0 - a_out + a_in) * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k) + &
6262 ((L_out + a_out) * Reg%Tr(ntr_id)%t(i,ji,k) - &
62630 (L_in + a_in ) * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%t(i,J,k)))
6264 enddo ; enddo
62650 if (allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then ; do k=1,nz ; do i=is,ie
62660 OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k)
6267 enddo ; enddo ; endif
6268 enddo
6269 endif
6270 enddo
6271end subroutine update_segment_tracer_reservoirs
6272
6273!> Update the OBC thickness reservoirs after the thicknesses have been updated.
62740subroutine update_segment_thickness_reservoirs(G, GV, uhr, vhr, h, OBC)
6275 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
6276 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
6277 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: uhr !< accumulated volume/mass flux through
6278 !! the zonal face [H L2 ~> m3 or kg]
6279 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: vhr !< accumulated volume/mass flux through
6280 !! the meridional face [H L2 ~> m3 or kg]
6281 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h !< layer thickness after advection
6282 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6283 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
6284
6285 ! Local variable
6286 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment=>NULL()
6287 real :: u_L_in, u_L_out ! The zonal distance moved in or out of a cell, normalized by the reservoir
6288 ! length scale [nondim]
6289 real :: v_L_in, v_L_out ! The meridional distance moved in or out of a cell, normalized by the reservoir
6290 ! length scale [nondim]
6291 real :: fac1 ! The denominator of the expression for tracer updates [nondim]
6292 real :: I_scale ! The inverse of the scaling factor for the tracers.
6293 ! For salinity the units would be [ppt S-1 ~> 1]
6294 integer :: i, j, k, n, nz, fd_id
6295 integer :: ishift, idir, jshift, jdir
6296 real :: resrv_lfac_out ! The reservoir inverse length scale scaling factor for the outward
6297 ! direction per field [nondim]
6298 real :: resrv_lfac_in ! The reservoir inverse length scale scaling factor for the inward
6299 ! direction per field [nondim]
6300 real :: b_in, b_out ! The 0 and 1 switch for tracer reservoirs
6301 ! 1 if the length scale of reservoir is zero [nondim]
6302 real :: a_in, a_out ! The 0 and 1(-1) switch for reservoir source weights
6303 ! e.g. a_in is -1 only if b_in ==1 and uhr or vhr is inward
6304 ! e.g. a_out is 1 only if b_out==1 and uhr or vhr is outward
6305 ! It's clear that a_in and a_out cannot be both non-zero [nondim]
63060 nz = GV%ke
6307
63080 if (associated(OBC)) then ; if (OBC%OBC_pe) then ; do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
63090 segment=>OBC%segment(n)
63100 if (.not. associated(segment%h_Reg)) cycle
63110 b_in = 0.0 ; if (segment%Tr_InvLscale_in < 0.0) b_in = 1.0
63120 b_out = 0.0 ; if (segment%Tr_InvLscale_out < 0.0) b_out = 1.0
63130 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
63140 I = segment%HI%IsdB
63150 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
6316 ! ishift+I corresponds to the nearest interior tracer cell index
6317 ! idir switches the sign of the flow so that positive is into the reservoir
63180 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
63190 ishift = 1 ; idir = -1
6320 else
63210 ishift = 0 ; idir = 1
6322 endif
6323 ! Can keep this or take it out, either way
63240 if (G%mask2dT(I+ishift,j) == 0.0) cycle
6325 ! Update the reservoir thickness concentration implicitly using a Backward-Euler timestep
63260 fd_id = segment%h_Reg%fd_index
63270 if (fd_id == -1) then
63280 resrv_lfac_out = 1.0
63290 resrv_lfac_in = 1.0
6330 else
63310 resrv_lfac_out = segment%field(fd_id)%resrv_lfac_out
63320 resrv_lfac_in = segment%field(fd_id)%resrv_lfac_in
6333 endif
63340 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%h_Reg%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%h_Reg%scale
63350 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then ; do k=1,nz
6336 ! Calculate weights. Both a and u_L are nondim. Adding them together has no meaning.
6337 ! However, since they cannot be both non-zero, adding them works like a switch.
6338 ! When InvLscale_out is 0 and outflow, only interior data is applied to reservoirs
6339 ! When InvLscale_in is 0 and inflow, only nudged data is applied to reservoirs
63400 a_out = b_out * max(0.0, sign(1.0, idir*uhr(I,j,k)))
63410 a_in = b_in * min(0.0, sign(1.0, idir*uhr(I,j,k)))
6342 u_L_out = max(0.0, (idir*uhr(I,j,k))*segment%Th_InvLscale_out*resrv_lfac_out / &
63430 ((h(i+ishift,j,k) + GV%H_subroundoff)*G%dyCu(I,j)))
6344 u_L_in = min(0.0, (idir*uhr(I,j,k))*segment%Th_InvLscale_in*resrv_lfac_in / &
63450 ((h(i+ishift,j,k) + GV%H_subroundoff)*G%dyCu(I,j)))
63460 fac1 = (1.0 - (a_out - a_in)) + ((u_L_out + a_out) - (u_L_in + a_in))
6347 segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,k) = (1.0/fac1) * &
6348 ((1.0-a_out+a_in)*segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,k)+ &
6349 ((u_L_out+a_out)*h(i+ishift,j,k) - &
63500 (u_L_in+a_in)*segment%h_Reg%h(I,j,k)))
63510 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_x)) OBC%h_res_x(I,j,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,k)
6352 enddo ; endif
6353 enddo
63540 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
63550 J = segment%HI%JsdB
63560 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
6357 ! jshift+J corresponds to the nearest interior tracer cell index
6358 ! jdir switches the sign of the flow so that positive is into the reservoir
63590 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
63600 jshift = 1 ; jdir = -1
6361 else
63620 jshift = 0 ; jdir = 1
6363 endif
6364 ! Can keep this or take it out, either way
63650 if (G%mask2dT(i,j+jshift) == 0.0) cycle
6366 ! Update the reservoir tracer concentration implicitly using a Backward-Euler timestep
63670 fd_id = segment%h_Reg%fd_index
63680 if (fd_id == -1) then
63690 resrv_lfac_out = 1.0
63700 resrv_lfac_in = 1.0
6371 else
63720 resrv_lfac_out = segment%field(fd_id)%resrv_lfac_out
63730 resrv_lfac_in = segment%field(fd_id)%resrv_lfac_in
6374 endif
63750 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%h_Reg%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%h_Reg%scale
63760 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then ; do k=1,nz
63770 a_out = b_out * max(0.0, sign(1.0, jdir*vhr(i,J,k)))
63780 a_in = b_in * min(0.0, sign(1.0, jdir*vhr(i,J,k)))
6379 v_L_out = max(0.0, (jdir*vhr(i,J,k))*segment%Th_InvLscale_out*resrv_lfac_out / &
63800 ((h(i,j+jshift,k) + GV%H_subroundoff)*G%dxCv(i,J)))
6381 v_L_in = min(0.0, (jdir*vhr(i,J,k))*segment%Th_InvLscale_in*resrv_lfac_in / &
63820 ((h(i,j+jshift,k) + GV%H_subroundoff)*G%dxCv(i,J)))
63830 fac1 = (1.0 - (a_out - a_in)) + ((v_L_out + a_out) - (v_L_in + a_in))
6384 segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k) = (1.0/fac1) * &
6385 ((1.0-a_out+a_in)*segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k) + &
6386 ((v_L_out+a_out)*h(i,j+jshift,k) - &
63870 (v_L_in+a_in)*segment%h_Reg%h(i,J,k)))
63880 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) OBC%h_res_y(i,J,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k)
6389 enddo ; endif
6390 enddo
6391 endif
6392 enddo ; endif ; endif
6393
63940end subroutine update_segment_thickness_reservoirs
6395
6396!> Vertically remap the OBC tracer reservoirs and radiation rates that are filtered in time.
63970subroutine remap_OBC_fields(G, GV, h_old, h_new, OBC, PCM_cell)
6398 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
6399 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Ocean vertical grid structure
6400 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h_old !< Thickness of source grid [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6401 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), intent(in) :: h_new !< Thickness of destination grid [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6402 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< Open boundary structure
6403 logical, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
6404 optional, intent(in) :: PCM_cell !< Use PCM remapping in cells where true
6405
6406 ! Local variables
6407 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! A pointer to the various segments, used just for shorthand.
6408
64090 real :: tr_column(GV%ke) ! A column of updated tracer concentrations in internally scaled units.
6410 ! For salinity the units would be [S ~> ppt].
64110 real :: r_norm_col(GV%ke) ! A column of updated radiation rates, in grid points per timestep [nondim]
64120 real :: rxy_col(GV%ke) ! A column of updated radiation rates for oblique OBCs [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
64130 real :: h1(GV%ke) ! A column of source grid layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2]
64140 real :: h2(GV%ke) ! A column of target grid layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6415 real :: I_scale ! The inverse of the scaling factor for the tracers.
6416 ! For salinity the units would be [ppt S-1 ~> 1].
64170 logical :: PCM(GV%ke) ! If true, do PCM remapping from a cell.
6418 integer :: i, j, k, m, n, ntr, nz
6419
64200 if (.not.associated(OBC)) return
6421
64220 nz = GV%ke
64230 ntr = OBC%ntr
6424
64250 if (.not.present(PCM_cell)) PCM(:) = .false.
6426
64270 if (associated(OBC)) then ; if (OBC%OBC_pe) then ; do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
64280 segment => OBC%segment(n)
64290 if (.not.(segment%on_pe .and. associated(segment%tr_Reg))) cycle
6430
64310 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
64320 I = segment%HI%IsdB
64330 do j=segment%HI%jsd,segment%HI%jed
6434
6435 ! Store a column of the start and final grids
64360 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
64370 if (G%mask2dT(i+1,j) == 0.0) cycle
64380 h1(:) = h_old(i+1,j,:)
64390 h2(:) = h_new(i+1,j,:)
64400 if (present(PCM_cell)) then ; PCM(:) = PCM_cell(i+1,j,:) ; endif
6441 else
64420 if (G%mask2dT(i,j) == 0.0) cycle
64430 h1(:) = h_old(i,j,:)
64440 h2(:) = h_new(i,j,:)
64450 if (present(PCM_cell)) then ; PCM(:) = PCM_cell(i,j,:) ; endif
6446 endif
6447
6448 ! Vertically remap the reservoir tracer concentrations
64490 do m=1,segment%tr_Reg%ntseg
64500 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
6451
64520 if (present(PCM_cell)) then
6453 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,:), nz, h2, tr_column, &
64540 PCM_cell=PCM)
6455 else
64560 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,:), nz, h2, tr_column)
6457 endif
6458
6459 ! Possibly underflow any very tiny tracer concentrations to 0?
6460
6461 ! Update tracer concentrations
64620 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,:) = tr_column(:)
64630 if (allocated(OBC%tres_x)) then ; do k=1,nz
64640 OBC%tres_x(I,j,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(I,j,k)
6465 enddo ; endif
6466
6467 enddo
6468
6469 ! Vertically remap the reservoir thicknesses?
64700 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) then
64710 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then
64720 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%h_Reg%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%h_Reg%scale
6473
64740 if (present(PCM_cell)) then
6475 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,:), nz, h2, tr_column, &
64760 PCM_cell=PCM)
6477 else
64780 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,:), nz, h2, tr_column)
6479 endif
6480
6481 ! Possibly underflow any very tiny tracer concentrations to 0?
6482
6483 ! Update tracer concentrations
64840 segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,:) = tr_column(:)
64850 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_x)) then ; do k=1,nz
64860 OBC%h_res_x(I,j,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(I,j,k)
6487 enddo ; endif
6488 endif
6489 endif
6490
64910 if (segment%radiation .and. (OBC%gamma_uv < 1.0)) then
6492 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%rx_norm_rad(I,j,:), nz, h2, r_norm_col, &
64930 PCM_cell=PCM)
6494
64950 do k=1,nz
64960 segment%rx_norm_rad(I,j,k) = r_norm_col(k)
64970 OBC%rx_normal(I,j,k) = segment%rx_norm_rad(I,j,k)
6498 enddo
6499 endif
6500
65010 if (segment%oblique .and. (OBC%gamma_uv < 1.0)) then
6502 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%rx_norm_obl(I,j,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65030 PCM_cell=PCM)
65040 segment%rx_norm_obl(I,j,:) = rxy_col(:)
6505 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%ry_norm_obl(I,j,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65060 PCM_cell=PCM)
65070 segment%ry_norm_obl(I,j,:) = rxy_col(:)
6508 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%cff_normal(I,j,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65090 PCM_cell=PCM)
65100 segment%cff_normal(I,j,:) = rxy_col(:)
6511
65120 do k=1,nz
65130 OBC%rx_oblique_u(I,j,k) = segment%rx_norm_obl(I,j,k)
65140 OBC%ry_oblique_u(I,j,k) = segment%ry_norm_obl(I,j,k)
65150 OBC%cff_normal_u(I,j,k) = segment%cff_normal(I,j,k)
6516 enddo
6517 endif
6518
6519 enddo
65200 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
65210 J = segment%HI%JsdB
65220 do i=segment%HI%isd,segment%HI%ied
6523
6524 ! Store a column of the start and final grids
65250 if (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
65260 if (G%mask2dT(i,j+1) == 0.0) cycle
65270 h1(:) = h_old(i,j+1,:)
65280 h2(:) = h_new(i,j+1,:)
65290 if (present(PCM_cell)) then ; PCM(:) = PCM_cell(i,j+1,:) ; endif
6530 else
65310 if (G%mask2dT(i,j) == 0.0) cycle
65320 h1(:) = h_old(i,j,:)
65330 h2(:) = h_new(i,j,:)
65340 if (present(PCM_cell)) then ; PCM(:) = PCM_cell(i,j,:) ; endif
6535 endif
6536
6537 ! Vertically remap the reservoir tracer concentrations
65380 do m=1,segment%tr_Reg%ntseg
65390 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%scale
6540
65410 if (present(PCM_cell)) then
6542 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,:), nz, h2, tr_column, &
65430 PCM_cell=PCM)
6544 else
65450 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,:), nz, h2, tr_column)
6546 endif
6547
6548 ! Possibly underflow any very tiny tracer concentrations to 0?
6549
6550 ! Update tracer concentrations
65510 segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,:) = tr_column(:)
65520 if (allocated(OBC%tres_y)) then ; do k=1,nz
65530 OBC%tres_y(i,J,k,m) = I_scale * segment%tr_Reg%Tr(m)%tres(i,J,k)
6554 enddo ; endif
6555
6556 enddo
6557
6558 ! Vertically remap the reservoir thicknesses?
65590 if (associated(segment%h_Reg)) then
65600 if (allocated(segment%h_Reg%h_res)) then
65610 I_scale = 1.0 ; if (segment%h_Reg%scale /= 0.0) I_scale = 1.0 / segment%h_Reg%scale
6562
65630 if (present(PCM_cell)) then
6564 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,:), nz, h2, tr_column, &
65650 PCM_cell=PCM)
6566 else
65670 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,:), nz, h2, tr_column)
6568 endif
6569
6570 ! Possibly underflow any very tiny tracer concentrations to 0?
6571
6572 ! Update tracer concentrations
65730 segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,:) = tr_column(:)
65740 if (allocated(OBC%h_res_y)) then ; do k=1,nz
65750 OBC%h_res_y(i,J,k) = I_scale * segment%h_Reg%h_res(i,J,k)
6576 enddo ; endif
6577 endif
6578 endif
6579
65800 if (segment%radiation .and. (OBC%gamma_uv < 1.0)) then
6581 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,:), nz, h2, r_norm_col, &
65820 PCM_cell=PCM)
6583
65840 do k=1,nz
65850 segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k) = r_norm_col(k)
65860 OBC%ry_normal(i,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_rad(i,J,k)
6587 enddo
6588 endif
6589
65900 if (segment%oblique .and. (OBC%gamma_uv < 1.0)) then
6591 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65920 PCM_cell=PCM)
65930 segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,:) = rxy_col(:)
6594 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65950 PCM_cell=PCM)
65960 segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,:) = rxy_col(:)
6597 call remapping_core_h(OBC%remap_h_CS, nz, h1, segment%cff_normal(i,J,:), nz, h2, rxy_col, &
65980 PCM_cell=PCM)
65990 segment%cff_normal(i,J,:) = rxy_col(:)
6600
66010 do k=1,nz
66020 OBC%rx_oblique_v(i,J,k) = segment%rx_norm_obl(i,J,k)
66030 OBC%ry_oblique_v(i,J,k) = segment%ry_norm_obl(i,J,k)
66040 OBC%cff_normal_v(i,J,k) = segment%cff_normal(i,J,k)
6605 enddo
6606 endif
6607
6608 enddo
6609 endif
6610 enddo ; endif ; endif
66110 if (OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally) call pass_vector(OBC%rx_normal, OBC%ry_normal, G%Domain, &
66120 To_All+Scalar_Pair)
66130 if (OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally) then
66140 call do_group_pass(OBC%pass_oblique, G%Domain)
6615 endif
6616
66170end subroutine remap_OBC_fields
6618
6619
6620!> Adjust interface heights to fit the bathymetry and diagnose layer thickness.
6621!!
6622!! If the bottom most interface is below the topography then the bottom-most
6623!! layers are contracted to GV%Angstrom_Z.
6624!! If the bottom most interface is above the topography then the entire column
6625!! is dilated (expanded) to fill the void.
6626!! @remark{There is a (hard-wired) "tolerance" parameter such that the
6627!! criteria for adjustment must equal or exceed 10cm.}
66280subroutine adjustSegmentEtaToFitBathymetry(G, GV, US, segment, fld, at_node)
6629 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure
6630 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
6631 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
6632 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< OBC segment
6633 integer, intent(in) :: fld !< field index to adjust thickness
6634 logical, intent(in) :: at_node !< True this point is at the OBC nodes rather than the faces
6635
6636 integer :: i, j, k, is, ie, js, je, nz, contractions, dilations
66370 real, allocatable, dimension(:,:,:) :: eta ! Segment source data interface heights [Z ~> m]
66380 real, allocatable, dimension(:,:) :: dz_tot ! Segment total thicknesses [Z ~> m]
6639 real :: hTolerance = 0.1 !< Tolerance to exceed adjustment criteria [Z ~> m]
6640 ! real :: dilate ! A factor by which to dilate the water column [nondim]
6641 !character(len=100) :: mesg
6642
66430 hTolerance = 0.1*US%m_to_Z
6644
66450 nz = size(segment%field(fld)%dz_src,3)
6646
66470 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
66480 is = segment%HI%IsdB ; ie = segment%HI%IedB
66490 if (at_node) then ! This point is at the OBC nodes, rather than the cell face centers.
66500 Js = max(segment%Js_obc, G%jsd)
66510 Je = min(segment%Je_obc, G%jed-1)
6652 else ! Segment thicknesses are defined at cell face centers.
66530 js = segment%HI%jsd ; je = segment%HI%jed
6654 endif
6655 else ! segment%is_N_or_S
66560 js = segment%HI%jsdB ; je = segment%HI%jedB
66570 if (at_node) then ! This point is at the OBC nodes, rather than the cell face centers.
66580 is = max(segment%HI%IsdB, G%isd)
66590 ie = min(segment%HI%IedB, G%ied-1)
6660 else ! Segment thicknesses are defined at cell face centers.
66610 is = segment%HI%isd ; ie = segment%HI%ied
6662 endif
6663 endif
66640 allocate(eta(is:ie,js:je,nz+1))
66650 allocate(dz_tot(is:ie,js:je), source=0.0)
6666
66670 if (at_node) then
66680 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
66690 I = Is
66700 do J=Js,Je
66710 dz_tot(I,J) = 0.5*(segment%dZtot(I,j) + segment%dZtot(I,j+1))
6672 enddo
6673 ! Do not extrapolate past the end of a global segment.
6674 ! ### For a concave corner between segments, perhaps we should do something more sophisticated.
66750 if (Js == segment%Js_obc) dz_tot(I,Js) = segment%dZtot(I,js+1)
66760 if (Je == segment%Js_obc) dz_tot(I,Je) = segment%dZtot(I,je)
6677 else
66780 J = Js
66790 do I=Is,Ie
66800 dz_tot(I,J) = 0.5*(segment%dZtot(i,J) + segment%dZtot(i+1,J))
6681 enddo
6682 ! Do not extrapolate past the end of a global segment.
66830 if (Is == segment%Is_obc) dz_tot(Is,J) = segment%dZtot(is+1,J)
66840 if (Ie == segment%Is_obc) dz_tot(Ie,J) = segment%dZtot(ie,J)
6685 endif
6686 else
66870 do j=js,je ; do i=is,ie
66880 dz_tot(i,j) = segment%dZtot(i,j)
6689 enddo ; enddo
6690 endif
6691
66920 contractions = 0 ; dilations = 0
66930 do j=js,je ; do i=is,ie
66940 eta(i,j,1) = 0.0 ! segment data are assumed to be located on a static grid
6695 ! For remapping calls, the entire column will be dilated
6696 ! by a factor equal to the ratio of the sum of the geopotential referenced
6697 ! source data thicknesses, and the current model thicknesses. This could be
6698 ! an issue to be addressed, for instance if we are placing open boundaries
6699 ! under ice shelf cavities.
67000 do k=2,nz+1
67010 eta(i,j,k) = eta(i,j,k-1) - segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k-1)
6702 enddo
6703 ! The normal slope at the boundary is zero by a
6704 ! previous call to open_boundary_impose_normal_slope
67050 do k=nz+1,1,-1
67060 if (-eta(i,j,k) > dz_tot(i,j) + hTolerance) then
67070 eta(i,j,k) = -dz_tot(i,j)
67080 contractions = contractions + 1
6709 endif
6710 enddo
6711
67120 do k=1,nz
6713 ! Collapse layers to thinnest possible if the thickness less than
6714 ! the thinnest possible (or negative).
67150 if (eta(i,j,K) < (eta(i,j,K+1) + GV%Angstrom_Z)) then
67160 eta(i,j,K) = eta(i,j,K+1) + GV%Angstrom_Z
67170 segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) = GV%Angstrom_Z
6718 else
67190 segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) = (eta(i,j,K) - eta(i,j,K+1))
6720 endif
6721 enddo
6722
6723 ! The whole column is dilated to accommodate deeper topography than
6724 ! the bathymetry would indicate.
67250 if (-eta(i,j,nz+1) < dz_tot(i,j) - hTolerance) then
67260 dilations = dilations + 1
6727 ! expand bottom-most cell only
67280 eta(i,j,nz+1) = -dz_tot(i,j)
67290 segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,nz) = eta(i,j,nz) - eta(i,j,nz+1)
6730 ! if (eta(i,j,1) <= eta(i,j,nz+1)) then
6731 ! do k=1,nz ; segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) = (eta(i,j,1) + G%bathyT(i,j)) / real(nz) ; enddo
6732 ! else
6733 ! dilate = (eta(i,j,1) + G%bathyT(i,j)) / (eta(i,j,1) - eta(i,j,nz+1))
6734 ! do k=1,nz ; segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) = segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) * dilate ; enddo
6735 ! endif
6736 !do k=nz,2,-1 ; eta(i,j,K) = eta(i,j,K+1) + segment%field(fld)%dz_src(i,j,k) ; enddo
6737 endif
6738 enddo ; enddo
6739
6740 ! can not do communication call here since only PEs on the current segment are here
6741 ! call sum_across_PEs(contractions)
6742 ! if ((contractions > 0) .and. (is_root_pe())) then
6743 ! write(mesg,'("Thickness OBCs were contracted ",'// &
6744 ! '"to fit topography in ",I0," places.")') contractions
6745 ! call MOM_error(WARNING, 'adjustEtaToFitBathymetry: '//mesg)
6746 ! endif
6747 ! call sum_across_PEs(dilations)
6748 ! if ((dilations > 0) .and. (is_root_pe())) then
6749 ! write(mesg,'("Thickness OBCs were dilated ",'// &
6750 ! '"to fit topography in ",I0," places.")') dilations
6751 ! call MOM_error(WARNING, 'adjustEtaToFitBathymetry: '//mesg)
6752 ! endif
6753
67540 deallocate(eta, dz_tot)
6755
67560end subroutine adjustSegmentEtaToFitBathymetry
6757
6758!> This is more of a rotate initialization than an actual rotate
67590subroutine rotate_OBC_config(OBC_in, G_in, OBC, G, turns)
6760 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer, intent(in) :: OBC_in !< Input OBC
6761 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G_in !< Input grid
6762 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer, intent(inout) :: OBC !< Rotated OBC
6763 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Rotated grid
6764 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns
6765
6766 integer :: c, n, l_seg
6767
67680 if (OBC_in%number_of_segments == 0) return
6769
6770 ! Scalar and logical transfer
67710 OBC%number_of_segments = OBC_in%number_of_segments
67720 OBC%ke = OBC_in%ke
67730 OBC%user_BCs_set_globally = OBC_in%user_BCs_set_globally
6774
6775 ! These are conditionally read and set if number_of_segments > 0
67760 OBC%vorticity_config = OBC_in%vorticity_config
67770 OBC%strain_config = OBC_in%strain_config
67780 OBC%zero_biharmonic = OBC_in%zero_biharmonic
67790 OBC%silly_h = OBC_in%silly_h
67800 OBC%silly_u = OBC_in%silly_u
67810 OBC%reverse_segment_order = OBC_in%reverse_segment_order
6782
6783 ! Segment rotation
67840 allocate(OBC%segment(0:OBC%number_of_segments))
67850 do l_seg=1,OBC%number_of_segments
67860 call rotate_OBC_segment_config(OBC_in%segment(l_seg), G_in, OBC%segment(l_seg), G, turns)
6787 ! Data stored in setup_[uv]_point_obc is needed for allocate_obc_segment_data
67880 call allocate_OBC_segment_data(OBC, OBC%segment(l_seg))
6789 enddo
6790
6791 ! The horizontal segment map
67920 allocate(OBC%segnum_u(G%IsdB:G%IedB,G%jsd:G%jed), source=0)
67930 allocate(OBC%segnum_v(G%isd:G%ied,G%JsdB:G%JedB), source=0)
67940 call rotate_array_pair(OBC_in%segnum_u, OBC_in%segnum_v, turns, OBC%segnum_u, OBC%segnum_v)
67950 call set_segnum_signs(OBC, G)
6796
6797 ! These are conditionally enabled during segment configuration
67980 if (modulo(turns,2) == 0) then
67990 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%open_u_BCs_exist_globally
68000 OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%open_v_BCs_exist_globally
68010 OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally
68020 OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally
68030 OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally
68040 OBC%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally
68050 OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally
68060 OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally
6807 else ! Swap information for u- and v- OBCs
68080 OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%open_v_BCs_exist_globally
68090 OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%open_u_BCs_exist_globally
68100 OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally
68110 OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally
68120 OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally
68130 OBC%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally
68140 OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally
68150 OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally
6816 endif
68170 OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%oblique_BCs_exist_globally
68180 OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally = OBC_in%radiation_BCs_exist_globally
6819
6820 ! These are set by initialize_segment_data
68210 OBC%brushcutter_mode = OBC_in%brushcutter_mode
68220 OBC%update_OBC = OBC_in%update_OBC
68230 OBC%any_needs_IO_for_data = OBC_in%any_needs_IO_for_data
6824
68250 OBC%update_OBC_seg_data = OBC_in%update_OBC_seg_data
68260 OBC%ntr = OBC_in%ntr
68270 if (OBC%ntr > 0) then
68280 allocate(OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(OBC%ntr), source=.false.)
68290 allocate(OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(OBC%ntr), source=.false.)
68300 if (modulo(turns,2) == 0) then
68310 do n=1,OBC%ntr
68320 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(n) = OBC_in%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(n)
68330 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(n) = OBC_in%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(n)
6834 enddo
6835 else ! Swap information for u- and v- OBCs
68360 do n=1,OBC%ntr
68370 OBC%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(n) = OBC_in%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(n)
68380 OBC%tracer_y_reservoirs_used(n) = OBC_in%tracer_x_reservoirs_used(n)
6839 enddo
6840 endif
6841 endif
6842
68430 OBC%gamma_uv = OBC_in%gamma_uv
68440 OBC%rx_max = OBC_in%rx_max
68450 OBC%OBC_pe = OBC_in%OBC_pe
6846
6847 ! These are run-time parameters that are read in via open_boundary_config
68480 OBC%debug = OBC_in%debug
68490 OBC%ramp = OBC_in%ramp
68500 OBC%ramping_is_activated = OBC_in%ramping_is_activated
68510 OBC%ramp_timescale = OBC_in%ramp_timescale
68520 OBC%trunc_ramp_time = OBC_in%trunc_ramp_time
68530 OBC%ramp_value = OBC_in%ramp_value
68540 OBC%ramp_start_time = OBC_in%ramp_start_time
68550 OBC%remap_answer_date = OBC_in%remap_answer_date
68560 OBC%check_reconstruction = OBC_in%check_reconstruction
68570 OBC%check_remapping = OBC_in%check_remapping
68580 OBC%force_bounds_in_subcell = OBC_in%force_bounds_in_subcell
68590 OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells = OBC_in%om4_remap_via_sub_cells
68600 OBC%remappingScheme = OBC_in%remappingScheme
68610 OBC%exterior_OBC_bug = OBC_in%exterior_OBC_bug
68620 OBC%hor_index_bug = OBC_in%hor_index_bug
68630 OBC%ignore_dt_obc_bgc = OBC_in%ignore_dt_obc_bgc
68640 OBC%tracer_dz_bug = OBC_in%tracer_dz_bug
68650 OBC%n_tide_constituents = OBC_in%n_tide_constituents
68660 OBC%add_tide_constituents = OBC_in%add_tide_constituents
6867
6868 ! These are read in via initialize_obc_tides when n_tide_constituents > 0
68690 if (OBC%add_tide_constituents .and. (OBC%n_tide_constituents>0)) then
68700 OBC%add_eq_phase = OBC_in%add_eq_phase
68710 OBC%add_nodal_terms = OBC_in%add_nodal_terms
68720 OBC%time_ref = OBC_in%time_ref
6873
68740 allocate(OBC%tide_names(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
68750 allocate(OBC%tide_frequencies(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
68760 allocate(OBC%tide_eq_phases(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
68770 allocate(OBC%tide_fn(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
68780 allocate(OBC%tide_un(OBC%n_tide_constituents))
68790 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents
68800 OBC%tide_names(c) = OBC_in%tide_names(c)
68810 OBC%tide_frequencies(c) = OBC_in%tide_frequencies(c)
68820 OBC%tide_eq_phases(c) = OBC_in%tide_eq_phases(c)
68830 OBC%tide_fn(c) = OBC_in%tide_fn(c)
68840 OBC%tide_un(c) = OBC_in%tide_un(c)
6885 enddo
6886
68870 if (OBC%add_eq_phase .or. OBC%add_nodal_terms) &
68880 OBC%tidal_longitudes = OBC_in%tidal_longitudes
6889 endif
6890
6891end subroutine rotate_OBC_config
6892
6893!> Rotate the OBC segment configuration data from the input to model index map.
68940subroutine rotate_OBC_segment_config(segment_in, G_in, segment, G, turns)
6895 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(in) :: segment_in !< Input OBC segment
6896 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G_in !< Input grid metric
6897 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< Rotated OBC segment
6898 type(dyn_horgrid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Rotated grid metric
6899 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns
6900
6901 ! Global segment indices
6902 integer :: Is_obc_in, Ie_obc_in, Js_obc_in, Je_obc_in ! Input domain global indices
6903 integer :: Is_obc, Ie_obc, Js_obc, Je_obc ! Rotated domain global indices
6904 integer :: qturns ! The number of quarter turns in the range of 0 to 3
6905
6906 ! NOTE: A "rotation" of the OBC segment string would allow us to use
6907 ! setup_[uv]_point_obc to set up most of this. For now, we just copy/swap
6908 ! flags and manually rotate the indices.
6909
6910 ! This is set if the segment is in the local grid
69110 segment%on_pe = segment_in%on_pe
6912
69130 qturns = modulo(turns, 4)
6914
6915 ! Transfer configuration flags
69160 segment%Flather = segment_in%Flather
69170 segment%radiation = segment_in%radiation
69180 segment%radiation_tan = segment_in%radiation_tan
69190 segment%radiation_grad = segment_in%radiation_grad
69200 segment%oblique = segment_in%oblique
69210 segment%oblique_tan = segment_in%oblique_tan
69220 segment%oblique_grad = segment_in%oblique_grad
69230 segment%nudged = segment_in%nudged
69240 segment%nudged_tan = segment_in%nudged_tan
69250 segment%nudged_grad = segment_in%nudged_grad
69260 segment%specified = segment_in%specified
69270 segment%specified_tan = segment_in%specified_tan
69280 segment%specified_grad = segment_in%specified_grad
69290 segment%open = segment_in%open
69300 segment%gradient = segment_in%gradient
6931
6932 ! These are conditionally set if nudged
69330 segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in = segment_in%Velocity_nudging_timescale_in
69340 segment%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out = segment_in%Velocity_nudging_timescale_out
6935
6936 ! Rotate segment indices
6937
6938 ! Reverse engineer the input [IJ][se]_obc segment indices
6939 ! NOTE: The values stored in the segment are always saved in ascending order,
6940 ! e.g. (is < ie). In order to use setup_segment_indices, we reorder the
6941 ! indices here to indicate face direction.
6942 ! Segment indices are also indexed locally, so here we convert to global indices
69430 if (segment_in%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
69440 Is_obc_in = segment_in%Ie_obc + G_in%idg_offset
69450 Ie_obc_in = segment_in%Is_obc + G_in%idg_offset
6946 else
69470 Is_obc_in = segment_in%Is_obc + G_in%idg_offset
69480 Ie_obc_in = segment_in%Ie_obc + G_in%idg_offset
6949 endif
6950
69510 if (segment_in%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
69520 Js_obc_in = segment_in%Je_obc + G_in%jdg_offset
69530 Je_obc_in = segment_in%Js_obc + G_in%jdg_offset
6954 else
69550 Js_obc_in = segment_in%Js_obc + G_in%jdg_offset
69560 Je_obc_in = segment_in%Je_obc + G_in%jdg_offset
6957 endif
6958
6959 ! Rotate the global indices of the segment according to the number of turns.
69600 if (qturns == 0) then
69610 Is_obc = Is_obc_in ; Ie_obc = Ie_obc_in
69620 Js_obc = Js_obc_in ; Je_obc = Je_obc_in
69630 elseif (qturns == 1) then
69640 Is_obc = G_in%JegB - Js_obc_in ; Ie_obc = G_in%JegB - Je_obc_in
69650 Js_obc = Is_obc_in ; Je_obc = Ie_obc_in
69660 elseif (qturns == 2) then
69670 Is_obc = G_in%IegB - Is_obc_in ; Ie_obc = G_in%IegB - Ie_obc_in
69680 Js_obc = G_in%JegB - Js_obc_in ; Je_obc = G_in%JegB - Je_obc_in
69690 elseif (qturns == 3) then
69700 Is_obc = Js_obc_in ; Ie_obc = Je_obc_in
69710 Js_obc = G_in%IegB - Is_obc_in ; Je_obc = G_in%IegB - Ie_obc_in
6972 endif
6973
6974 ! Orientation is based on the index ordering, and setup_segment_indices
6975 ! is based on the original order in the intput files.
69760 call setup_segment_indices(G, segment, Is_obc, Ie_obc, Js_obc, Je_obc)
6977
6978 ! Re-order [IJ][se]_obc back to ascending, and remove the global indexing offset.
69790 if (Is_obc > Ie_obc) then
69800 segment%Is_obc = Ie_obc - G%idg_offset
69810 segment%Ie_obc = Is_obc - G%idg_offset
6982 else
69830 segment%Is_obc = Is_obc - G%idg_offset
69840 segment%Ie_obc = Ie_obc - G%idg_offset
6985 endif
6986
69870 if (Js_obc > Je_obc) then
69880 segment%Js_obc = Je_obc - G%jdg_offset
69890 segment%Je_obc = Js_obc - G%jdg_offset
6990 else
69910 segment%Js_obc = Js_obc - G%jdg_offset
69920 segment%Je_obc = Je_obc - G%jdg_offset
6993 endif
6994
6995 ! Reconfigure the directional flags
69960 segment%direction = rotate_OBC_segment_direction(segment_in%direction, turns)
6997
6998 segment%is_E_or_W_2 = ((segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) .or. &
69990 (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W))
70000 segment%is_E_or_W = segment_in%on_PE .and. segment%is_E_or_W_2
7001 segment%is_N_or_S = segment_in%on_PE .and. &
7002 ((segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) .or. &
70030 (segment%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S))
7004
7005 ! These are conditionally set if Lscale_{in,out} are present
70060 segment%Tr_InvLscale_in = segment_in%Tr_InvLscale_in
70070 segment%Tr_InvLscale_out = segment_in%Tr_InvLscale_out
70080 segment%Th_InvLscale_in = segment_in%Th_InvLscale_in
70090 segment%Th_InvLscale_out = segment_in%Th_InvLscale_out
7010
7011 ! This needs to be set
70120 segment%num_fields = segment_in%num_fields
70130end subroutine rotate_OBC_segment_config
7014
7015
7016!> Return the direction of an OBC segment on after rotation to the new grid. Note that
7017!! rotate_OBC_seg_direction(rotate_OBC_seg_direction(direction, turns), -turns) = direction.
70180function rotate_OBC_segment_direction(direction, turns) result(rotated_dir)
7019 integer, intent(in) :: direction !< The orientation of an OBC segment on the original grid
7020 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns
7021 integer :: rotated_dir !< An integer encoding the new rotated segment direction
7022
7023 integer :: qturns ! The number of quarter turns in the range of 0 to 3
7024
70250 qturns = modulo(turns, 4)
7026
70270 if ((qturns == 0) .or. (direction == OBC_NONE)) then
70280 rotated_dir = direction
7029 else ! Determine the segment direction on a rotated grid
70300 select case (direction)
7031 case (OBC_DIRECTION_N)
70320 if (qturns == 0) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_N
70330 if (qturns == 1) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_W
70340 if (qturns == 2) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_S
70350 if (qturns == 3) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_E
7036 case (OBC_DIRECTION_W)
70370 if (qturns == 0) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_W
70380 if (qturns == 1) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_S
70390 if (qturns == 2) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_E
70400 if (qturns == 3) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_N
7041 case (OBC_DIRECTION_S)
70420 if (qturns == 0) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_S
70430 if (qturns == 1) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_E
70440 if (qturns == 2) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_N
70450 if (qturns == 3) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_W
7046 case (OBC_DIRECTION_E)
70470 if (qturns == 0) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_E
70480 if (qturns == 1) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_N
70490 if (qturns == 2) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_W
70500 if (qturns == 3) rotated_dir = OBC_DIRECTION_S
7051 case (OBC_NONE)
70520 rotated_dir = OBC_NONE
7053 case default ! This should never happen.
70540 rotated_dir = direction
7055 end select
7056 endif
7057
70580end function rotate_OBC_segment_direction
7059
7060!> Return the that the field would have after being rotated by the given number of quarter turns
70610function rotated_field_name(input_name, turns)
7062 character(len=*), intent(in) :: input_name !< The unrotated field name
7063 integer, intent(in) :: turns !< Number of quarter turns of the grid
7064 character(len=len(input_name)) :: rotated_field_name !< The rotated field name
7065
70660 if (modulo(turns, 2) /= 0) then
70670 select case (input_name)
70680 case ('U') ; rotated_field_name = 'V'
70690 case ('Uamp') ; rotated_field_name = 'Vamp'
70700 case ('Uphase') ; rotated_field_name = 'Vphase'
70710 case ('V') ; rotated_field_name = 'U'
70720 case ('Vamp') ; rotated_field_name = 'Uamp'
70730 case ('Vphase') ; rotated_field_name = 'Uphase'
70740 case ('DVDX') ; rotated_field_name = 'DUDY'
70750 case ('DUDY') ; rotated_field_name = 'DVDX'
70760 case default ; rotated_field_name = input_name
7077 end select
7078 else
70790 rotated_field_name = input_name
7080 endif
7081
70820end function rotated_field_name
7083
7084!> Allocate an array of data for a field on a segment based on the size of a potentially rotated source array
70850subroutine allocate_rotated_seg_data(src_array, HI_in, tgt_array, segment)
7086 real, dimension(:,:,:), intent(in) :: src_array !< The segment data on the unrotated source grid
7087 type(hor_index_type), intent(in) :: HI_in !< Horizontal indices on the source grid
7088 real, dimension(:,:,:), allocatable, intent(inout) :: tgt_array !< The segment data that is being allocated
7089 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(inout) :: segment !< OBC segment on the target grid
7090
7091 ! Local variables
7092 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB, nk
7093 logical :: corner ! True if this field is discretized at the OBC segment nodes rather than the faces.
7094
70950 isd = segment%HI%isd ; ied = segment%HI%ied ; IsdB = segment%HI%IsdB ; IedB = segment%HI%IedB
70960 jsd = segment%HI%jsd ; jed = segment%HI%jed ; JsdB = segment%HI%JsdB ; JedB = segment%HI%JedB
70970 nk = size(src_array, 3)
7098
7099 ! Determine whether the source array is allocated at a segment face or at the corners.
7100 corner = (size(src_array, 1) == abs(HI_in%IedB - HI_in%IsdB) + 1 ) .and. &
71010 (size(src_array, 2) == abs(HI_in%JedB - HI_in%JsdB) + 1 )
7102
71030 if (corner) then
71040 allocate(tgt_array(IsdB:IedB,JsdB:JedB,nk), source=0.0)
71050 elseif (segment%is_E_or_W) then
71060 allocate(tgt_array(IsdB:IedB,jsd:jed,nk), source=0.0)
71070 elseif (segment%is_N_or_S) then
71080 allocate(tgt_array(isd:ied,JsdB:JedB,nk), source=0.0)
7109 endif
71100end subroutine allocate_rotated_seg_data
7111
7112
7113!> Write out information about the contents of the OBC control structure
71140subroutine write_OBC_info(OBC, G, GV, US)
7115 type(ocean_OBC_type), pointer :: OBC !< An open boundary condition control structure
7116 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Rotated grid metric
7117 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Vertical grid
7118 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling
7119
7120 ! Local variables
7121 type(OBC_segment_type), pointer :: segment => NULL() ! pointer to segment type list
7122 integer :: turns ! Number of index quarter turns
7123 integer :: n ! The segment number reported in output
7124 integer :: n_seg ! The internal segment number
7125 integer :: dir ! This indicates the internal logical orientation of a segment
7126 integer :: unrot_dir ! This indicates the logical orientation a segment would have had
7127 ! without grid rotation
7128 integer :: c ! Used to loop over tidal constituents
7129 character(len=1024) :: mesg
7130
71310 turns = modulo(G%HI%turns, 4)
7132
71330 write(mesg, '("OBC has ", I0, " segments.")') OBC%number_of_segments
71340 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7135 ! call MOM_error(WARNING, mesg)
7136
71370 if (modulo(turns, 2) == 0) then
71380 if (OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("open_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71390 if (OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("open_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71400 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71410 if (OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71420 if (OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71430 if (OBC%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71440 if (OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("specified_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71450 if (OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("specified_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
7146 else ! The u- and v-directions are swapped.
71470 if (OBC%open_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("open_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71480 if (OBC%open_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("open_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71490 if (OBC%Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71500 if (OBC%Flather_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("Flather_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71510 if (OBC%nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71520 if (OBC%nudged_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("nudged_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71530 if (OBC%specified_v_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("specified_u_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71540 if (OBC%specified_u_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("specified_v_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
7155 endif
7156
71570 if (OBC%oblique_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("oblique_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71580 if (OBC%radiation_BCs_exist_globally) call MOM_mesg("radiation_BCs_exist_globally", verb=1)
71590 if (OBC%user_BCs_set_globally) call MOM_mesg("user_BCs_set_globally", verb=1)
71600 if (OBC%update_OBC) call MOM_mesg("update_OBC", verb=1)
71610 if (OBC%update_OBC_seg_data) call MOM_mesg("update_OBC_seg_data", verb=1)
71620 if (OBC%any_needs_IO_for_data) call MOM_mesg("any_needs_IO_for_data", verb=1)
71630 if (OBC%zero_biharmonic) call MOM_mesg("zero_biharmonic", verb=1)
71640 if (OBC%brushcutter_mode) call MOM_mesg("brushcutter_mode", verb=1)
71650 if (OBC%check_reconstruction) call MOM_mesg("check_reconstruction", verb=1)
71660 if (OBC%check_remapping) call MOM_mesg("check_remapping", verb=1)
71670 if (OBC%force_bounds_in_subcell) call MOM_mesg("force_bounds_in_subcell", verb=1)
71680 if (OBC%om4_remap_via_sub_cells) call MOM_mesg("om4_remap_via_sub_cells", verb=1)
71690 if (OBC%exterior_OBC_bug) call MOM_mesg("exterior_OBC_bug", verb=1)
71700 if (OBC%hor_index_bug) call MOM_mesg("hor_index_bug", verb=1)
71710 if (OBC%debug) call MOM_mesg("debug", verb=1)
71720 if (OBC%ramp) call MOM_mesg("ramp", verb=1)
71730 if (OBC%ramping_is_activated) call MOM_mesg("ramping_is_activated", verb=1)
71740 write(mesg, '("n_tide_constituents ", I0)') OBC%n_tide_constituents
71750 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
71760 if (OBC%n_tide_constituents > 0) then
71770 do c=1,OBC%n_tide_constituents
7178 write(mesg, '(" properties ", 4ES16.6)') &
71790 US%s_to_T*OBC%tide_frequencies(c), OBC%tide_eq_phases(c), OBC%tide_fn(c), OBC%tide_un(c)
71800 call MOM_mesg(trim(OBC%tide_names(c))//mesg, verb=1)
7181 enddo
7182 endif
71830 if (OBC%ramp) then
71840 write(mesg, '("ramp_values ", 3ES16.6)') OBC%ramp_timescale, OBC%trunc_ramp_time, OBC%ramp_value
71850 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7186 endif
71870 write(mesg, '("gamma_uv ", ES16.6)') OBC%gamma_uv
71880 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
71890 write(mesg, '("rx_max ", ES16.6)') OBC%rx_max
71900 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7191
71920 call MOM_mesg("remappingScheme = "//trim(OBC%remappingScheme), verb=1)
7193
71940 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
71950 n_seg = n ; if (OBC%reverse_segment_order) n_seg = OBC%number_of_segments + 1 - n
71960 segment => OBC%segment(n_seg)
71970 dir = segment%direction
7198
71990 unrot_dir = rotate_OBC_segment_direction(dir, -turns)
72000 write(mesg, '(" Segment ", I0, " has direction ", I0)') n, unrot_dir
72010 if (unrot_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_N) write(mesg, '(" Segment ", I0, " is Northern")') n
72020 if (unrot_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_S) write(mesg, '(" Segment ", I0, " is Southern")') n
72030 if (unrot_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_E) write(mesg, '(" Segment ", I0, " is Eastern")') n
72040 if (unrot_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_W) write(mesg, '(" Segment ", I0, " is Western")') n
72050 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7206
7207 ! write(mesg, '(" range:", 4(1x,I0))') segment%Is_obc, segment%Ie_obc, segment%Js_obc, segment%Je_obc
72080 if (modulo(turns, 2) == 0) then
72090 write(mesg, '(" size: ", I0," ",I0)') 1+abs(segment%Ie_obc-segment%Is_obc), 1+abs(segment%Je_obc-segment%Js_obc)
7210 else
72110 write(mesg, '(" size: ", I0," ",I0)') 1+abs(segment%Je_obc-segment%Js_obc), 1+abs(segment%Ie_obc-segment%Is_obc)
7212 endif
72130 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7214
72150 if (segment%on_pe) call MOM_mesg(" Segment is on PE.", verb=1)
7216
72170 if (segment%Flather) call MOM_mesg(" Flather", verb=1)
72180 if (segment%radiation) call MOM_mesg(" radiation", verb=1)
72190 if (segment%radiation_tan) call MOM_mesg(" radiation_tan", verb=1)
72200 if (segment%radiation_grad) call MOM_mesg(" radiation_grad", verb=1)
72210 if (segment%oblique) call MOM_mesg(" oblique", verb=1)
72220 if (segment%oblique_tan) call MOM_mesg(" oblique_tan", verb=1)
72230 if (segment%oblique_grad) call MOM_mesg(" oblique_grad", verb=1)
72240 if (segment%nudged) call MOM_mesg(" nudged", verb=1)
72250 if (segment%nudged_tan) call MOM_mesg(" nudged_tan", verb=1)
72260 if (segment%nudged_grad) call MOM_mesg(" nudged_grad", verb=1)
72270 if (segment%specified) call MOM_mesg(" specified", verb=1)
72280 if (segment%specified_tan) call MOM_mesg(" specified_tan", verb=1)
72290 if (segment%specified_grad) call MOM_mesg(" specified_grad", verb=1)
72300 if (segment%open) call MOM_mesg(" open", verb=1)
72310 if (segment%gradient) call MOM_mesg(" gradient", verb=1)
72320 if (modulo(turns, 2) == 0) then
72330 if (segment%is_N_or_S) call MOM_mesg(" is_N_or_S", verb=1)
72340 if (segment%is_E_or_W) call MOM_mesg(" is_E_or_W", verb=1)
7235 else ! The x- and y-directions are swapped.
72360 if (segment%is_E_or_W) call MOM_mesg(" is_N_or_S", verb=1)
72370 if (segment%is_N_or_S) call MOM_mesg(" is_E_or_W", verb=1)
7238 endif
7239 ! if (segment%is_E_or_W_2) call MOM_mesg(" is_E_or_W_2", verb=1)
7240
72410 write(mesg, '(" Tr_InvLscale_out ", ES16.6)') segment%Tr_InvLscale_out*US%m_to_L
72420 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
72430 write(mesg, '(" Tr_InvLscale_in ", ES16.6)') segment%Tr_InvLscale_in*US%m_to_L
72440 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
72450 write(mesg, '(" Th_InvLscale_out ", ES16.6)') segment%Th_InvLscale_out*US%m_to_L
72460 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
72470 write(mesg, '(" Th_InvLscale_in ", ES16.6)') segment%Th_InvLscale_in*US%m_to_L
72480 call MOM_mesg(mesg, verb=1)
7249
7250 enddo
7251
72520 call chksum_OBC_segments(OBC, G, GV, US, 0)
7253
72540end subroutine write_OBC_info
7255
7256!> Write checksums and perhaps some or all of the values of all the allocated arrays on the OBC segments.
72570subroutine chksum_OBC_segments(OBC, G, GV, US, nk)
7258 type(ocean_OBC_type), intent(in) :: OBC !< An open boundary condition control structure
7259 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Rotated grid metric
7260 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Vertical grid
7261 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling
7262 integer, intent(in) :: nk !< The number of layers to print
7263
7264 ! Local variables
7265 integer :: n ! The segment number reported in output
7266 integer :: n_seg ! The internal segment number
7267
72680 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
72690 n_seg = n ; if (OBC%reverse_segment_order) n_seg = OBC%number_of_segments + 1 - n
7270
72710 call chksum_OBC_segment_data(OBC%segment(n_seg), GV, US, nk, n)
7272 enddo
7273
72740end subroutine chksum_OBC_segments
7275
7276
7277!> Write checksums and perhaps some or all of the values of all the allocated arrays on a single OBC segment.
72780subroutine chksum_OBC_segment_data(segment, GV, US, nk, nseg_out)
7279 type(OBC_segment_type), intent(in) :: segment !< Segment type to checksum
7280 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< Vertical grid
7281 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< Unit scaling
7282 integer, intent(in) :: nk !< The number of layers to print
7283 integer, intent(in) :: nseg_out !< The segment number reported in output
7284
7285 ! Local variables
7286 real :: norm ! A sign change used when rotating a normal component [nondim]
7287 real :: tang ! A sign change used when rotating a tangential component [nondim]
7288 character(len=8) :: sn, segno
7289 integer :: dir ! This indicates the internal logical orientation of a segment
7290
72910 dir = segment%direction
7292
72930 write(segno, '(I0)') nseg_out
72940 sn = '('//trim(segno)//')'
7295
7296 ! Turn each segment and write it as though it is an eastern face.
72970 norm = 0.0 ; tang = 0.0
72980 if (dir == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
72990 norm = 1.0 ; tang = 1.0
73000 elseif (dir == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
73010 norm = 1.0 ; tang = -1.0
73020 elseif (dir == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
73030 norm = -1.0 ; tang = -1.0
73040 elseif (dir == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
73050 norm = -1.0 ; tang = 1.0
7306 endif
7307
73080 if (allocated(segment%Htot)) call write_2d_array_vals("Htot"//trim(sn), segment%Htot, dir, nk, unscale=GV%H_to_mks)
73090 if (allocated(segment%dZtot)) call write_2d_array_vals("dZtot"//trim(sn), segment%dZtot, dir, nk, unscale=US%Z_to_m)
73100 if (allocated(segment%SSH)) call write_2d_array_vals("SSH"//trim(sn), segment%SSH, dir, nk, unscale=US%Z_to_m)
73110 if (allocated(segment%normal_vel)) &
73120 call write_3d_array_vals("normal_vel"//trim(sn), segment%normal_vel, dir, nk, unscale=norm*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73130 if (allocated(segment%normal_vel_bt)) &
73140 call write_2d_array_vals("normal_vel_bt"//trim(sn), segment%normal_vel_bt, dir, nk, unscale=norm*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73150 if (allocated(segment%tangential_vel)) &
73160 call write_3d_array_vals("tangential_vel"//trim(sn), segment%tangential_vel, dir, nk, unscale=tang*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73170 if (allocated(segment%tangential_grad)) &
7318 call write_3d_array_vals("tangential_grad"//trim(sn), segment%tangential_grad, dir, nk, &
73190 unscale=tang*norm*US%s_to_T)
73200 if (allocated(segment%normal_trans)) &
7321 call write_3d_array_vals("normal_trans"//trim(sn), segment%normal_trans, dir, nk, &
73220 unscale=norm*GV%H_to_mks*US%L_T_to_m_s*US%L_to_m)
73230 if (allocated(segment%grad_normal)) &
73240 call write_3d_array_vals("grad_normal"//trim(sn), segment%grad_normal, dir, nk, unscale=norm*tang*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73250 if (allocated(segment%grad_tan)) &
73260 call write_3d_array_vals("grad_tan"//trim(sn), segment%grad_tan, dir, nk, unscale=1.0*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73270 if (allocated(segment%grad_gradient)) &
73280 call write_3d_array_vals("grad_gradient"//trim(sn), segment%grad_gradient, dir, nk, unscale=norm*US%s_to_T)
7329
73300 if (allocated(segment%rx_norm_rad)) &
73310 call write_3d_array_vals("rxy_norm_rad"//trim(sn), segment%rx_norm_rad, dir, nk, unscale=1.0)
73320 if (allocated(segment%ry_norm_rad)) &
73330 call write_3d_array_vals("rxy_norm_rad"//trim(sn), segment%ry_norm_rad, dir, nk, unscale=1.0)
73340 if (segment%is_E_or_W) then
73350 if (allocated(segment%rx_norm_obl)) &
73360 call write_3d_array_vals("rx_norm_obl"//trim(sn), segment%rx_norm_obl, dir, nk, unscale=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
73370 if (allocated(segment%ry_norm_obl)) &
73380 call write_3d_array_vals("ry_norm_obl"//trim(sn), segment%ry_norm_obl, dir, nk, unscale=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
7339 else ! The x- and y- directions are swapped.
73400 if (allocated(segment%ry_norm_obl)) &
73410 call write_3d_array_vals("rx_norm_obl"//trim(sn), segment%ry_norm_obl, dir, nk, unscale=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
73420 if (allocated(segment%rx_norm_obl)) &
73430 call write_3d_array_vals("ry_norm_obl"//trim(sn), segment%rx_norm_obl, dir, nk, unscale=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
7344 endif
7345
73460 if (allocated(segment%cff_normal)) &
73470 call write_3d_array_vals("cff_normal"//trim(sn), segment%cff_normal, dir, nk, unscale=US%L_T_to_m_s**2)
73480 if (allocated(segment%nudged_normal_vel)) &
7349 call write_3d_array_vals("nudged_normal_vel"//trim(sn), segment%nudged_normal_vel, dir, nk, &
73500 unscale=norm*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73510 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_vel)) &
7352 call write_3d_array_vals("nudged_tangential_vel"//trim(sn), segment%nudged_tangential_vel, dir, nk, &
73530 unscale=tang*US%L_T_to_m_s)
73540 if (allocated(segment%nudged_tangential_grad)) &
7355 call write_3d_array_vals("nudged_tangential_grad"//trim(sn), segment%nudged_tangential_grad, dir, nk, &
73560 unscale=tang*norm*US%s_to_T)
7357
7358 contains
7359
7360 !> Write out the values in a named 2-d segment data array
73610 subroutine write_2d_array_vals(name, Array, seg_dir, nkp, unscale)
7362 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< The name of the variable
7363 real, dimension(:,:), intent(in) :: Array !< The 2-d array to write [A ~> a]
7364 integer, intent(in) :: seg_dir !< The direction of the segment
7365 integer, intent(in) :: nkp !< Print all the values if this is greater than 0
7366 real, optional, intent(in) :: unscale !< A factor that undoes the scaling of the array [a A-1 ~> 1]
7367 ! Local variables
7368 real :: scale ! A factor that undoes the scaling of the array [a A-1 ~> 1]
7369 character(len=1024) :: mesg
7370 character(len=24) :: val
7371 integer :: i, j, n, iounit
7372
73730 scale = 1.0 ; if (present(unscale)) scale = unscale
73740 iounit = stderr
7375
73760 if (nkp > 0) then
73770 write(iounit, '(2X,A,":")') trim(name)
73780 mesg = "" ; n = 0
73790 if ((seg_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_N) .or. (seg_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_W)) then
73800 do j=size(Array,2),1,-1 ; do i=size(Array,1),1,-1
73810 write(val, '(ES16.6)') scale*Array(i,j)
73820 mesg = trim(mesg)//" "//trim(val) ; n = n + 1
73830 if (n >= 12) then
73840 write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
73850 mesg = "" ; n = 0
7386 endif
7387 enddo ; enddo
7388 else
73890 do j=1,size(Array,2) ; do i=1,size(Array,1)
73900 write(val, '(ES16.6)') scale*Array(i,j)
73910 mesg = trim(mesg)//" "//trim(val) ; n = n + 1
73920 if (n >= 12) then
73930 write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
73940 mesg = "" ; n = 0
7395 endif
7396 enddo ; enddo
7397 endif
73980 if (n > 0) write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
7399 endif
7400
74010 if (scale == 1.0) then
74020 call chksum(Array, name)
7403 else
74040 call chksum(scale*Array(:,:), name)
7405 endif
74060 end subroutine write_2d_array_vals
7407
7408 !> Write out the values in a 3-d segment data array
74090 subroutine write_3d_array_vals(name, Array, seg_dir, nkp, unscale)
7410 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name !< The name of the variable
7411 real, dimension(:,:,:), intent(in) :: Array !< The 3-d array to write
7412 integer, intent(in) :: seg_dir !< The direction of the segment
7413 integer, intent(in) :: nkp !< The number of layers to print
7414 real, optional, intent(in) :: unscale !< A factor that undoes the scaling of the array [a A-1 ~> 1]
7415 ! Local variables
7416 real :: scale ! A factor that undoes the scaling of the array [a A-1 ~> 1]
7417 logical :: reverse
7418 character(len=1024) :: mesg
7419 character(len=24) :: val
7420 integer :: i, j, k, n, nk, iounit
7421
74220 scale = 1.0 ; if (present(unscale)) scale = unscale
74230 iounit = stderr
7424
74250 if (nkp > 0) then
74260 nk = min(nkp, size(Array,3))
74270 write(iounit, '(2X,A,":")') trim(name)
74280 do k=1,nk
74290 mesg = "" ; n = 0
74300 if ((seg_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_N) .or. (seg_dir == OBC_DIRECTION_W)) then
74310 do j=size(Array,2),1,-1 ; do i=size(Array,1),1,-1
74320 write(val, '(ES16.6)') scale*Array(i,j,k)
74330 mesg = trim(mesg)//" "//trim(val) ; n = n + 1
74340 if (n >= 12) then
74350 write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
74360 mesg = "" ; n = 0
7437 endif
7438 enddo ; enddo
7439 else
74400 do j=1,size(Array,2) ; do i=1,size(Array,1)
74410 write(val, '(ES16.6)') scale*Array(i,j,k)
74420 mesg = trim(mesg)//" "//trim(val) ; n = n + 1
74430 if (n >= 12) then
74440 write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
74450 mesg = "" ; n = 0
7446 endif
7447 enddo ; enddo
7448 endif
74490 if (n > 0) write(iounit, '(2X,A)') trim(mesg)
7450 enddo
7451 endif
7452
74530 if (scale == 1.0) then
74540 call chksum(Array, name)
7455 else
74560 call chksum(scale*Array(:,:,:), name)
7457 endif
7458
74590 end subroutine write_3d_array_vals
7460
7461end subroutine chksum_OBC_segment_data
7462
7463!> \namespace mom_open_boundary
7464!! This module implements some aspects of internal open boundary
7465!! conditions in MOM.
7466!!
7467!! A small fragment of the grid is shown below:
7468!!
7469!! j+1 x ^ x ^ x At x: q, CoriolisBu
7470!! j+1 > o > o > At ^: v, tauy
7471!! j x ^ x ^ x At >: u, taux
7472!! j > o > o > At o: h, bathyT, buoy, tr, T, S, Rml, ustar
7473!! j-1 x ^ x ^ x
7474!! i-1 i i+1 At x & ^:
7475!! i i+1 At > & o:
7476!!
7477!! The boundaries always run through q grid points (x).
7478
74790end module MOM_open_boundary
